tei:div.tei:p: — — cho rdze'i—sku4ne+e — —dz+wa — — 4 ge+o hūṃ be+e — dz+wa dz+wa sgo 4 dā stag ge kai ge ri gad+ku ga tso— ༄ d+nghaspre —— — —nge+o bo'i ko+o — seng ba /— — — ko r+ha la—— — —ri —spre — 4 dzha byā — 4 —wa wa ḍa 4 tre — cho sa skene rngosnye tshopharkarke du 4 — — khe d+ngha—— —bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /tho sku
rwa stag gi don rkyen dang de'i ngo bo'i skor gleng ba/phun tshes rtsom sgrig byas/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /

— gleng gzhi/rwa stag gi don rkyen de ni don dngos thog nye rabs bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung ba'i kha bral dang kha bral la ngo rgol byed pa'i ches rno ngar dang / ches dza drag ches rnyog 'dzing bcas kyi 'thab rtsod cig yin la/ a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas mngon sum 'dzems med kyis krung go'i nang srid la the jus byas te bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs nas kha bral btang ste kho pa tsho'i mi ser spel yul du sgyur thabs byed pa'i sdig nyes kyi dpang rtags mtshon byed cig kyang yin/bod chu bya ( 1933) lo'i zla 1rkyatshes 20nyin rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das shing /skabs der bod kyi dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de ni ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba dang rno ngar can du gyur pa ste gtso bo'i don gnad ni rgyal tshab su la sko min der thug yod/ dus der rgyal gces kyi ser skya dpon rigs mang che bas rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes ni chos srid gnyis ka'i mkhyen rgya che zhing / sku na chung dus nas bla ma skyes chen dam pa'i rang rtags ldan pa zhig yin — 1 —

stabs de 'os che shos yin zhes brjod/ 'on kyang ser skya dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis chos phyogs kyi mtshan snyan shin tu che ba dga' ldan khri pa ye shes dbang ldan dang / phur lcog yongs 'dzin sprul sku byams pa thub bstan 'os zhes zhus/mthar chos lugs kyi rgyun srol ltar zan brtag phul bas rwa sgreng bzang bar phebs pa ltar/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la gser snyan sgron pa ma zad/ bod ljongs tshogs 'dus kyang rwa sgreng ho thog thu thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyis rgyal tshab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes thog glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug nas sngar mus bzhin srid blon gyi las gnas bzhes rgyu'i re ba zhus pa ltar/ shing khyi ( 1934) lo'i zla 1tshes 1kyanyin gza' skar 'byung 'phrod mchog tu dge ba'i nyin rwa sgreng ho thog thu thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyis rgyal tshab kyi srid 'gan bzhes te go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhus pa dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i yang srid gdan zhu gnang ba/ dbu skyes gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan gsol ba sogs kyi mdzad sgo legs sgrub gnang ba ma zad/ rgya bod mthun lam dang mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la phan pa'i phyag las mang po gnang ba ste ri 'gog dmag 'khrug 'go tshugs ma thag tu paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal — 2 —

ye shes rnam gnyis nas krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur mtha' gcig tu zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan pa dang / lhag tu bod rigs ser skya mang tshogs kyi khrod du ri 'gog rgyal skyob kyi dril bsgrags slob gso rgya che spel ba/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis pho nya mngags te paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa bod du phyir phebs mdzad rgyu'i re ba bton pa/ de bzhin snga rjes su go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab hong rma'o sung dang 'u krung shing sogs lha sar phebs skabs bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas gnang ba/ lha sar bca' sdod go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi don gcod khang dngos su btsugs te mes bod 'brel ba nyin bzhin je legs su phyin pa red/ phyogs — mtshungs dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og mes bod 'brel ba gtor bshig gtong ba dang / bod kyi srid dbang mgo rting slog pa'i lkog g.yo mtha' dag thal ba'i rdul du brlags pa bcas la brten btsan dga' shog khas rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes sogs rgyal gces kyi ser skya dpon rigs rnams mig nang gi gra ma dang sha'i nang gi tsher ma lta bur brtsis te g.yo thabs la brten nas srid dbang 'phrog rgyu dang /rgyal gces stobs shugs la rdung rdeg gtong ba'i lkog g.yo rab dang rim pa bshams pa/ dper na/ seng ge bla ma bslu brid dang g.yo sgyu'i sbyor bar brten nas lcag sbrul (1941)lo'i zla — 3 bhe

1tshes 1nyin stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab kyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid 'gan gtso bo blangs/ de nas kho pa tshos mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byed pa'i bya ngan mang po spel ba ste/lcags sbrul ( 1941) lor ri pin gyis mtsho 'gram gru kha rnams bkag stabs go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod kyi shar khul brgyud mes rgyal nang sa dang rgya gar bar rlangs 'khor 'gro lam bzo rgyu'i gra sgrig byas te 'di lo'i zla 9par rlangs 'khor 'gro lam bzo mi bod du bskyod kyang stag brag sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ 'on kyang lo de rang du a ri'i dmag don 'thab byus gsang 'phrin cus kyi mi sna bod du dmag don brtag zhib byed par yong chog pa'i mos mthun byas/ chu rta ( 1942)lo'i zla 7tshes 6nyin khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas phyi 'brel las khungs dngos su btsugs pa ma zad/ lha sar bca' sdod go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi don gcod khang la'ang slad phyin las don mtha' dag phyi 'brel las khungs brgyud bka' shag tu zhu dgos zhes brda khyab btang / shing sprel ( 1944)lor dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa gso skyong byed ched lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa btsugs/ de bzhin btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rjes 'brang pa zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs dmigs bsal gyi sgo nas bka' ge 4 —

blon dang tsis dpon sogs la gnas spar byas/ de rjes stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog khas rgyal zur rwa sgreng la ma nyes kha g.yogs mang tsam byas te btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab pa ri car san gyi ngan skul 'og rgyal zur rwa sgreng dang rgyal gces ser skya dpon rigs gtso bo 'ga' zhig 'dzin bzung thog mthar me phag ( 1947) lo'i zla 2tshes 2ṭ+wāṃnyin rtse shar chen lcog tu rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkrongs/ khong gi zhabs 'bring dang ser skya dpon rigs mang po btson du bcug de nas stag brag shog khas bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur te mngon sum 'dzems med kyis mes bod kha bral gtong ba'i bya ngan rab dang rim pa spel zhing / me phag (1947)lor tha'i ji bsam pho tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang / mkhan chung blo bzang dbang rgyal sogs ngo las drug tsam rgya gar ldi lir e she ya mi rigs ser po'i don gnad skor gyi tshogs 'dur btang nas mes bod kha bral gtong ba'i bya ngan mang tsam spel/ de rjes dbyin ji'i lag nas go mtshon 'bor chen nyos te bod dmag rgya skyed gtong ba'i grabs byas pa ma zad/ rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan dang / chang khyim thub bstan tshe dpal/rim bzhi spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel sogs bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa a ri dang / dbyin ji/ rgya gar sogs la btang ste ‘‘bod rang btsan zer bar rgyal spyi'i rgyab — 5 —

skyor thob ched bya ngan mang tsam spel/ sa glang ( 1949)lo'i zla 7 tshes 8 nyin lha sar bca' sdod go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi don gcod khang gi dpon rigs ngo las dang /lha sar yod pa'i rgya rigs yod tshad phyir 'bud byas/ de rjes a ri dang / dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang ngan 'brel gyis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong bar bkag 'gog rab dang rim pa byas/ mthar bod kyi rgyal gces ser skya dpon rigs dang rgya che'i mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs srid skyong stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog kha dang / a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ‘‘bod rang btsan ’ zer ba de nyin mo'i rmi lam lta bur gyur pa dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis bod du dpung 'jug byas te bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas bod 'di dro skyid ldan pa'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang slar yang tshur log thub pa byung ba red/gong gsal lo rgyus don gnad 'di dag gi thog nas nye rabs bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung ba'i rwa stag don rkyen sogs ni gal 'gangs ha cang che ba'i lo rgyus don chen zhig yin pa gsal por rtogs thub/ lhag par du rwa stag don rkyen sogs nang dngos su zhugs myong ba'i ser skya dpon rigs mang po dang yun ring mnyam las byed pa'i ring khong rnam pas skabs de'i lo — 6 —

rgyus kyi don dngos dang zhib gsal gnas tshul mang po zhig sbas gsang med par mtshams sbyor gnang ba dang / de bzhin don rkyen de dag skor 'khod pa'i rgya bod dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs mang por lo mang ring zhib 'jug gzab nan zhus te rgya che'i klog pa po dang / lhag par du gzhon nu klog pa po rnams la phan pa cung zad yong ched deb chung 'di nyid rtsom sgrig zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang rang nyid kyi chab srid dang / rig gnas/lo rgyus shes bya sogs ha cang dman pas skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig yong nges la rgya che'i klog pa po dang lhag tu gzur gnas mkhas dbang rnams kyis skyon brjod dang bka' slob 'dzems med yod pa zhu/phun tshes/1992lo'irizla 1por/

dkar chagadang po/twa la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das rjes bod kyi dbang 'dzin pa'i dbar 'thab rtsod byung ba'i skor/ (1)gnyis pa/rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rgyal tshab kyi gser khrir 'khod pa dang / lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal sogs la nyes chad phog pa'i skor/(13)gsum pa/ stag brag shog khas g.yo thabs la brten nas srid dbang blangs pa dang / btsan dga' shog kha'i stobs shugs je cher phyin pa'i skor/ ༷ (29)

bzhi pa/rwa sta ga dbar srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de mngon gsal dod pa dang / rtso ngar che ba/ dza drag che ba bcas su gyur pa'i skor/ (46)lnga pa/ rgyal gces stobs shugs la pham nyes tshabs chen phog pa'i skor/ (64)drug pa/ rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkrongs rjes btsan dga' shog khas bod kyi srid dbang yo ngas su kha lo bsgyur pa'i skor / (116)bdun pa/bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs kyis kha bral ring lugs par ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas te srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab khri nas phab pa'i skor/ (138)

dang ngo / tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mcho mchog dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das rjes bo— kyi dbang 'dzin pa'i dbar ge'athab rtsod byung ba'i skor/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing lug ( 1895) lor dgung grangs bco brgyad la pebs skabs lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan dngos su bzhes te chu bya ( 1933) lo bar lo ngo sum cu so bdun tsam chab srid bskyangs pa'i ring tā la'i bla ma sku phreng na rim dang mi 'dra bar phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen sna tshogs 'phrad cing / 'on kyang gong sa mchog gis 'gal rkyen de dag las rnam par rgyalwa te bod kyi chab srid dang / rig gnas/ dpal 'byor bcas gong du spel ba dang / lhag par du mes rgyal mtha' mtshams sra brtan yo/nga ched sku ngal 'dzems med kyis mes rgyal dang mi dmangs la phan pa'i phyag las du ma mdzad/ stabs mi legs pa zhig la chu bya ( 1933) lo'i zla 10tshes 15tsam la mgul zim 1bsdos/

tshes 27nyin skung gzhi je lod du gyur kyang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags nas srid blon dang bka' shag la snyan seng ma zhus par gsang ba gnang / de rjes bka' shag gis gong sa mchog gi snyung gzhi je lod du song ba'i gnas tshul shes 'phral bka' blon bla ma dge 'dun chos dar dang / bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal/ bka' blon gnang byung pa bcas nas dga' ldan khri zur byams pa chos grags gdan drangs te nor gling spyan bsal pho brang du gsol 'debs zhu bar phebs kyang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis bkag 'gog gnang stabs sku mdun du bcar thabs med par phyir log mi byed thabs med byung / 'on kyang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis gsungs par gzhigs na tā la'i bla mar snyung gzhi phog rjes 'gan blos rtsa ba nas ma bzod par bka' shag tu snyan seng zhu rtsis thengs mang byas kyang gong sa mchog gis bka' shag la snyan seng rigs gtan nas byed mi dgos/ sku drag de tsho yong nas brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul ba sogs byas na nga'i rlung nad la gnod pa ma gtogs phan pa gang yang yong gi ma red ces gsungs byung / gong zla'i tshes 29nyin sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis gnas chung chos rje gzim chung du gdan drangs nas gzim chung spyan 'dren zhus pas gnas chung chos rjes cham 'joms dpa' bo — 2 —

bcu bzhi 'bul dgos zhes brjod pa ma zad/ chos rje'i gam g.yog gis sman blangs te phul 'phral gong sa mchog bka' mol gnang rgyu med par gyur/ don du sman log phul ba red/ de nas chu bya (1933) lo'i zla 1rkyatshes 2rkyanyin gyi dgong mo'i chu tshod 1rkyapa'i thog rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho gzim khri mtha' can du gyur bas sku bcar kun 'phel lags nas/ srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug dang / bka' shag la snyan seng mi zhu thabs med byung ba red/skabs der bod kyi ser skya mang tshogs mang po zhig gis gong sa mchog 'tsho bzhugs skabs mes rgol dang bod mi dmangs la phan pa'i bya ba bzang po ji snyed pa mdzad kyang da lam snyung gzhi bzhes pa'i skabs zhabs brtan sna gcig kyang sgrub mi ma byung bar glo bur dgongs pa rdzogs pa ni ha cang thabs sdug cig red zer srid blon glang mdun dang / bka' shag sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel sogs la 'khon 'dzin shugs chen byas/ de mtshungs srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug dang / sku bcar thub bstan kun 'apel/ rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal bcas dbang 'dzin shog kha so sos go skabs 'di dang bsdun nas spyi tshogs thog dang bod ljongs tshogs 'du sogs gang sar rang phyogs la bstod cing gzhan phyogs la dma' 'bebs byed pa'i gleng ge 3 —

phyogs mang po bzos pa dang / g.yo thabs sna tshogs la brten nas so so'i shog khas bod yongs kyi srid dbang kha lo sgyur thub thabs byas/ tā la'i bla ma zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul dang / lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal/ thub bstan kun 'phel bcas sku bcar spyan bsal phan tshun dbar gcig dbang gcig gis 'phrog pa'i 'thab rtsod rab dang rim pa byang yod/ rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyis bod rir 4zig tshogaspyo༄༄ la sna /rje/ (15ste:/dmag ga dmag spya' ga gnas bzung sa nga zla bzang dgra 'dul gis bode dmag gi dmag spyi byed skabs go mtshon mang po tshang min skor skyon 'dzugs mang po byas/ ‘‘de rjes sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags dang lung shar gnyis shugs che mnyam yin stabs spyan bsal nang khul mthun po ma byung bas bsnyad 'tshol ched tā la'i bla ma'i sku mdun du gleng phyogs mang tsam bzos/ dper na lung shar rol cha gtong rgyur dga' po yod stabs zla re bzhin nyin gnyis tsam ring rol cha gtong rogs tsho dang mnyam du 'dzoms te nyin dgung tsam nas gzhas dang zhabs bro brgyab ste sdod kyi yod lugs sogs snyan phra zhus stabs/ gzhung don las kar do 'khur ma byas pa lta bu'i dgongs phyogs byung ste dmag spyi'i las 'khur phyir 'then dang rtsis dpon rang 'jags su 'jog pa gnang ’ zhes gsal ba ltaḍi rding/ zhar dang thub bstan kun 'phel lags dbar 'gal

ba shugs cher song ba'i 'gag rtsa'i skabs der gong sa mchog glo bur dgongs pa rdzogs stabs lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal la 'khon lan slog pa'i go skabs shig rnyed nas drung rtsis dang gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mir skul slong mang tsam byas pa dang / lhag par du sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags su gong sa mchog gis dmigs bsal gyi brtsi mthong chen po gnang stabs dbang shugs ha cang che bas sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag khag gcig mi dga' bror gyur te khong la 'khon 'dzin chen po byas/skabs der dpon rigs khag gcig gis ‘‘spyan bsal/spyan bsal zer rgyal ba spyan ras gzigs kyi sbyan la su mi bsal bar bsdad yod pa red ’ ces zer/ yang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi yab bkra shis kyis ‘‘sde pa gzhung / sde pa gzhung zer yang nga gnyis pha bu gnyis red ’ces brjod pa red zer spyi tshogs thog skad cha de rigs ha cang khyab che bar gyur/ da dung gong sa mchog dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das rjes sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis gzim chung gi phyag lde khag bka' shag la 'bul lam zhus pa tsam las srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug dang bka' blon lhan rgyas kyi mdun du sngar bzhin dbang shed che ba dang lta ba mtho bas bod ljongs rngo+ogs 'du'i khongs mi dang de min sku drag mi nyung ba zhig gis mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur — 5 —

bstan stabs sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags la zhu len khrims gcod de bas byed bde ba byung /yang sgos lcags lug ( 1931) lor sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis grong drag dmag mi zer ba sku drag gi sras gzhung zhabs ma zhus pa dang / tshong pa che 'bring khag gi bu phrug de bzhin dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen gang legs yod pa bcas kyi bu phrug chig stong tsam bsdu bskong thog grong drag dmag sgar btsugs te rang nyid kyi drag dpung zhig tu brtsis kyang blos 'gel mthong chen bya yul de dag gis gzhan gyis ngan skul byas pa'i 'og go skabs de dang bstun nas nga tshor btsan shed byas te dmag khongs su bcug pa las dmag mi byed 'dod rtsa ba nas med lugs skor 'u thug snyan zhu phul stabs srid blon dang bka' shag gis grong drag dmag mi yongs rdzogs phyir slog byas te sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi rgyab rten dmag dpung rnams yongs su rtsa gtor btang /de nas sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags dang /bla sman pa byams pa lags/ gnas chung sku rten blo bzang bsod nams bcas bod ljongs tshogs 'du chen mo'i sar bskongs te gong sa mchog la sman log phul ba sogs nag nyes de dag tshogs 'du'i sar ngos len zhu dgos zhes tshogs 'du'i gtso skyong pa drung rtsis kyis bshad kyang sku bcar thub bstan kun d+ngha 6 —

'phel lags kyis zhwa phud gus bkur tsam yang ma byas par gong sa mchog gi snyung gzhi'i skor srid blon dang bka' shag la snyan seng mi zhu ba de dag tā la'i bla ma sku ngo ma'i dgongs don yin lugs skor mang tsam zhus stabs tshogs zhugs ser skya dpon rigs mang po khong khro langs te 'phral du btson 'jug dang /lus steng khrims gcod bka' dpyad gtong dgos pa'i gros rkyu'ago bton/ de nas drung rtsis dang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus kyis ‘‘de ring khyed kyis bod ljongs tshogs 'du chen mor gus bkur zhwa phud tsam mi byed pa'i thog ngos len sne gcig mi zhu ba'i gdeng tshod ji yod do nub bsam blo btang ste sang nyin tshogs 'dur ngos len kha gsal zhu dgos ’’duzhes brjod nas phyir slog btang /sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags phyir log rjes da res chu+ogs 'dus nag med nyes 'gel gyis bzo lta sprod bzo che ba 'dug snyam ste me mda' zhig gra sgrig gis rang med mi med dzi cig bzo dgos snyam yang khong gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yongs 'dzin phur lcog sprul sku byams pa thub bstan tshul khrims mchog gis 'jam bshad blo 'gugs gnang bas de don dang len zhus/de nas slar yang bod ljongs tshogs 'du chen mo 'tshogs 'phral 10patri gsashāg/da kyi spro sa/ rig gnas dasnad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 12pa'i shog grangs — 7 —

sku srung ru dpon cha pa sras dbang chen g.yu lhar ka dang dmag mi lding khag gcig khrid de thub bstan kun 'phel bros byol du mi song bar 'phral du tshogs 'du'i thog khrid yong dgos pa'i bka' phab pa bzhin ka dang ru dpon cha pa sras nas thub bstan kun 'phel tshogs 'du'i sar khrid yong stabs sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags che nyams yongs su shor te pus mo'i lha nga gnyis sa la btsugs te bsdad/ skabs der tshogs 'du'i sar lus bsher btang ba ma zad/ drung rtsis nas ‘‘khyod kyis nag nyes rnams ngos len zhu dgos zhes brjod 'phral sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis phyag 'tshal bzhin rang skyon ngos len thog nor 'khrul nag nyes che yang /da phan gong sa skyabs mgon rin po cher zhabs zhu yun ring byas par dgongs te srog thog tu 'gro mi dgos pa'i re ba phyag yang yang 'tshal te zhus mthar ‘‘srog thog la 'gro dgos min khyed rang la rag lus yod ’ ces zer bzhin dngos su 'dzin bzung thog btson srung ka dang dmag mi dang sbrags rtse pho brang gi shar chen lcog tu btson 'jug byas pa ma zad/ thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi yab bkra shis dang spun nye 'ga' zhig gis rnam kun ltag shed ngoms te dbang shugs ha cang che bas pha bkra shis nor gling nas 'dzin bzung gis snang rtse shag tu bcug thog nang gzhis snye mo khul la sgo the'u rgyag par rtse drung ngag — 8 —

dbang bsam gtan sogs btang / de bzhin spun nye ser byes phyag mdzod grwa chung dang / zhol las khungs nenyer chung ngag dbang sogs 'dzin bzung gis zhol las khungs su btson 'jug byas thog nang gzhis tshang mar sgo therlu brgyab/ de bzhin bla sman pa byams pa lags dang gnas chung sku— rten blo bzang bsod nams gnyis kyang tshogs 'du'i sar zhu ba len thog bcon 'jug byas/ de nas bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa nas gong gsal mi sna rnams la nyes chad khrims gcod byed phyogs skor gros mol gzab nan byas pa dang 'brel bka' shag brgyud srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug la 'char phul phyag rtags yong ba zhus par/ sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kong po rtse la sgang rdzong du rgyang 'bud gtong rgyu dang /khong gi pha bkra shis snye mo rdzong la rtsis sprod thog nang mi khyim rgyud dang bcas pa'i kha dbang gzhung bzhes gtong rgyu/ de bzhin bla sman pa byams pa lags kyi kha dbang gzhung bzhes thog dwags po rgya tsha rdzong du rgyang 'bud gtong rgyu/ gnas chung sku rten blo bzang bsod nams 'bras spungs blo gsal gling la rtsis sprod bya rgyu bcas kyi bka' dpya da btang ba ltar lo de ga'i zla 12tshes 29nyin dgu gtor te dgon sde khag nas gtor rgyag dang /khyim tshang tshang mas dgu gtor glud rdzong byed pa'i nyin der thub — 9 —

bstan kun 'phel lags rtse shar chen lcog btson khang nas bton te dpon rigs ser skya gnyis dang dmag mi bcu'i lta srung 'og lha sa'i khrom gzhung brgyud khrid yong ba dang / khong gi pha bkra shis snang rtse shag gi btson khang nas bton te lha sa'i khrom gzhung brgyud khrid yong ste dus gcig tu rgyang 'bud gtong ba sogs gang sdug gang ngan byas/ de rjes thub bstan kun 'phel lags kong po rtse la sgang rdzong nas 'brug yul brgyud rgya gar du bros pa dang / de nas rgya gar bas khong la dogs pa chen po byas te/ 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byed rtsis byas kyang skabs de'i rgya gar du bca' sdod go min tang srid gzhung gi gzhung tshab che mo ba'i rogs ram 'og rgyal sa nan cing du bros byol phebs pa dang / 'tsho bar dka' ngal ha cang chen po 'phrad/de bzhin skabs der srid blon las rogs su 'os skor dbang 'dzin dpon rigs shog kha so so'i dbar rtsod gleng ha cang chen po byung zhing / bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i thog se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po las sne tshos mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur ngang ‘‘bod chos ldan gyi zhing khams khyad du 'phags pa der lugs gnyis kyi chab srid chos bzhin bskyang dgos na dad gus zhu yul zhig dgos gal che bas bla sprul zhig srid blon las rogs su bsko dgos mi zhes brjod kyang / ‘‘lcang can — 10 —

sras bsod nams rgyal pos srid blon phyag rogs bla sprul bsko rgyu en chung snabs tshir gcig khri steng du bzhag de'i phyag mdzod dza sag sna thag 'bo gang tsam 'then mkhan chab srid kyi nyams myong rtsa ba nas med pa zhig la bskos na mi 'grig glu②zer/ rtse skor rtse drung tshang mas se 'bras dga' gsum gyi gros 'gor yongs su mos mthun byas te bla sprul zhig srid blon las rogs su bsko dgos pa'i lta ba mtha' 'khyongs byas/ yang dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug la ma 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis ‘‘rgyal ba'i sku tsha song tsang byin rlabs che ba tsam las de min gyi dge mtshan che ba gang yang mi 'dug ces brjod/ dus der tshogs 'du'i thog rtsod gleng shugs che byung ste/ mgron gnyer che mo ba bstan 'dzin chos 'phel gyi skul slong 'og rtse drung rnams tshogs 'du nas phyir 'then gyis tshogs 'du zur du 'tshogs te srid blon las rogs bla sprul zhig dgos pa'i dge mtshan gnas lugs mang tsam brjod/ dus mtshungs shod drung bon shod tshe brtan dbang rgyal sogs drung 'khor khag gcig gis kyang rtse drung dang se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po dang 'thus mi'i phyogs su langs stabs rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes srid blon 7paralhasal〈/〈bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigad+ku〉deb 12pa'i zhog grangs — 11 —

las rogs su bsko gzhag gnang bzo che bar brten rwa sgreng phyogs gtogs kyi rgan gras shes ldan dad gus can gyi dpon rigs dang zhabs 'bring mang pos ‘‘srid blon las rogs bsko gzhag gnang rigs byung tshe khyed kyis rtsa ba nas zhal bzhes gnang rgyu med/ de snga bstan gling de mo ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas mchog dang / rwa sgrong sku thog gong ma ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan sogs srid skyong gnang skabs nag med nyes 'dogs kyis do phog gyong gun tshabs chen phog pa'i lo rgyus bslab bya de tshor dgongs bzhes gzab nan gnang dgos ’ zhes zhus/ de bzhin dpon rigs la las ‘‘sde pa gzhung gi sku drag de tshor ngo tsha khrel gzhung rtsa ba nas med ’ ces zer/ lhag par du rwa sgrong thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyi yab phun tshogs dgra 'dul gyis kyang ‘‘srid skyong gi thugs 'gan rtsa ba nas ma bzhes rogs gnang ’ zhes re ba skyabs 'jug yang yang zhus pa bcas la brten rwa sgreng rin po ches srid blon las rogs lam seng mi gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / 'on kyang srid tshab bla sprul zhig bsko rgyu ni ldog thabs med pa'i dmangs kyi re 'dun zhig tu gyur/ de rjes srid blon las rogs kyi 'os gtso bo rnams zan brtag 'bul rgyu'i thag gcode gtan 'khel byas/— 12 —

gnyis pa/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rgyal tshab kyi gser khrir 'khod pa dang / lung shar rdo rje che rgyal sogs la nyes chad phog pa'i skor/bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas bsdus kyis tshig tho phul nas rgyal tshab su 'os zan brtag bsgril rgyu'i 'os su rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes dang / dga' ldan khri pa mi nyag a mi ye shes dbang ldan/ phur lcog sprul sku byams pa thub bstan tso+ol khrims gsum sutshobazang ba yod min mtshan shog bris te rtse po ta la'i rten gtso 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra'i spyan sngar mchod sprin gzab rgyas bshams pa dang 'brel srid blon glang mdun dang / bka' blon rnam pa/ spyi khyab mkhan po/drung yig che mo ba/ rtsis dpon/ gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus bcas lhan 'dzoms thog dga' ldan khri zur byams pa chos grags mchog nas thugs smon gnang bzhin zan brtag bsgril bas rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes bzang zhes thon/ skabs der rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rwa sgrong dge 'phel gling du bzhugs mus yin stabs bod ljongs tshogs 'udus rwa sgreng rin po ches rgyal tshab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes gnang yong ba zhu ba'i pho nya mngags pa ma — 13 —

zad/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la snyan sgron chog mchan zhu yig kyang phul/ dus der rwa sgreng mchog gis kyang lha bla ma'i lung bstan dang bod ljongs ser skya dpon rigs mang tshogs kyi 'dun par gzhigs nas lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu'i zhal bzhes mi gnang mthu med byung ba bzhin rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing khyi ( 1934) lo'i zla 1tshes 1༷nyin gza' skar 'byung 'phrod mchog tu dge ba'i nyin rgyal tshab kyi gser khrir mnga' gsol ba dang / dus mtshungs srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug gis sngar mus bzhin srid blon gyi 'gan bzhes gnang rgyu'i re ba zhus pa bzhin rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis srid blon glang mdun dang lhan sbrel thog lo lnga tsam ring lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan yongs su bzhes/dus der rgyal tshab rwa sgreng sogs kyis dmigs bsal tshogs 'du'i thog gong sa bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku gdung lha khang dang rten rnams bzheng phyogs skor tshogs zhugs 'thus mi yongs kyis mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur thog rgyal dbang thub— bstan rgya mtsho ni bod dmangs skye 'gro kun la bka' drin lhag par che bas gser gdung khyad du 'phags pa zhig bzheng dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ltar/ gser gdung gsar bzheng legs sgrub yong ched do dam par bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang chen dang / mkhan drung ram pa ba/ rtsis dpon khro dga' ba/— 14 —

de bzhin las bya 'ga' zhig bcas bsko gzhag bstsal ba dang 'brel gser gdung lha khang dang gser gdung bzheng yul gang dga' brtag dpyad gra sgrig legs par mdzad de rtse pho brang dmar po'i nub rgyud du gser gdung lha khang gi ar las dang gser gdung las grwa dus gcig tu 'go tshugs te rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i gser sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig las sku tshad rgyug mtho lnga yis mtho ba dang / bzo bkod khyad du 'phags pa/rin bral phra rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i gser gdung dge legs 'dod 'jo bzheng 'go tshugs pa dang / phyogs mtshungs dad ldan skye bo pho mo kun gyis mchod 'bul dang bsnyen bkur zhu bde ba'i ched du gong sa mchog gi sku 'dra byin can lnga bzhengs te gdung khang dge legs 'dod 'jo dang / rtse po ta la/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang / zhol par khang / nor bu gling kha bcas la bzhugs su gsol rgyu'i gtan 'khel mdzad/de bzhin rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mthun lam la shugs snon dang / go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba 'thus sgo tshang du gtong ba'i thad phyag las mang po gnang ba ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid gdan zhu gnang rgyu'i thad la'ang phyag las rgya che mdzad pa bcas la brten btsan /dga' shog khas 'khon 'dzin bcangs nas rwa sgreng gi srid dbang mgo rting bslag rgyu'i — 15 —

lkog g.yo bshams/dus der rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal ni dbang shugs ha cang che ba zhig yin pas slad phyin bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo sgyur thub pa'i ched du srid 'gyur byed pa'i gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs shig btsugs te phyi rgyar brjod mkhas tsam gyis ‘‘skyid phyogs kun mthurge nam bstan pa rgyas pa ’ zhes 'bod/ don du sgrig 'dzugs de'i lte ba'i khongs mi mang che ba ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi pha shul bu 'dzin byed mkhan dang ham sems can gyi shod drung khag gcig yin zhing /kho pa tsho'i lkog gshom der ser skya dpon rigs mang che ba'i rgyab skyor thob pa'i ched du kho pa tsho'i khongs mi gtso gras phyag dpe do dam pa rtse drung thub bstan dge ldan (ming gzhan dkar me khang gi kong phrug zer ) gyis rtse skor gyi rtse drung nang gleng phyogs mang po bzos pa ste ‘‘de snga'i lung bstan zhig nang mchod rten mgo med 'ong zer ba yod pas da lta rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i gser gdung gsar bzheng gnang mus mjug 'khyongs rgyur gegs bar chen po yong nyen yod pa red/ der brten rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid 'khrul bral gdan zhu thub pa dang / bstan srid la nyams chag med par yar rgyas gnas thabs sogs kyi ched nga rang tsho gzhung gi bka' — 16 —

drin gyis 'tsho ba yin stabs zhen skul zhu 'os pa yin ⑧ tshul sogs kyi ngan skul byas par brten rtse skor gyi rtse drung mang che bas lkog g.yo ngan byus kyi gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs yod pa rtsa ba nas ma shes par rtse drung thub bstan dge ldan gyi skul slong 'og rtse drung brgyad cu lhag tsam gyis nang mol gan rgya der ming rtags bkod pa red/ 'on kyang de rjes ‘‘rtse drung 'tshog sar shod drung bsher dpang rgyal mkhar nang pa dang / shod drung sman ri ba/ shod drung brag mthon pa/ de min gcig bcas yong ste sman ri bas 6nga ①ོ shod skor ni skyes tsam nas sa bzang gdan btings/ khang bzang mgo la gyon te 'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal med pas bstan srid 'di tsam nyag phrar thug dus nga tshos rkang len byed dgos kyang rtse skor nas gnang ba thugs rje che/nga tsho shod skor mi nyi shu rtsa gsum yod/ de ring ming zhu gi min/nga tsho bzhi spyi 'thus su bcar ba yin/ srid gzhung gis go gnas bsko 'then drang po rtsa ba nas med pas rtswa gnyer dang /rtsam bzhes/ shing gnyer bcas gsum gyong gun yod pa shod skor pha gzhis yod pa'i kha gtad rtse drung grwa rkyang nas gnang mus dang / chab srid kyi dbang cha 'dzin mkhan bka' blon bzhi'i khongs su rtse skor gcig las med pa sogs drang po min 6༷pa rdzi gsanābo/da kyi rig gnas lo rgyus daphyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigasata〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs — 17 —

pa dngos ra gsal 'phrod yod pas rtse skor la bka' blon bla ma gcig 'phar du phul te rtse shod bka' blon gnyis re gnang rgyu/da lta bka' shag nang bka' blon khri smon gyi dbang shugs su phyin te gang ci'i thad drang po drang bzhag rtsa ba nas med lugs skad cha mang po bshad dupa red/ skad cha 'di dag la rtse skor gyi rtse drung mang— po yid ma rangs par gyur te ‘‘bka' blon khri smon gyis drang po ma byas pa'i skor nga tshor rtsa ba nas shod rgyu med/ gal srid bka' blon khri smon gyis drang po ma gnang ba'i dbang du btang na'ang / thag gcod chog mchan rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyisamuganang bas dgongs 'gal yongari nges red ces brjod/ dus der rtse skor gyi rtse drung khag gcig gis kho pa tsho'i lkog g.yo rim bzhin gsal rtogs thub ste sgrig 'dzugs de nas phyir 'then byas/nyin zhig ‘‘skyid phyogs kun mthun ’ zhes pa'i gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs de'i lte ba'i khongs mi rnams lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi gtso skyong 'og lkog tu tshogs 'du 'tshogs te ‘‘bod du da yod lam lugs bsgyur bcos thog sgrid mo khe rin si'i (dbyin skad de dmangs gtso zhes pa'i don yin )lam lugaso lag len bstar dgos ’ zhes brjod skabs tshogs zhugs dpon rigs 62pani gsanābo/da kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs — 18 —

'ga' zhig gis tha snyad de'i go don gang yin skad cha dris par lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyis dbyin ji'i lam lugs la zer ba red ces 'grel bshad khungs ma dag cig brgyab stabs tshogs zhugs dpon rigs khag gcig gis ‘‘gangs can chos ldan zhing khams la dbyin ji'i lam lugs lag len bstar mi rung ’ zhes brjod nas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ lhag par du rim bzhi ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas ‘‘tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su ‘ dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs la mdun dpral ba bstan nas 'dzing dgos pa las/rgyab lcang lo bstan nas bros rgyu med ’ ces gsungs pas der mos mthun rtsa ba nas med ’ ces gsungs pa ma zad/ gsang gros byas pa'i gnas tshul rnams bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang chen la gsang brda yang zhus/ khri smon gyis gnas tshul de thos 'phral rgyagotshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes la gser snyan sgron te khong gnyis ka 'bras spungs su g.yol thabs gnang nas bzhugs/ de nas nyin shas song mtshams rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal shod 'gag tu bskongs te las zhabs chabs cig gnas dbyung gis dpon chas zhwa gos lham gsum bshu skabs lung shar bas lham nang nas yi ge zhig bton te kha la zas pas shod mgron gzim gyis 'gram pa btsir nas 'don thabs ji ltar byas kyang bton mi thub par khyur mid ge 19 —

btang ba dang / lham ya gcig sngog bsher byed skabs mthu sngags 'khor lo'i steng ‘‘khri smon nor bu dbang che na nan ’ zhes 'khod yod pa red ces yongs grags byas/ de nas lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal dang / ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma rtse shar chen lcog gi btson khang du btson 'jug byas pa ma zad/ lcang can bsod nams rgyal po dang / rgyal mkhar nang pa/ sman ri ba/brag mthon pa/ cha pa sras dbang chen g.yu lha/ rtse drung mkhyen rab mthar phyin/ kong phrug thub bstan dge ldan sogs kyang 'dzin bzung thog btson 'jug byas/ skabs der drung yig che mo ba mkhyen rab mthar phyin dang / rtsis dpon klu khang ba tshe dbang rab brtan/ dmag spyi mkhan chung bstan pa 'jam dbyangs/ sku srung mda' dpon snang dkar dbang phyug mthar phyin bcas gyod don zhib bsher par bsko gzhag thog lung shar la 'dri rtsad zhu ba thengs mang len kyang ngos len rtsa ba nas ma zhus stabs ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas lung shar sogs kyis ‘‘skyid phyogs kun mthun zhes pa'i gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi phyi rgyar chab srid legs bcos bya rgyu zhes brjod mkhas tsam las don du bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang chen sogs mgo rting bslogs te bod kyi srid dbang lung shar sogs kyis len rgyu'i nang gan yod lugs skor ther 'don byas pas lung shar ba phrag pa glod bzhin mig gnyis sa la lta ba dang /— 20 —

smra ba'i lce chad pa lta bur gyur te nag nyes rnams ngos len ma zhu rang zhu thug de nas lung shar don gnad kyi zhib gcod pa bzhi sbrel gyis 'char gzhi phul bar byed gte gtso bo lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi mig 'bras gnyis ka 'don rgyu zhes 'khod yod na'ang rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes yod stabs ‘‘mi'i dbang po yan lag gcod breg byed pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang yongs su 'gal bas srid blon glang mdun mchog gis thag gcod bka' mchan yong ba zhu ’ zhes gsungs pa ltar/srid blon glang mdun gyis 'char gzhi der yongs su mos/ mthun chu+og mchan gnang ste lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi mig 'bras gnyis ka bton nas zhol btson khang du tshe btson du bcugalcang can bsod nams rgyal po dang / cha pa sras dbang chen g.yu lha/ rgyal mkhar nang pa/ sman ri ba/ brag mthon pa/mkhyen rab mthar phyin/ kong phrug thub bstan dge ldan bcas byed gte rnams mtha' khul rdzong gzhis khag so sor rgyang 'bud btang / skabs der lcang can bsod nams rgyal po kong po rtse la sgang du rgyang 'bud btang / de rjes khong dang 'dra ba rgyang 'bud btang ba'i sku drag 'ga' zhig bka' dpyad dgongs 'khrol gyis lha sar phyir log thog gzhung zhabs bskyar zhu chog pa byung bas khong gis kyang bka' shag la bde sdug snyan zhu phul nas phyir log chog pa zhus kyang bka' shag gis mos — 21 —

mthun rtsa ba nas byas med/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni khong ni don rkyen de'i nang gi byed gte gtso bo'i gras shig yin pa tsam ma zad/ rnam kun ser skya dpon rigs gzhan la mthun lam zhan pa dang / mang tshogs kyi khrod du'ang bag chags ngan tsam yod pas red/ skabs der ‘‘lcang can rgyal po'i pho brang /dgrog dkrog gze ma ra mgo/ mgo la tog yod ma gtogs/tog med thar sa ma red ’ ces pa'i dmangs gzhas gang sar khyab pa de'i thog nas mang tshogs khag gcig gis khong la 'khon 'dzin chen po byed pa gsal po mthong thub/ des na lcang can gung bya thabs dben pa'i gnas su lhu/ngas te gnas skor du 'gro bar kha g.yar nas 'brug yul brgyud rgya gar du bros byol phebs te yun ring bzhugs/ de bzhin lha klu sras tshe dbang rdo rje dang dga' byang bstan pa gnyis las zhabs gnas dbyung btang ba dang / ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs khongs kyi gtso gras shig yin rung lung shar sogs byed gte rnams ther 'don byas stabs gu yangs su bzhag pa red/yig tshang—las khungs kyis rtse drung kong phrug thub bstan dge ldan gyi g.yo sgyu'i mgo skor 'og tshud nas gan rgyar ming rtags 'god mkhan rtse drung brgyad cu lhag tsam yod pa de dag la zhu ba blangs ba tsam las dbye 'byed rtsa zhib ma gnang bar yang bzos kyis mkhan chung so sor nyes chad gser srang bzhi re — 22 —

(gser srang rer dngul srang dgu dang zho lnga ) dang / rtse mgron dang / shod mgron/ las tshan pa bcas so sor nyes chad gser srang do re/ rtse drung dkyus dzo pa rer nyes chad gser srang gang re bcas gtong rgyu'i thag gcongasni gnang /dus der thub bstan kun 'phel lags su nyes chad tshabs chen phog ste kong po rtse la sgang du rgyang 'bud btang ba dang kha dbang gzhung bzhes btang ba sogs ya nga ba'i gnas tshul de spom mda' stobs rgyal gyis go rngotsho/sa byung zhing / khong ni rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos sma sdo khams khul gyi yul dmag gi 'go 'dzin ru dpon la bsko ga(nag gnang ba zhig red/ru dpon spom mda' stobs rgyal ni gong rnga5 mchog dang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags su lhag nga/sam zol med gnang mkhan zhig yin stabs gong sa mchog sku gshegs 'phral sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags su nye sa chad 'di lta bu phog par yid ma rangs par shing khyi (1spyo34dī/lo'i zla 1rkyapar khong gis yul dmag rnams khrid de smar khams/ sa‘srung mda' dpon nor rgyas nang pa'i dmag sgar la mtshan gti ba btang /skabs der mda' dpon ngo ma bzhugs med pa dang / brgya dpon dang dmag mi 'ga' zhig la rmas ston phog me skyogs dang / me mda' rdzas mdel/ sger gye rgyu dngos bcas pa mang po 'phrog bcom byas pa ma zad/ khams phyogs tshang ma — 23 —

bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi chab 'bangs su sdod mi dgos par sger langs byed dgos pa'i skul slong yang byas/ 'on kyang kho pa tshor yid mthun rgyab skyor byed mkhan ma byung khar/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang / srid blon glang mdun/ bka' shas/ bcas kyi bka' bkod ltar mdo spyi bka' tshab bkras mthong pa 'gyur med rgya mtshos drag gnon dmag dpung 'phral rdzongs gnang / spom mda' stobs rgyal gyi yul dmag rnams la dpa' rtsal gang tsam yod zer yang go lag sogs gang ci'i thad bod dmag dang 'gran thabs med pas spom mda' stobs rgyal dang yul dmag khag gcig zi khron zhing chen khongs 'ba' tsophyogs su bros byol du phyin/ yul dmag khag ga/cig bod dmag gis gson por bzung ste rkang pa'i nywa khug gi rtsa chen bcad / la la bsad rmas btang / bu rgan pa spom mda'arab dga' don rkyen de dang 'brel ba che bas/ bod dmag btang ste lha sar yod pa'i spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel gyi sdod shas/ gi mtha' bskor nas 'dzin rwazung byeng nye'i skabs der spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel ni spyang sgrung 'dzoms shing rnam kun thob khungs gdam sa'i grwa rigs las bya rnams dang mthun lam che bas grwa rigs dang spun nye tshos bka' shag tu spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel ni thengs 'ji'i don rkyen dang 'brel ba rtsa ba nas med lugs dag 'bud zhus pa dang / rte — 24 —

spun nye'i byas nyes la gzhigs te sa gnas srid gzhung gi go mtshon dang / sger gyi rgyu dngos 'phrog bcom byas rigs rnams skyin tshab chad lus med pa 'bul rgyu'i khas len zhus pa ma zad/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang / srid blon glang mdun / bka' yag sogs la'ang dgongs sel zhus/ des na bka' shag gis pha spom mda' nyi ma rgyal po dang / bu nyi ma rgyal mtshan gnyis ka sa gnas srid gzhung la lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang / spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel yang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi tshong don thad snga phyir zhabs zhu lan mang zhus pa sogs la brten rtsa zhib med par nyes pa yang bzos kyis gzhung sger rgyu dngos skyin tshab sprad 'thus chog pa'i thag gcod gnang / shing khyi ( 1934) lo'i zla 4par/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis hong rma'o sung bod du gtong gnang mdzad/ de'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs mchod sprin 'bul ba'i go skabs de dang bstun nas go ming tang krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba 'thus sgo tshang du btang ste phyi rgyal btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod kyi nang srid kha lo sgyur ba'i spyod ngan bkag 'gog bya rgyu de red/hong rma'o sung sku 'khor dang bcas pa lha sar 'byor rjes — 23 —

bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sne len dang bsu ba gzab rgyas zhus/ de nas sngar srol ltar go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab rnams lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / rgya stag ra mo che/ se 'bras dga' gsum sogs la mchod 'bul gnang bar phebs/ de rjes rtse pho brang chen po po ta lar mdzad sgo rgya che tshugs te rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshor ‘‘rgyal skyong bstan rgyas kun byam/sa byang chub slob dpon chen po ’ zhes pa'i rjes snon cho lo dang / g.yang ṭi'i 'ja' sa dam kha bcas gnang ba ma zad/ rgyal ba'i gser gdung gi zhal 'debs kyang gang legs 'bul gnang mdzad/ hong rma'o sung dang las rogs dpon rigs rnams lha sar zla gsum tsam bzhugs te rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang / srid blon/ bka' shag sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa dang rgya bod 'brel ba dam gtsang yong ba dang / go min tang grung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod kyi las don la shugs snon rgyag phyogs thad phan tshun bka' mol thengs mang gnang / gzhan yang go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bka' mngags ltar/ lha sar bca' sdod bod sog u yon lhan khang gi don gcod khang dngos su btsugs te go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi dpon rigs khag gcig lha sar bca' bzhugs gnang rgyu dang /skyid 'dod slob grwa dang / 'grim 'grul pu'u khongs kyi sbrag — 26 —

tar khang / sman khang / gnam gshis babs tshugs so gas dngos su 'dzugs thub pa byung bas rgya bod mthun lam la shugs snon thebs thub pa byung ba red/ skabs der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brang pa tshos thabs brgya byus stong gi sgo nas rgo min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rnams bod du yong bar bkag 'gog byas/ 'on kyang kho pa chu+o'i dmigs yul de sgrub mi thub stabs srid sgyur gyi bya thabs la brten nas btsan rgol rgyal gces shog kha'i stobs shugs rtsa gtor gtong ba'i lkog gshom rab dang rim pa spel/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyis rgyal gces yar thon gyi dar cha mthon por bsgrengs te krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel bar shugs snon dang /rgya bod mi rigs gyi mthun lam la phan pa'i phyag las mang po gnang ba ste/ ri 'gog dmag 'khrug 'go tshugs ma thag tu paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang lhan du go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur dang rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan pa dang /lhag par du bod rigs ser skya mang tshogs kyi khrod du ri 'gog rgyal skyob kyi dril bsgrags slob gso rgya che spel/ dus mtshungs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis pho nya mngags te paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pe bod du 'phral mar phyir log mdzad rgyu'i re ba — 27 —

bton/ des na btsan dga' shog khas khong la 'khon 'dzin de bas che ba byas te g.yo thabs la brten nas srid dbang 'phrog rgyu'i lkog g.yo chen po zhig bshams pa red/dus der rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes dang srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug dbar la'ang gzhung sger phyag las mang po'i thad phan tshun dargongs pa ma mthun pa'i 'gal rkyen byung ste rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis sngar srol ltar rgyal tshab na rim la las 'brel med cing //bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis dgos gal med stabs rgyal tshab las gnas dgongs zhu yong ba'i re ba 'don gnang mdzad/'on kyang bka' shag dang / drung rtsis/ se 'bras dga' gsum kyi 'thus mi bcas kyis rwa sgreng mchog nas mu mthud lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu'i re ba yang yang zhu skabs sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu phyogs skor sogs phyag las mang po'i thad srid blon glang mdun gyis 'grig min gnas tshul mang po byung lugs gsungs pas tshogs 'thus gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mis srid blon glang mdun gyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog la brtsi med byas tshul nyes pa mang po bgrangs nas srid blon glang mdun la nyes chad gtong rgyu'i bsam 'char dang gros 'go mang tsam bton/tshogs 'thus byings nas srid blon glang mdun la dmigs — 28 —

bsal nyes pa de yin med pa dang / rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku tshar brten sri da blon zur pa'i go gnas dang / gsol phogs rang 'jags 'bul rgyu'i skor bka' shag tu tshig tho spyi tham bzhi sbyar phul bas bka' blon rnams srid blon glang mdun sar bcar te thabs mkhas kyis tshogs 'du'i tshig tho rnams snyan sgron gyis srid 'gan 'jog gnang dgos pa'i blang bya bton pas de don kar kor rtsa ba nas med par yongs su zhal bzhis gnang ba red/ba/sum pa/ stag brag shog khas g.yo thabs la brten nas srid dbang blangs pa dang / btsan dga' shog kha'i stobs shugs dze cher phyin pa'i skor/gong du smos pa ltar/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes ni rgyal gces chos gces kyi bla ma skyes chen dam pa zhig yin stabs a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brang pa tshos g.yo thabs la brten nas srid dbang 'phrog rgyu'i lkog g.yo zhig bshams pa ste/ lcags 'brug ( 1940) lor/ nyin zhig ‘‘lha sar sus sbyar med pa'i yig skyur zhig thon pa'i nang don gtso bor rwa sgreng la sdom pa med — 29 da

pas rgyal ba rin po cher chos lugs kyi bslab sdom 'bul bzhes sogs byas na mi 'grig duces bkod de gang sar gleng phyogs mang tsam bzos/ der brten rgyal tshab rwa sgreng kyi dgongs par chu rta (1942)lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi par rab byung gi sdom pa 'bul bzhes gnang rgyu'i dus tshod zin par lo gcig lhag tsam las med stabs sngon tshud nas dgongs zhu g.yol thabs ma byas na chos srid gnyis kar phan thogs med pa'i klan ka yong nges red dgongs pa las de ni stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog kha'i 'char gzhi yod pa'i lkog gshom zhig yin pa rtsa ba nas ma mkhyen pa red/ der brten rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis 'phan po seng ge sgang du sdod pa'i khams rigs seng ge bla ma zer ba der rnam kun cha 'jog dang yid ches chen po gnang gi yod pas kho pa lha sar rwa sgreng bla brang gi sdod khang du ched 'bod kyis ‘‘rgyal tshab rang 'jags gnang dang / dgongs zhu gnang ba gang bzang pra phab gnang ba'i pra lung du rgyal ba rin po che'i sku phywar shin tu 'tshub pa dang / de bzhin rwa sgreng rang gi sku phywar yang 'tshub lhong che bas rgyal tshab dgongs zhu gnang ste rkyen sel bsnyen sgrub gnang na bzang ba bye 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo sa dpyad gzhi'i cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs 9par gsal/— 30 —

'dug rjo ces bshad/ gong gsal gnas tshul de'i thog nas seng ge bla ma zer ba de ni mi bden rdzun sgrig byed mkhan zhig yin pa dang / stag brag shog khas kho pa bslu brid dang ba/yo sgyu'i sbyor bar brten nas srid dbang 'phrog rtsis byed pa ni gsal por mthong thub/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng ni mes rgyal la sha zhen che ba dang chos phyogs mkhyen rgya ha cang che ba zhig yin rung chab srid 'thab rtsod kyi myong bya dman pa dang / lhag don seng ge bla ma'i g.yo gtam la thugs blos rjen 'gel gnang bar brten nor 'khrul gyi sgo nas rgyal tshab dgongs pa zhu 'dod 'gog thabs med pa zhig byung ba red/ skabs der rgyal tshab gsar pa sko phyogs skor rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang / dza zur 'jam dbyang bde legs/ smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan byams pa skal bzang / mkhar rdo sprul sku skal bzang thub bstan/ gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan sogs dang nang mol bka' bsdur gnang bas smyung gnas bla ma dang mkhar rdo sprul sku gnyis kyis kun bde gling ho thog thu sogs rgyal sprul khag dang / phur lcog yongs 'dzin su la bskos kyang skabs mtshams su rgyal tshab kyi dbang cha tshur 'bul dka' bas stag brag rin po che rgyal tshab tu bsko gzhag mdzad gsaladu/ 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo sa dpyad gagi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigasata〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs 7par — 31 —

na 'os shing 'tshams pa zheg red/ khong ni rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / thugs snang dkor ba/ dgung lo drug cu re dgur phebs pa bcas yin stabs khong srid skyong la bsko ga'/ga gnang na thugs blos rjen 'gel chog pa dang /sku'i 'gal rkyen se‘pa rjes srid dbang tshur bzhes bde ba yong tshul sogs nor 'khrul gyi bsam 'char mang tsam bshad pa dang /bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang bka' blon bon shod tshe brtan rdo rjes kyang gong gsal bzhin nor 'khrul gyi bsam 'char mang tsam zhus/ 'on kyang skabs der gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan dang / bka' gung phun khang bkra shis rdo rje/ rtsis dpon ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma tshobacas kyis slorgyal tshab dgongs zhu ma gnang bar da mur rang 'jags gnang na legs lam yong tshul dang / dbang dang bral na thams cad pham nyes yong tshul/ sku phywar 'tshub lhong yod tshe rkyen sel zlog rim gnang na legs 7zhes gnas lugs ji ltar zhus kyang gsan 'jog rtsa ba nas mi gnang zhing /lhag par du gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan gyis ‘‘stag brag rin po che zer ba'i bla ma de yang ngas bltas na thugs sems gnag mdog kha po zhig 'dug pas phyin chad srid dbang rang 'jags 'bul bzhes zer ba khag po red ces zhus pa desna la rwa sgrong rin po ches khyod nga'i rtsa ba'i bla mar d+ku ba6nga ba ge 32 —

de ni dam nyams red ces bka' brkyan yang gnang ba red/ ②ska/bas der rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal bo shes mchog gis btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brang pas g.yo thabs spel bar tshor snang rtsa ba nas ma byung ba ma zad/da dung stag brag ngag dbang gre/sung rab srid skyong la bsko gzhag gnang rgyu'i skor nang mol gnang bas stag brag shog kha'i chab srid kyi dmigs yul yongs su grub/ stag brag gis ‘‘lo gnyis gsum tsam song mtshams sring/ skyong mdzad 'khur rwa sgreng rin po ches slar ba'es gnang na de'i ring rang ngos nas hur thag zhus chog pa dang / ngos nas rwa sgyeng rin po che'i bka' drin rjes dran gyis mdzad pa'i 'phro skyong zhu rgyu/ rwa sgrong bla brang bi/ ltos bcas la phan 'gyur rogs0ram gang zab zhus chos/ ’ zer ba sogs kyi g.yo sgyu'i gta/ ma snyan mang tsam zhus/ dus der rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gis ‘‘ngas bsgrub rgyu'i las ka 'phro/ can gcig ni rtsis dpon ka shod par bka' blon bsko rgyu khaṭag len zin pas bka' blon 'pho 'gyur snga ba su byung yang nge'i las tshab tu rtsis dpon ka shod pa chos rgyal nyi ma sko gnang yod pa zhu zhi/sa gsungs pa dang / khyung ram gyi gyod gzhi khra slos / mi chog pa'i re ba 'don gnang mdzad pa bcas la stag brasartowas /gu/〈rmye ༵ kyi lo rgyukā rig sa/rnasadapyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdam bsgrigs〉〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs 8par da 33 ——

gis khas yongs su blangs/ dus mtshungs bka' blon rnams dang / drung rtsis/ gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/tshogs 'thus gnad yod khag la rwa stag bla brang gnyis kas nang mol gnang ba dang bstun nas srid skyong nang bshug gtong ba'i las don de bgegs rkyen bar chad med par legs sgrub yong ba'i nang gsed gnang ba dang / lhag par du stag brag gi phyag mdzod bstan pa mthar phyin gyis rtsis dpon ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma'i sar bcar nas ‘‘khyed la bka' blon bsko gzhag gnang rgyu de stag brag rin po che yis yongs su zhal bzhes gnang bas srid skyong dang yongs 'dzin gsar bsko gnang rgyu'i thad sku ngo rtsis dpon mchog gis tshogs 'du'i sar 'khrog langs 'gal rkyen mi yong ba'i rogs ram skyabs 'jug ci nas yod pa zhu ’ zhes zhus pas rtsis dpon ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas de don bzhin zhabs zhu gang thub nges par zhus chog ces khas len gnang ba ma zad/ stag brag rin po cher bstod pa'i bka' mol yang mang tsam gsungs/de nas lcags 'brug (1940)lo'i lo smad tsam la rgyal tshab rwa sgrong thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes mchog gis bka' shag la ‘‘de sngon ngos nas rgyal tshab srid skyong gi las gnas dgongs zhu rim pa zhus kyang bka' blon rnam pas mtshon ser skya dpon rigs dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus kyis — 34 —

rgyal tshab rang 'jags byed dgos pa'i re ba 'don gatsha/nga mdzad pa ltar da bar 'bad brtson cher skyed kyis rgyal tshab kyi las 'gan khur te gong sa mchog gi yang srid rin po che gdan zhu dang / dbu skyes gtsug phud/ dge bsnyen sdom bzhes/gser khri mnga' gsol/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba 'thus sgo tshang du btang ba sogs mdor na bod kyi bstan srid las don gang ci'i thad 'thus shor med par legs sgrub zhus yod/ 'on kyang da lam lha bla ma'i lung bstan dang phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen mang bas gnas skabs rgyal tshab las gnas dgongs zhu thog bsnyen sgrub zlog rim mi zhu thabs med la bka' shag gis de don bzhin bod ljongs tshogs 'dur bka' bsdur dgongs 'khrol ci nas yod pa zhu zhes gsungs/de nas bka' shag gis tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa skong 'tshog thog drung rtsis rnams bka' shag tu ched 'bod kyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyis rgyal tshab dgongs pa zhus te tshab tu stag brag rin po che bsko gzhag mdzad rgyu'i dgongs tshul ldog thabs med pa de tshogs 'du'i thog brgyud bsgrags mdzad/ tshogs 'dus gros mol nan tan byas mthar ‘‘rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan mu mthud bzhes rgyur bka' shag gis gsol — 35 ge

'debs gnang bar zhal bzhes ma thob kyang / bod ljongs tshogs 'dus slar yang mu mthud bstan srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes dgos pa'i re 'dun mi zhu thabs med yin zhes gros thag bcad pa'i skor drung rtsis brgyad sbrel dang / gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/ de bzhin tshogs 'thus 'ga' zhig bcas lha sa rwa sgreng bla brang gi spro khang du ngo bcar zhus te rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes la maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang mjal dar phul te drung rtsis mkhan 'thus tshang mas gus phyag 'bul bzhin rgyal ba sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen pos rgyal srid chos srid dngos su ma bzhes bar rgyal tshab rin po ches lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes gnang yong ba'i re 'bod zhu ba yang yang phul yang rgyal tshab rwa sgrong gis gsan 'jog rtsa ba nas mi gnang bar de ni lha bla ma'i lung bstan yin tshul skor mang tsam gsungs/ de'i sang nyin bka' shag nas rtse pho brang chen po po ta lar tshogs 'du mu mthud 'tshogs te gros bsdur byed dgos zhes gsungs pa dang / de nyin rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog kyang rtse pho brang du phebs stabs bka' blon rnam pa dang / drung rtsis brgyad sbrel/ gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/ dza tha'i/ tshogs 'thus mi nyung ba zhig bcas kyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis mu mthud lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes dgos pa'i re 'bod ji ltar zhus kyang — 36 ge

gsan 'jog rtsa ba nyid nas ma gnang stabs tshogs 'thus tshang mas de ni rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gi dgongs pa 'gog thabs med pa zhig rang yin pas de don mos mthun mi zhu thabs med thog/ bka' shag dang / drung rtsis brgyad sbrel/ spyi khyab mkhan po/ gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/ de min tshogs 'thus bcas kyis rtse pho brang du stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab sgobazhugs yul du bcar te bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis stag brag la srid tshab 'gan bzhes gnang dgos pa'i snyan seng zhus par stag brag rin po ches ‘‘da cha nga lo na rgas shing srid kyo nga gi 'gan dbang rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gi bka' bzhin lo ngo gnyis gsu/ma ring gang 'khyol zhus chog pa dang /dus mtshams su srid skyong gi 'gan dbang yongs rdzogs rwa sgreng rang la phyir 'bul zhus chog mi ces g.yo thabs kyis mi sgrub khas len byas/ dus der bod ljongs spyi tshogs kyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gi mdzad rjes gzengs su thon pa rnams tho bkod zhib phra mdzad thog da lam rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gi sku'i gegs rkyen bar chad sel ba'i ched du gnas skabs srid 'gan dgongs zhu gnang ste rwa sgreng dgon du bsnyen sgrub tu phebs bzhugs gnang rgyu dang / srid skyong las tshab stag brag gis byas te lo gnyis gsum tsam song mtshams rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes mchog gis rgyal tshab rang 'jags gnang rgyu'i skor gsal — 37 ge

zhing gsal ba sogs 'khod pa'i bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i tshig tho spyi dam drug sbyar 'dra bzhi bzos nas rwa sgreng dang / stag brag so sor 'dra re dang / bka' shag la 'dra gcigatshogs 'dur 'dra gcig bcas 'bul nyar byas/de nas lcags sbrul ( 1941) lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin gnam lo gsar du bzhad pa'i skabs der stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab kyis srid skyong dang yongs 'dzin bgres pa'i gsar mjal zhus te lugs gnyis kyi 'gan dngos su bzhes thog stag brag lha sar bzhugs yul kun bzang pho brang du rgyal zur rwa sgreng sku 'khor dang bcas pa gdan drangs te gsol ston gzab rgyas bshams pa ma zad/ thugs rje legs 'bul gyi dngos po yang gang legs phul ba red/ de nas yun ring ma song bar rgyal zur rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rwa sgreng dgon du phyir log mdzad skabs bka' blon rnam pa dang / gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi bla sprul/ gzhung zhabs ser skya/bod dmag dmag sgar khag gi ru sgrig dang bcas mdor na srid skyong las thog ltar rgya che gzab rgyas kyi phebs skyel zhus pa red/yin na yang bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la srid skyong stag brag la dbang cha thob ma thag rgyal zur rwa sgreng la phebs skyel tsam yang ma zhus stabs rwa sgreng bla brang gi dpon rigs gtso gras rnams 'gyod sems dang khong khro cig car du 'char bas rwa — 38 —

stag dbar gyi 'gal ba'i 'go tshugs/rwa sgreng rgyal zur dgongs zhu gnang ste rwa sgreng dgon du lo shas bzhugs ring thog mar rwa stag gnyis nang mol gnang ba ltar/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'gangs che'i las don dang las tshan sko phyogs sogs skor rgyal zur rwa sgreng la bka' 'dri dgongs skor zhu mi ched mngags btang / 'on kyang stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab lo na mtho ba dang chab srid kyi myong bya zhan par brten gser khrir 'khod nas yun ring ma song bar dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa tshos g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba mang tsam spel nas bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur stabs srid skyong stag brag kyang don dngos thog kho pa tsho'i lag cha lta bur gyur pa red/ ‘‘rwa sgreng rin po ches rgyal tshab gnang ring bod rgya'i dbar gyi 'brel ba sngar las je dam du gtong gi yod pa red/'on kyang stag brag srid skyong byas rjes dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang dbyin ji dga' nyer sten mkhan mtho rim pa nyung shas nas btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og bod 'di rlabs chen mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral du btang thog btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i mi ser spel yul du bsgyur rgyu'i re

ngan bcangs 7rjo te mes bod kha bral gtong ba'i bya ba mang posachesaku5 ngas sheste/ lcags sbrul (1941)lor ri 'gog dmag 'khrug langs nas ri pim/ gyis mtsho 'gram gru kha khag bkag 'ardoms byas stabs dbyin ji sogs mthun phyogs rgyal khab khag gis mes/ rgyal nang khul du ngamag mkho'i yo chas rogs ram byas pa rmams rgya gar mas 'bar ma'i sa cha brgyud mes rgya/la nang khul drwa pangadabor 'dren byed lam cor bas rgya gar dang / rang rgyal gnyis nas bod kyi rdza yul brgyud dmag mkho'i yo chas dbosmu ri'adren bya rgyu'i 'go lam sasar bzo byas chos pa zhes lha ri —ne ri bca' sngod rgya gar don gcod khang gi dza sas ra ye bha dur rtso/'i ribu don grub dang lha sar bca' sdod so min tang krung dbyarngarngo srid gzhung gi dom gcod khang gi khung tsing tsung gis bong shuri /gnasatshosred sazhung la gnas lugs ji ltar bshad kyang de rdotsāmimos mthun ma/ byas par dbu tshugs mtha' bkag byas 6ོre+opo / —kyang lo der a ri'i dmag don 'thab jus gsang 'azim/ sdo5chari kyi mi sna bod du dmag don brtag zhib byed par/ yong chogo si ci mos mthun byas pa red//chu rta (1942)lo'i zla 5tshes 2 2nyim khrims/ 'ga'/ byi ——palhagaḍā shābod bye kā —snye4rig gnas dbya da gagi'i myu cha ngadi mas bsgrigasko 〉〉dasi 3〉/ṅka /gluri tre4/ grang kyipre —4༵/—

sgo nas phyi rgyal las khungs btsugs te de'i 'go gtsor zur khangakyuzur pa dza sag dbang chen tshe brtan sogs bsko gzhag byas pa0ma zad/ phyi'i rgyal khag gi bod sdod don gcod khang dang /lha sar bca' sdod go min tang bod sog u yon lhan khang ge don gcod khang la slad phyin las don mtha' dag phye rgyal las khungs brgyud de bka' shag la snyan sgron zhu dgos pa las thad kar bka' shag la 'brel gtugs byed mi chog pa'i brda khyab btang bas dbyin ji dang a ri'i las don mi snas 'phral mar phyi rgyal las khungs kyi brda khyab dang len thog phan tshun 'brel ba yang yang byas shing / 'on kyang skabs der go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis gnas tshul de shes 'phral ngo sgol mtha' gcig tu byas pas dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa rnams ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su gyar/shing sprel ( 1944) lor lha sa bde skyid gli khar bca' sdod dbyin ji'i tshong don spyi khyab pa ri car san (rgya yig gi yig cha khag la li'i khra sun zhes 'khod ) dang / 'bras spyi'i las rogs me car she rab (dbyin ji'i mi yin ) gnyis kyis bka' shag la ‘‘deng skabs 'dzam gling yongs la 'gro khyab che thos ni dbyin ji'i skad yis yin pas bod kyi chab srid dang //da mab don// bzo las sogs gang ci'i thang rang rkya 'pher ba 'irga/ bye shā thab—nga/'i cheng du bod ris/sa/ phru gu myo/nga tsam zhis/ la da 4rke dge

dbyin ji'i skad yig bslabs na yag po yod pa red ces bshad/ don du de ni dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i tshab byed mi sna de gnyis kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brang pa tsho'i 'dod blo ltar bod 'di mes rgyal nas kha bral btang ste dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul du sgyur ched rkang 'dzin mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i 'thab byus rang bzhin ldan pa'i lkog g.yo zhig red/ de rjes bsam 'char de bka' shag brgyud srid skyong stag brag dang / bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyang sogs la zhus pas kho pa tshos der yongs su mos mthun byas shing / bka' shag gis kyang dbyin ji'i slob grwa 'dzugs rgyu'i zhib gsal bya thabs skor dpon rigs mngags gtong gis me car she rab dang nang mol yang yang byas pa ma zad/ dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa phyi rgyal las khungs zer ba'i 'go gtso zur khang zur pa dza sag dbang chen tshe brtan dang /las tshab rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gnyis kyis kyang bka' shag la ‘‘lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa 'dzugs rgyu 'di bzhin bod phan che bas 'phral du phyag bzhes thub pa zhig nges par gnang dgos 7zhes skul lcag thengs mang zhus pas srid skyong stag brag gis bka' phab pa'i don bzhin dbyin ji'i slob grwa 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i do dam las 'gan drung rtsis thun mong la sprad/ de nas dbyin ji'i slob grwa gsar rgyag bya yul — 42 —

klu sgug rgyud kyi gzhung gling dang sa stong du ar las 'phral tshugs bya rgyu'i gtan 'be+ebs byas/ de'i las grwa'i do dam par rtsis pa ldum ra ba bsko gzhag thog gron dngul srang nyis khri lnga stong dang / 'bru khal bdun brgya tham pa sprad pa ma zad/shod skor gzhung zhabs kyi bu phrug dang / rtse skor gyi shag tshang ngam tsha bo sogs zhabs sdod kyi dmigs sgo rnams slob grwar zhugs dgos pa'i bka' yang phab/ slob khang gsar rgyag si/ las ka 'phral du legs sgrub ma thub stabs bka' shag brgyud gser snyan sgron pa ltar/ snga 'phros drung spyi gling kha'i spro khang du slob grwa tshugs rgyu gtan 'khel byas te/ shing sprel (1944)lo'i zla 6tshes 11nyin slob grwa dngos su tshugs pa red/skabs der slob grwar zhugs mkhan gras su sku drag che 'bring chung gsum gyi bu phrug dang tsha bo sum cu lhag tsam dang / tshong pa che khag gi bu phrug bcu phrag kha shas yod pa red/dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa gso skyong byed pa'i slob grwa de dngos su btsugs rjes ‘‘bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs tshos bod shing 'brug ( 1904) lo'i dmag dus kyi khrag gi bslab bya de brjed med la/ kho tsho ni rang gi mes rgyal la dga' zhen chen po yod par brten rgyal zur rwa sgreng sogs rgyal gces mtho rim gyi ser skya mi sna khag gcig gis phan tshun nang gnas spel nas 'gog rgol skul slong byas shing / lhag par se 'bras dga' — 43 —

gsum gyis mtshon dgon sde khag gi nang chos lugs la gnod skyon 'byung gzhi'i dogs 'drog byed pa bcas mdor na lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa btsugs pa de la ngo rgol gyi sbir grags byung 7⑨ ba sogs la brten gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus tshang ma rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis ‘‘lha sar btsugs pa'i dbyin ji'i slob grwa de bzhin bod kyi bstan srid gang la'ang rtsa ba nas mi phan pa dang / ser skya mi dmangs rnams kyi 'dod blor gtan nas mi babs pas 'phral du phyir 'then yong ba zhu zhes srid skyong stag brag dang / bka' shag la re 'dun zhu skabs bka' shag gis ‘‘dbyin ji'i slob grwa de ni srid skyong stag brag gi bka' 'khrol byung thog bod gzhung dang dbyin gzhung bka' mol mdzad de btsugs pa zhig yin ’ zhes brjod/ skabs der rgyal gces ser skya dpon rigs mang po khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar nas ‘‘slob grwa 'dzugs phyogs skor bod ljongs tshogs 'dur bka' bsdur tsam yang mi gnang ba dang / ma 'ongs par bu phrug de tshos srid kyi dbang cha 'dzin skabs bstan srid la gnod skyon de bas che ba yong nges la chu la zam pa med na brgal ba las 'os med pas lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa btsugs na bod kyi bstan srid dang 'phral phugs gang la'ang gnod skyon 65pani gabloshābo/da kyi rig gnas lo sa dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs—da 44 da

che bas slob grwa 'dzugs mi 'jug thag gcod yin ’ zhes brjod pa ma zad/ lha sa'i mang tshogs kyis kyang ‘‘dag pa lha ldan gzhung la/ ma dag dbyin ji'i slob grwa/ dge rgan sna chen yog tog dge phrug grwa pa'i a lce ‘‘zhes pa'i dmangs gzhas shig brtsams pa de gang sar btang bas srid skyong stag brag dang bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs sogs btsan dga' shog khas dbyin ji'i slob grwa btsugs nas zla ba dgu tsam song rjes phyir 'then mi byed ka med byung ba red/de bzhin stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab sogs btsan dga' shog khas kho pa tsho'i stobs shugs je cher gtong ched bka' blon gnang byung pa nyes med phyir 'then gyis de'i las tshab tu zur khang dbang chen dge legs dmigs bsal gyis bsko gzhag byas pa dang / twa la'i bla ma'i sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po ser byes ngag dbang bstan 'dzin btsan shed kyis dgongs zhu byed du bcug ste las tshab tu 'jam dbyangs dkyil mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bsko gzhag byas pa/ rtsis dpon 'bri yul don med las gnas phyir 'then gyis las tshab tu zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan bsko gzhag byas/ mdo ra na gzhung zhabs ser skya dpon rigs dang gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus nang gi rgyal zur rwa sgreng dang /krung dbyang srid gzhung la lhag bsam dkar ba'i rgyal gces — 45ri—

stobs shugs la 'khon 'dzin dang rdung deg tshabs chen btang bar brten kha bral dang kha bral la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de sngar bas mngon gsal dod pa dang dza drag che bar gyur/skabs der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang de don dngos thog stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab dang / stag brag dza sag bstan pa mthar phyin/ bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs kha bral ring lugs pa nyung shas kyi lag tu bzung ste mu mthud mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la gtor bshig gtong ba'i spyod ngan mang tsam spel ba red/bzhi pa/ rwa stag dbar srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de mngon gsal dod pa dang /rno ngar che ba/ dza drag che ba bcas su gyur pa'i skon/rwa sgreng dang stag brag dbar de sngon nang mol gnang ba ltar lo gnyis gsum tsam song mtshams srid skyong gi 'gan dbang phyir 'bul gnang rgyu'i kha dan gyi dus tshod snga sa nas zin rung / srid skyong stag brag shog khas 'gan dbang phyir 'bul zhu bzo gang yang med stabs rgyal zur rwa sgreng thub bstan — 46 —

'jam dpal ye shes mchog gis go skabs shig dang bstun nas lha sar ngo phebs thog stag brag dang nang mol zhib gsal gnang dgos dgongs shing / shing sprel ( 1944) lo'i zla 1tshes 2nyin rtse pho brang du zan ril phul bar gzhigs na/ tā la'i bla ma'i sku phywar gegs bar che ba yod lugs phebs stabs gong sa mchog la brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu gtan 'khel zin pa'i gsang gnas de rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog gis mkhyen rjes da res lha sar ngo phebs gnang thub pa'i go skabs bzang po zhig byung song dgongs te/ rwa sgreng mchog la lhag bsam dkar ba'i 'brel yod dpon rigs la phyag bris gnang ste/ ‘‘da lam 'di nas bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang / bka' blon phun khang / mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan/ 'bras sngags mkhan zur ngag dbang mkhas mchog sgo mang mkhan po chos 'phel rgyal po/ se ra stod pa mkhan po rgyal mtshan seng ge/ ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho bcas so sor phyag bris ched gnang gis bka' mngags gnang yod cing / gtso bo bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang / mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan gnyis nas dam don gnang rgyur khyed nas ser byes mkhan por gros bsdur dang 'brel gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po dang /las sne gnad yod khag la gsang ba'i sgo nas thabs shes brgyud — 47 —

bsku9ra gyis rgyal ba rin po cher brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul bar rwa sgreng lha sar gdan 'dren zhu dgos zhes gdan sa gsu/ma nas bka' shag tu slan seng gis gdan zhu thub pa zhig byed dgos zhes gsungs 7⑫ pa ltar dpon rigs tshos gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus khag so sor 'brel gtugs byas nas phan tshun gzhogs 'degs gnang dgos pa'i nang mol gnang ba dang / lhag par ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtshos gtso bo'i 'gan khur te gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po dang 'brel yod las sne rnams dang gsang ba'i gros mol byed skabs mkhan po dang 'brelaXyod las sne mang che bas rgyal zur rwa sgyeng gi bka' dang len zhus te/ shing sprel (1944)lo'i zla 2pa'i nang lha sar tshogs mchod 'tshog skabs gdan sa'i mkhan po khag gis gsang ba'i gros mol thog rgong sa mchog la brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul bar rwa sgreng rin po che lha sar gdan zhu dgos pa'i re 'dun thun mong nas bka' shag tu snyan seng zhu rgyu byas/ de rjes zla 2pa'i nang gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po rnams bka' shag tu ngo bskyod kyis las don gal 'gangs che ba zhig snyan seng zhu rgyu yod pas 'phral du tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms 'tshog rgyu'i re ba zhus pa'i lan du bka' shag gsal⑪/ 〈〈bod spyi rigaganagalo rgyu dbyadagagi'i cha bdamaspobasgrigs〉〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs snye1la — 48 —

gis snga 'phros tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms 'tshog dgos don med kyang / bka' shag nas drung rtsis lhan rgyas 'phral du tshogs 'du 'tshog rgyu'i mo sa mthun byas te gnad don che rigs 0nga yod sngon du drung rtsis lhan rgyas sar zhu 'thus tshas pa zhis brjo da/ nyin shas song mtshams lha sa bla brang steng gi gzim chung zur 'phyong du drung rtsis lhan rgyas chogs 'du 'tshogs pa0dang / ser 'bras kyi mkhan po las zur tshang ma dang dgaljori ldan gyi 'thus mi bcas kyang ngo bcar mnyam 'dzoms zhus rkya/yo+ogs 'du'i thog gdan sa'i mkhan 'thus tshos gnad do na gal che zhig/ snyan seng zhu dbo/sa stabs kha sngon bka' shag kharī/ gser snyam/ sgron pa ltar/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas/ 0'dzoms 'phral du skong 'tshos/ yong ba'i re 'dun zhus kyang mkhan drung tā bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen gyis ‘‘gnangari don gal che gsung 'os gang yod gsal por gsungs na nga tshos5 bka' shag tu snyan seng zhus chog pa zhes gsungs par /'bras spungs sngags pa'i mkham/ zur ngag dbang mkhas mcho0/ dang / ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtshos gtso bor byanu༈ pa'i gdan sa se 'bras gnyis kyi mkhan po las zur dang gle dga' ldan 'thus mi bcas kyis gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyiṭa/ ‘‘rwa sgreng rin po che ni bla ma skyes chen dam pa ga/zhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yim/ pas song sa mchog/ sku phywar ngan dogs yod pas da 49 da

brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan zhu bar rwa sgreng rin po che gdan zhu gnang dgos ’ zhes bsam 'char mang tsam zhus/ skabs der ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus tsho'i re 'dun —rnams drung tsis brgyud bka' shag tu snyan seng zhu skabs bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la de snga rgyal zur rwa sgreng dang bla brang gi drin gyis bskyangs te 'tsho ba'i bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis glo bur du khong khro chen po'i rnam 'gyur bstan te ‘‘gong sa skyabs mgon chen por brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu'i thad 'di gar srid skyong stag brag rin po che sku zil pa khrom mer bzhugs yod pa ma red dam/ de 'dra yin bzhin du rgyal zur rwa sgrong rin po che lha sar gdan zhu bya rgyu ni la cha'i sgang la spags thel rgyag dgos don yod pa ma red/ lar nas ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po tsho chos 'chad nyan dang /bslab pa slob gnyer gnang nas bzhugs tshugs na dga' yi ma red pas ⑪ zhes brjod bzhin og tshom byil byil btang /dus der sa dbang bon shod tshe brtan rdo rje dang / zur khang dbang chen dge legs gnyis kyis bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyi skad char rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu byas/dus der bka' blon phun khang bkra shis rdo rjes ‘‘srid skyong stag gsalayi/ 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dbyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigasata〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs 25la — 50 —

brag rin po che sku zil pa khrom mer bzhugs yod rung / la cha'i sgang la spags thel zer ba de 'dra gang nas yin/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che nas gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i yang srid gdan zhu dang / dbu skyes gtsug phud 'bul bzhes sogs gnang ba ma red dam/ 'di skor gang dga' bka' mol gnang rogs ’ zhes rwa sgreng la phyogs pa'i skad cha bshad kyang mthar bya thabs dben pa'i gnas su gyur/ skabs der gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus tshang ma phyir 'then shor nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng lha sar gdan zhu bya rgyu'i skad cha bskyar du shod mi nus par phyir log byed dgos byung ba red/ de nas nyin shas song rjes rwa sgreng gi ltos phyogs 'bras spungs sgo mang mkhan po chos 'phel rgyal po dang / 'bras spungs sngags pa'i mkhan zur ngag dbang mkhas mchog se ra stod pa mkhan po rgyal mchu+on seng ge bcas so so'i sdod shag gi sgo phyir 'gro mi chog pa ma zad/ mi gzhan dang thug 'phrad kyang byed mi chog pa'i bkod rgya btang ste bzang btson du bcugadus der rwa sgreng ltos phyogaru/ dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis gong gsal gnas tshul rnams rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog la zhu yig dang gser snyan sgron te stag brag shog khas srid dbang 'bul bzo rtsa ba nas med pa ma zad/ rwa sgreng gi thugs blos 'gel sa dpon rigs gtso gras bka' blon bla ma bstan pa — 51 —

'jam dbyangs sogs kyi rnam 'gyur skor yang zhus te gnas skabs lha sar ma phebs na legs pa yong tshul skor ji ltar zhus kyang rwa sgreng rin po ches gsan 'jog rtsa ba nas mi gnang ba red/ gang yin zer na/ rwa sgrong ltos phyogs kyi dpon rigs mang po zhig gis rgyal zur rwa sgreng lha sar ngo phebs gnang ste sngon tshud zhal dan gnang ba bzhin srid 'gan tshur bzhes dgos zhes skul ma zhus pa dang / rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog gi dgongs pa la'ang stag brag dang rang nyid bla slob kyi 'brel ba che bas zhal dan tshig la gnas te srid dbang tshur gnang nges red snyam pa'i re stong zhig 'char/ des na khong gis thabs lam gzhan zhig 'tshal ba ste/ ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang nang mol gnang ste phyi rgyar ser0byes grwa tshang gi 'du khang nyams gso legs sgrub zin pa'i rab gnas mdzad par rgyal zur rwa sgrong gdan zhu byas pa zhal bzhes thob tshul dang / don du srid skyong 'gan dbang rtsis 'bul yong re'i ched du byang rwa sgreng dgon nas lha sar phebs/ skabs der lha sa'i shar ngos smon grong zam pa'i 'gor sa gnas srid gzhung gi ser skya dpon rigs dang / dgon khag gi bla sprul/gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus sogs kyis bsu ba gzab rgyas zhus pa red/de nas nyin shas song mtshams rwa sgreng rin po che rtse pho — 52 —

brang chen po po ta lar tā la'i bla ma dang / srid skyong stag brag lhan 'dzoms sar 'byor phyag zhus thog mdzad sgo grol ba'i rjes su srid skyong stag brag gi gzim chung du zur mjal zhu gnang mdzad de ‘‘da lam rkyen sel dang bar chad zlog rim sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub zhabs brtan legs sgrub zin te lha sar bcar ba yin/ stag brag rin po che sku na shin tu mtho bas (de dus stag brag lo 72la slebs yod )mu mthud srid 'gan bzhes na sku ngal che ba yong snyam nas da res ched mngags 'dir bcar ba yin ’ zhes gsung skabs stag brag gis go yang ma go mdog gis rna cog gnyis ka lag pas bskyor te/ la la zhes ma go ba'i rnam 'gyur kho na bstan nas de snga kha dan bzhag pa bzhin srid 'gan tshur 'bul rgyu phar bzhag rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi bka' mol la yang ya lan de tsam mi byed pa'i rnam 'gyur ngan pa bstan stabs don dngos des rgyal zur rwa sgreng la bslab bya gting zab cig thob ste ‘‘stag brag rin po ches zhal dan tshig la mi gnas pa 'di 'dra gnang yong bsams pa nyal ba'i mi lam la'ang ma byung ’ zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang kho pa tshos rgyal zur rwa sgreng lha sar zla gcig tsam bzhugs ring sku drag su zhig dang 'brel ba byed min lkog tu lta rtog byed mkhan btang bas rwa sgreng ltos phyogs kyi sku drag mang po zhig gis mngon gsal dod pos 'brel gtugs zhu ma nus stabs rgyal zur rwa — 53 —

sgreng sar bcar mkhan shin tu dkon par gyur/ de nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng gis phyir log gnang rgyu'i thon phyag dang chabs cig tā la'i bla ma mchog la brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan phul thog thugs pham shin tu che ba'i ngang byang rwa sgreng dgon du phyir log mi gnang ka med byung ba red/de rjes nyin zhig rwa stag 'gal ba byung rkyen skor gleng skabs rgyal zur rwa sgreng gis thugs sems skyo ba'i ngang ‘‘stag brag dang nga gnyis bla slob gyi 'du shes yag po yod pa ma zad/stag brag bla brang skyo po yin stabs ngas stag brag la 'tsho skyong byed ched re zhig nga rang bod kyi rgyal tshab dgongs pa zhus te rgyal tshab gsar pa stag brag nas gnang rgyu dang / lo kha shas song mtshams rgyal tshab kyi las 'gan nga la phyir sprod gnang rgyu nang ma'i kha dan byas pa yin/ 'on kyang stag brag gis nga la rgyal tshab phyir sprod bya rgyu phar bzhag rwa sgreng bla brang la 'khon 'dzin gnod 'tshe kho na byas byung / der brten nga gnyis 'gal zlar gyur pa red/ bka' shag dang / yig tshang gi gtso bo tshos mtshon pa'i stag brag gi rjes 'brang sku drag tshos rwa blar gnod 'tshe gang thub byed kyi 'dug ⑪ ces gsungs/skabs der stag brag shog khas srid dbang tshur 'bul rgyu phar 1159 gsanābo/da kyi rig gnas lo sa dbyad gzhi'i cha bdams bsgrigasata〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs—— 54 —

bzhag de las ldog ste rwa sgreng bla brang gi dpon rigs tshor gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis gnod 'tshe shugs chen btang ba ma zad/ rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi sku srog la'ang nyen kha ha cang chen po byung bar brten rwa sgreng bla brang gi ltos phyogs kyis 'khon lan bslogs te srid dbang tshur len thabs byed pa'i dza drag che la/ rno ngar che ba'i 'thab rtsod byed 'go tshugs/skabs der 'brel yod kyi don rkyen gzhan zhig byung ste rwa stag dbar gyi 'gal ba de bas dza drag che bar gyur/ de yang shing sprel ( 1944) lo'i ston khar ser byes grwa tshang dang / se ra sngags pa grwa tshang gnyis kyi grwa pa brgyad 'phan po lhun grub rdzong khongs su 'bru bun 'ded par skyod skabs rdzong de'i mnga' 'og mi ser gyis ‘‘grwa pas 'bru bun tsha 'ded gtong yi/ 'dug ces rdzong dpon la zhus/ skabs de'i 'phan po lhun grub rdzong gi rdzong dpon tshul khrims ni 'bum thang drung yig che mo ba chos 'phel thub bstan gyi spun mched rgan pa yin stabs kho pas spun mched ltag ngoms kyis ‘‘'bru bun sprod mi dgos zhes brjod/der brten 'bru bun 'ded pa ser byes grwa tshang gi grwa pa bdun dang ser sngags grwa tshang gi grwa pa gcig gis rdzong dpon sar phyin te phan tshun kha rtsod brgyab mthar grwa pas rdzong dpon la nyes brdung btang bas rdzong dpon rkyen lam du shor/ gnas tshul de drung yig che mo ba chos 'phel thub bstan gyis shes — 55 —

'phral bod sa gnas srid gzhung la zhu tho phul te byed gte 'phral du rtsis sprod yong ba'i re 'dun bton pa ltar/ sa gnas srid gzhung gis ser byes grwa tshang la byed gte 'phral du rtsis sprod dgos pa'i bka' phab/ 'on kyang ser byes grwa tshang dang sngags pa grwa tshang gnyis kyis ‘‘'bru bun skyed gtong ni dge 'dun dmangs kyi gtong rtsa yin pas grwa pa rtsis sprod zhu mi dgos par bka' nyes gang gnang sgrub 'bul zhus chog pa ’’zhes ji ltar zhus kyang zhib dpyod dpon rigs tshos nyan 'jog rtsa ba nas ma byas par ‘‘byed gte rtsis sprod byed dgos ’ zhes dbu tshugs mtha' skyel byas/ stag brag dang de'i ltos phyogs kyis ser byes grwa tshang la 'khon 'dzin 'di ltar byed pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni ser byes grwa tshang 'di rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi thob khungs dgon pa zhig yin stabs kho pa tshos go skabs de dang bstun nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi ltos phyogs la rdung rdeg gtong dgos bsams pa de red/ de nas byed gte rtsis sprod min skor zhag 'phul nyin 'gyangs su song nas shing bya (1945)lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam che mo 'tshog pa'i dus la slebs dus se ra byes sngags gnyis kyi mkhan po dang / bla sprul/ grwa dmangs bcas kyis dus thog tu lte ldan smon lam che mor ma phebs stabs ser smad grwa tshang gi mkhan 'thus dang / rwa sgreng bla brang / phur lcog bla brang / se ra dgon pa'i thob khungs sdi 56 —
