sbyin bdag tshong rigs sogs kyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang se ra byes sngags grwa tshang dbar bar gsed zhus pa brgyud gong gsal don rkyen skor zhib rtsad nyes chad med par lha ldan smon lam che mor zhugs chog pa'i bka' dpyad gnang / don du srid skyong stag brag dang yig tshang gi dbang 'dzin pa tshos gsang ba'i ngan gros kyis nor gling mjal kha'i go skabs dang bstun nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi ltos phyogs ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho 'dzin bzung bya rgyu byas/ gsang ba'i ngan gros byas pa'i nang don de rwa sgreng ltos phyogs kyi dpon rigs kyis shes 'phral ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtshor gsang brda bskyal bas mkhan po ngo 'khor bzhi khams phyogs su bros byol du phyin/ srid skyong stag brag sogs kyis gnas tshul de shes rjes khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar te a drung rta shad ched gtong gis mdo spyi dza sag la mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho ngo 'khor bcas pa bsad bzung gang thub byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ mkhan po ngo 'khor bcas pa bros byol 'gro ba'i lam bar du mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho'i spun mched phyag mdzod 'phrin las bsad pa dang / mkhan po dang gsol dpon pad ma rdo rje sogs bros thar/ de rjes stag brag shog kha ngo tsha kha skyengs kyis khong khro chen po langs te kha dan tshig la mi gnas par se ra'i grwa pa dbre phe rgya bo dang / 'bru gnyer zla ba sogs — 57 —

grwa pa nyi shu skor 'dzin bzung byas te nyes chad drag po btang thog rdzong khag la rgyang 'bud btang ba bcas la brten rwa stag dbar gyi 'gal ba sngar bas ches cher phyin pa red/skabs der rgyal zur rwa sgreng ltos phyogs kyi bla sprul dang dpon rigs tshos thabs byus mang po bton nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po che phyi tshul du bkra shis lhun po sogs gtsang gnas su phebs rgyur khag btags te rgya gar brgyud go min tang gi rgyal sa nan cing du phebs rgyu gtan 'khel zin yang gsang ba phyir gyar bas phebs mi thub/ de rjes smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan byams pa skal bzang gis byed thabs don tshan gsum bton gnang ba ste/ ‘‘gcig go min tang srid gzhung gi thugs 'dod bzhin stag brag rin po cher de snga gtan 'khel zin pa'i gros mol ltar rgyal tshab rwa sgreng la rang 'jags sprod rgyu bka' phab dgos pa'i re ba zhu rgyu/ gnyis/ go min tang srid gzhung nas dngul sgor 'bum tsho gnyis g.yar po zhus te lha sar 'gangs che'i sku drag khag la nang bcar gyis las don 'grub thabs byed dartso/sa/ gsum/ de ltar ma grub tshe go min tang la skyabs bcol gyis dmag dpung dang / gnam gru gtong gnang yong ba'i re ba bton te btsan po'i thabs kyis srid skyong yong thabs byed dgos ’ zhes gsungs/ skabs der rgyal zur rwa sgreng gis lha sar bca' sdod go min tang gi — 58 —

gsang ba'i las ka byed mkhan rgya rigs ho khor phrug sogs la 'brel gtugs gnang nas nga dang stag brag dbar bla slob kyi 'brel ba che bas rang nyid rkyen sel bsnyen sgrub byed ring srid skyong stag brag la bsko gzhag thog bsnyen sgrub tshar rjes srid skyong gi 'gan dbang phyir 'bul bya rgyu'i nang mol yod kyang / da lam kha dan tshig la mi gnas pa dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas rgya bod mthun lam la gnod pa'i phyag las mang po gnang dang gnang bzhin yod stabs/bod 'di yang btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i dbang 'og tu 'gro nyen shin tu che bas srid skyong 'gan dbang phyir 'bul zhu dgos pa'i skor go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bka' phab dgos pa'i re 'dun zhu 'bod gnang bar brten go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis lha sar bca' sdod don gcod khang brgyud rgyal zur rwa sgreng la go min tā hud kyi u yon du bsko gzhag zin pas tshogs 'dur ngo phebs gnang dgos pa'i bka' phab/ rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog tshogs 'dur ngo phebs thog bde sdug yong rkyen rnams thad kar snyan sgron zhu 'dod shin tu che yang skabs der srid dbang stag brag shog khas bzung stabs sku sger gyi mtshan thog nas phebs thabs bral bar brten rwa sgreng sku thog na rim gyi mchod yon sbyin bdag rnying khongs dkar mdzes tre+e hor brgya dpon tshang gi bu don grub rnam rgyal — 59 ge

dang / a thub la dkar tshang gi bu mthu stobs gnyis dkar mjos khul gyi 'thus mi'i ming thog nas rgyal 'bangs tshogs chen du zhugs mkhan yin pa'i nang gnas mkhyen/ lhag par du brgya dpon tshang gi bu don grub rnam rgyal skabs der lha sar yod pa dang / mar lam byang rwa sgrong dgon du rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po che mjal bar bcar skabs ‘‘thengs 'dir tshogs 'dur bcar mi thub pas khyed gnyis nagatshab gnang ste de snga bod don skor krung dbyang srid gzhung la snyan seng rab dang rim pa zhus kyang da bar don smin gsol ba ma byung bas de don snyan seng gzab nan yong ba 7zhes bka' mngags gnang ba dang /de bzhin la dkar bu mthu stobs la'ang gong gsal don bzhin mngags cha gnang ba'i phyag bris gcig bskur gnang mdzad/dus der lha sar rwa stag shog kha'i dbar gyi 'thab rtsod de ha cang rno ngar che ba'i gnas su gyur pa ste/ stag brag shog khas phyi rgyal btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas rgyal gces stobs shugs la gnod 'tshe gcig mjug gnyis mthud btang stabs rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang / smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan byams pa skal bzang /mkhar rdo bla ma skal bzang thub bstan sogs kyis bya thabs sna tshogs spel nas 'khon lan slog rtsis byas/ gnas tshul de rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog gis mkhyen 'phral snga rjes su phyag bris — 60 —

thengs mang gnang ste ‘‘mi byed dgu byed byas na da lta'i gnas babs 'di la'ang mi gnas pa yong gi red/ nga tshos go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la skyabs bcol te zhi ba'i thabs lam la brten nas srid dbang tshur len thabs byed dgos 7zhes bslab bya gang legs gnang yang khong tshos nyan 'jog ma byas par gsang ba'i gros mol byas te smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan byams pa skal bzang gis stag brag dza sag bstan pa mthar phyin brgyud srid skyong stag brag la lag 'bom 'bul rgyu'i bsam gros bton/ ‘‘skabs der nga tsho sus kyang lag 'bom gyi nus pa gang 'dra yod med shes kyi med kyang / khong nyid (smyung gnas bla mar zer ) phyi sog tu bzhugs yun ring bas mtshon cha sogs 'phrul 'khor rigs kyi nus pa dang / legos nyes sogs mkhyen pas ma tshad nyams gso yang gang 'tshams gnang gi yod par brtem stag brag rin po cher lag 'bom bskyel rgyur nga tsho mos mthun byung ste dza sag gi drung du lag 'bom skyel bar rwa bla'i zhabs phyi 'phan po lcang ra shar pa'i chos mdzad bstan 'dzin dang / khams brgya dpon tshang gi g.yog po blo bzang rnam rgyal gnyis btang bar khong gnyis nas dza sag gi 'gram du mi mang zhing / las ka zhig byed pa dang dus mtshungs te nang du 'dzul phod ma byung zhes phyir log slebs — 61 —

byung zha de nas rwa sgrong dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang /smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan byams pa skal bzang sogs nang gros byed skabs rwa sgreng dza sag sogs kyis ‘‘rgya 'bum sgang drung yig che mo ngag dbang rnam rgyal sar lag 'bom skyel bar gtong dgos zhes brjod skabs/ smyung gnas bla mas der mos mthun rtsa ba nas ma byas par ‘‘srid skyong gi dbang cha 'dzin mkhan stag brag red ma gtogs rgya 'bum sgang gi drung yig che mo ma red 7ces lan btab/ de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan byams pa skal bzang dang rgya 'bum sgang drung yin che mo ngag dbang rnam rgyal gnyis phan tshun 'brel ba gting zab po yod pas red/ de rjes smyung gnas bla mas ‘‘nga rang ngos nas bshad na rgya 'bum sgang drung yig che mo bka' drin ha cang chen po yin/ tshe smon gling gi 'bo kha ba 'di bzhin phran la gsol ras gnang ba de gcig pu'i thog nas zla rer yong 'bab 'bru khal nyi shu rtsa lnga nas ma chag pa yong gi 'dug ’ ces brjod pa red/ skabs der rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan sogs kyis 4o rog mi bzhag lha 'dre dang / 'jag ma mi bzhag rlung po zer ba'i dpe ltar srid skyong stag brag rin po che bzhugs su mi 'jug mkhan gyi byed 9༷padzi gasgoshābo/da kyi rig gnas lo sa dpyad gzhi'i bdams bsgrigasanyi〉deb 8pa'i shog grangs—— 62 —

gte gtso bo stag brag dza sag bstan pa mthar phyin dang / rgya 'bum sgang drung yig che mo ngag dbang rnam rgyal red ’ ces brjod de smyung gnas bla ma'i bsam gros la ma nyan par chos mdzad bstan 'dzin dang brgya dpon tshang gi g.yog po blo bzang rnam rgyal gnyis lag 'bom skyel bar btang yang rgya 'bum sgang drung yig che mor sngon nas gsang brda 'byor stabs lag 'bom blugarngashrī pa'i sgam chung de shod khang stong pa zhig nang kha phye bas khang pa'i rtsig par skyon phran bu byung ba las mi su zhig la'ang rmas skyon gang yang ma byung ba red/ des na rgya 'bum sgang drung yig che mos gong gsal gnas tshul yong rkyen rnams bka' shag tu zhib gsal snyan seng zhus pa ma zad/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / stag brag dza sag bstan pa mthar phyin/drung yig che mo ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rjes 'brang pa tsho mtshan mo lkog tu mnyam 'dzoms thog ngan gros bshams nas rgyal gces stobs shugs med pa bzo rgyu'i thabs byus rab dang rim pa bting pa red/

lnga pa/ rgyal gces stobs shugs la pham nyes tshabs chen phog pa'i skor/skabs der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab ri car san gyis shog sbubs rlung 'tshang gis bka' shag sogs sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'brel yod las khungs gang la'ang 'brel gtugs ma byas par thad kar srid skyong stag brag la ‘‘rwa sgreng gis tre hor brgya dpon bu don rnam dang la dkar bu mthu stobs gnyis nan cing du btang ste go ming tā hud thog bod kyi tshogs 'thus rwa sgreng gi ngo tshab mngags cha byas stabs kho pa gnyis bod kyi 'thus mi dza sag gnyis las kyang mthong che ba yod pa dang / lhag par tshogs 'du grol rjes kho gnyis phyir log ma byas par nan cing du bsdad de rwa sgreng gis go ming tang srid gzhung la bod rang btsan min par rgya khongs yin pa'i khas len byas 'dug pa ma zad/ bod du rgya dmag gtong cedagos pa dang / go mtshon dang / dngul khyon che bcas kyi rogs ram dgos lugs bshad pa dang / go ming tang srid gzhung nas kyang bod kyi srid skyong rwa sgreng gis rang 'jags byed dgos pa'i bka' phab kyi yod pa dang / bod du rgya dmag — 64 —

khyon che gtong gtan 'khel bas mi tshad/ gnam gru mang po btang ste lha sar 'bom g.yug gtan 'khel tshul sogs ha lam sang gnangs dbar dus 'gyur yong gi yod pa lta bu'i nyen kha ha cang chen po zhig bskul ba ma zad/ go min tang gis tre+e hor brgya dpon bur me mda' dang / dngul mang po zhig sprad lugs dang / rwa sgreng dang bkras bla ngan mthun gyis se rar dmag gi rten gzhi byas te lha sar rwa sgreng bla brang dang / rwa bla'i ltos phyogs nas zing 'khrug slong rgyu/ bkras lhun du dmag gi rten gzhi byas te gzhis rtser bkras blas zing 'khrug slong rtsis yod lugs sogs deng skabs bod don skor gal che dza drag gi skad cha mang tsam yod tshul sogs mi⑫gsang gnas yin khul gyis bshad/ skabs der srid skyong stag brag gis ri car san gyi gtam 'chal de bden par brtsis pa ma zad/ dngangs skrag dang 'khon 'dzin cig car du 'char te bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma/ lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje bcas la ‘‘gong gsal gnad don de gal 'gangs ha cang che ba'i srid don zhig yin pas bka' blon rnams kyis gsang ba nan tan gnang dgos pa las tshig zur tsam yang phyir gsal⑫/ 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo sadapyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigasanyi〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs 41la — 65 —

mi gyar ba byed dgos ’ zhes brjod/ de nas bka' blon rnams kyis stag brag gi bkod mngags ltar/ nan cing don gcod mkhan mgron lo gsum ste mkhan chung thub bstan bzang po dang / rtse mgron thub bstan tshe ring / lo tsā ba byams pa ngag dbang bcas la gsang ba'i tar yig btang ste ‘‘deng sang bod don skor gal che dza drag gi gnas tshul yod 'dug pas khyed tshos thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas myang zhib gzab nan thog 'phral du tar lan gtong dgos ’ zhes bkod brda btang /de rjes dbyin gzhung las tshab ri car san gyis dza sag zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan dang / dza sag sne'u shag thub bstan thar pa brgyud brjod gsal/ ‘‘kha sngon rgyal zur rwa sgreng gis rgya gar khul du gnas mjal zhig tu phebs rgyur rogs ram byed rogs gsungs byung bar/ nga tshos khyed rang ni gzhan dang mi 'dra ba bod kyi rgyal zur yin gshis/ thog mar bka' shag la snyan seng gnang rogs zhus par brten da bar rgya gar du phebs ma thub pa las/ rgya gar du phebs thub pa yin na nang do na rgya nag du phebs rtsis yin 'dra zhing / da cha rgyal zur rwa sgreng byang lam brgyud rgya nag tu phebs rtsis med dam snyam pas gnas tshul de dag phyi rgyal las khungs nas bka' shag tu snyan seng zhu dgos gsungs byung ba ma zad/ skad cha 'di phyi gyar med pa'i gsang ba dam po gnang dgos nan tan — 66 —

gyis zer lugs sogs kyang bshad song /’⑫ gzhan yang dbyin gzhung las tshab ri car san gyis go min tang gi dmag dpung byang lam brgyud slebs zin pa dang / mu mthud lha sa phyogs su dpung skyod byed bzhin yod pas srid skyong stag brag gi sku srog la nyen kha ha cang chen po yod lugs sogs dkros/ gtam mang po thabs lam sna tshogs brgyud nas gang sar bkram/de'i dmigs yul ni rgyal zur rwa sgreng 'phral du lha sar bskongs nas bkrong rtsis yod pa gsal po red/me phag (1947)lo'i zla 2tshes 22nyin gyi snga dro bka' shag la nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi don gcod khang gi tar yig cig 'byor gsal du/ ‘‘rwa sgreng gi ngo tshab tro hor brgya dpon bu don rnam dang / la dkar bu mthu stobs gnyis kyis go min tang srid gzhung la bod du drag dpung dang / drag chas kyi rgyab gnon/ gnam gru sogs dgos lugs bshad par/ 'di'i skor cang ce hres nyin lnga tshun lan gsal sprod rgyu byas 'dug pa de lugs mdzad phyogs yod pa zhes 'khod ⑫yod pa red/ skabs der bka' shag gis nan cing don gcod mkhan chung thub bstan bzang po dang / rtse mgron thub gsalazha 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs 42la gsal / 〈bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gagi'i cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs ji2la — 67 d+ngha

bstan tshe ring / lo tsā ba byams pa ngag dbang bcas la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgo nas myang zhib byed dgos zhes bkod mngags byas pa ltar/ kho pa tshos tre hor brgya dpon bu don rnam dang / la dkar bu mthu stobs gnyis 'jam thabs kyis bslu brid byas te nang gnas 'ga' zhig 'dri skabs kho pa gnyis chab srid 'thab rtsod kyi myong bya zhan par brten gsang gnas kyi tshig zur 'ba' zhig kha nas shor bas mtha' ma rgyal zur rwa sgreng sku srog shor ba'i ngan 'bras de lta bu zhig byung ba red/phyis rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkrongs pa sogs kyi gnas tshul de la dkar bu mthu stobs kyis thos rjes khrag rlung langs te nan cing du tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs pa dang / tre hor brgya dpon bu don rnam yang gnong 'gyod ha cang chen po byung ba red/skabs der btsan dga' shog kha dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab ri car san sogs khyi spyang lag sbrel gyis gros ngan gshom skabs bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis ‘‘gnas tshul der gzhigs na nye sngon lha sdod dbyin gzhung sku tshab ri car san gyis nang gnas gsal po gsungs pa ma gtogs mgo rul rna bas mi tshor ba'i dpe ltar las ka gang min zhig yong gtan 'khel ba red/ der brten da res kyi gnas tshul ni lag pa 'gyog snga ting las thabs skegazhan med/ de las sngon la rwa sgreng lha sar gdan zhu thub pa — 68 —

bya rgyu de dgos gal che ’ zhes bshad/ dus der bka' blon gzhan gyis kyang bka' shag dang spyi khyab mkhan po sogs ser skya dpon rigs gtso gras rnams rdog rtsa gcig sgril byed dgos lugs skor bsam gros bton pa ma zad/ bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyi bsam 'char la yang yongs su mos mthun byas/ de rjes rgyal zur rwa sgreng lha sar bskong rgyu'i skor srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab la dgongs skor snyan seng zhu bar song bas srid skyong stag brag thugs ngar skyes pa'am yang na zhed snang blo pham byung ba ji yin ma shes kyang / skabs der snyan seng zhus 'phral ‘‘zhal ras dmar por gyur thog spyan gnyis ka mchi mas khengs shing / gsung 'dar skad dang / ljags dbugs kyang hal pa'i ngang nas rwa sgreng lha sar 'phral du gdan zhu thub pa zhig nges par gnang dgos zhes mos mthun gnang / ⑪ bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen gyis gdan zhu spyi khyab tu bka' blon gcig 'gro dgos nges la mi 'gro su 'os bsko gzhag yod pa zhu skabs bka' blon zur khang 'gro dgos zhes gsungs/ de'i thog nas zur khang dbang chen dge legs ni srid skyong stag brag gi blos 'khel shos kyi mi zhig yin pa gsal por mthong thub/ de 'phral bka' gsal⑪/ 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dasbyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 6pa'i zhog grangs 45la — 69 —

blon zur khang gis nga la las rogs bka' blon zhig dgos lugs zhus par de'i lan du bka' blon lha klu phebs dgos zhes gsu/ngas pa red/de nyin srid skyong stag brag dang / bka' blon/ spyi khyab mkhan po bcas nang mol byas pa'i snying por thengs 'di'i bya ba ni ha cang gal 'gangs che ba zhig yin stabs bka' shag dang / spyi khyab mkhan pos gtso 'gan 'khur dgos pa dang /zhib cha'i 'gan drung rtsis brgyad sbrel gyis 'khur dgos pa ma zad/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i thog ri car san gyis nang gtam gsang gnas bshad lugs skor rtsa ba nas shod mi chog pa dang / rwa sgreng bla brang dang / mkhar rdo bla brang / smyung gnas bla ma'i shag yab gzhis phun khang / sa 'du tshang bcas la sgo thel rgyag rgyu dang do bdag ngo ma rnams 'dzin bzung bya rgyu'i gtan 'khel yang byas/bka' blon zur lha gnyis rgyal zur rwa sgreng 'dzin bzung byed mkhan gyi spyi khyab tu bsko gzhag byas rjes gsang brda phyi la gyar nas kho pa tsho'i sdig nyes kyi dmigs yul de 'grub mi yong snyam te gsang ba'i sgo nas bka' blon zur lha gnyis kyi bzhon rta ji yod ngo las tshang mas rang rta rang bzhon byas pa ma zad/nor bu gling kha dang / zhol chibs ra mdo sbug de bzhin bka' blon ram pa dang / spyi khyab mkhan po sogs kyi rta drel — 70 —

go 'aper ba rnams kyang bsdu rub kyis grwa bzhi dmag sgar du bskyal/ de nas bka' blon zur khang gis bsam gros bton pa ltar/ byang spyi rim bzhi zhwa sga ba pa blo gsal don grub dang bod dmag mi bcu bcas sngon du 'phan po sgo la 'gog par btang / nyin de'i mtshan mo lha sa'i chu tshod bcu gcig tsam la bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / lha klu kyatshe dbang rdo rje/ dmag spyi skal tshul/ dbus mda' shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub/ grwa bzhi ru dpon a nan zla ba/ ru dpon bzhi pa skal bzang / dam ga mi nyis brgya bcas grwa bzhi dmag sgar nas rdog thon byas te rim bzhin 'phan po sgo lar 'byor/ 'di gar la mgo srung mkhan zhwa sgab pa blo gsal don grub dang / bod dmag bcu bcas dang zla bsgri ri/ te nyin mtshan ltos med kyis byang rwa sgreng du bskyod pa red/ dus der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab ri car san gyis ‘‘bkra shis lhun po de dmag don rten gzhi byas te bkras lhun bla brang gis zing cha slong rtsis 'dug mi ces brjod pa de srid skyong stag brag sogs kyis bden par mngon nas bod dmag cha dang dmag sgar dang me skyogs dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon rgod gsham pa kun dga' rnam rgyal 'go dmag dang bcas pa gzhis rtser bca' sdod srung dmag tu btang / — 71 —

bod dmag de tshos gzhis rtse khul gyi mi ser la mnar gcod tshad med btang bar brten rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar/bka' blon zur lha gnyis dang dmag mi bcas rwa sgreng du bskyod pa'i gsang gtam zhig rgyal zur rwa sgreng ltos phyogs kyi dpon rigs dza zur 'jam dbyangs bde legs dang / dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan/ smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan khyi byams pa skal bzang sogs kyis zur tsam thos rjes phan tshun nang gros gnang ste gnas tshul de dag dngos yin min 'brel yod dpon rigs zhol spyi khyab mkhan zur dang / mdo mkhar ba sogs la nang gtam 'dri bar btang yang kho pa tshos dngos 'brel ma shes pa yin nam yang na gsang ba byas pa ji yin ma nges kyang de'i lan du ‘‘gnas tshul de rigs go thos shes tshor gang yang ma byung bas de ltar yin srid kyi ma red/ sde pa gzhung gi dmag mi 'gro skabs rta 'ul dos khal sogs sbir grags chen po ma byas par thon mi thub pas sku ngo rnam pa srang lam gtam 'chal gsan dgongs ma gnang ’ zhes bshad/dus der rwa sgreng dza sag gnyis dang / smyung gnas bla ma sogs nang gros byed skabs bsam gros gcig mthun ma byung bar brten smyung gnas bla mas sloganas tshul legs nyes ji ltar yin rung dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan 'phral du rwa sgreng du d+ngha 72 —

phebs dgos ’ zhes zhus/ 'on kyang dza sag gnyis nas bsam gros de la mos mthun ma byas stabs smyung gnas bla ma khong khro dang bcas te lam seng yar langs thog ‘‘gnas tshul legs pa zhig mi yong mthong gsal red/ 'on kyang sku ngo dza sag gnyis nas thag gcod gang 'dra gnang dgos min dgongs bzhes gnang rogs/ nga bla rgan gyi 'gro lam nga rang gis shes ’ zhes brjod nas phyir log gnang / de mjug dza sag gnyis kyis dog sde sbar gzim gzhis kyi las dpon tshe dbang nas grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi dmag mi phon chen zhig dza drag ngang thon song zhus pa'i gnas tshul de dngos 'brel yin min ma rtogs stabs mchod dpon ye shes tshul khrims la ‘‘khyed rang snga phyi ma gtogs phyir log gnang dgos pas da lam stabs gcig don gnyis kyis lam seng thon te bod dmag rwa sgreng la ma 'byor gong rwa sgreng dgon du 'byor ba byas te rwa sgreng rin po cher zhib gsal gnas lugs rnams chad lus med par zhu dgos ’ zhes gsungs pa ltar/7 mchod dpon ye shes tshul khrims ngo g.yog bzhis lag 'bom dang / me mda' khyer thog bzhon rta go 'pher re bzhon te nyin mtshan ltos med kyis rwa sgreng phyogs su bskyod/ mchod dpon ye shes tshul khrims ngo g.yog rnams phod mdo'i nye 'gram du 'byor skabs bka' blon zur lha gnyis dang / bod dmag 'go dmag phal che ba rwa — 73 —

sgreng du 'byor ba go thos byung bas kho tshos phod mdo lha chu dang rwa sgrong gtsang po 'dres mtshams nas rab brgyab ste mgyogs lam brgyud gsang ba'i sgo nas rwa sgreng spro khang gi nye 'dabs su bskyod/ 'di gar rwa sgrong dgon pa dang spro khang tshang ma bod dmag gis mtha' bskor ba dngos su mthong bas re zhig ci bya gtol med du gyur nas yibs bsdad/ stabs legs pa zhig la rwa sgreng mchod khang gi gad pa 'jam rab dang 'phrad de kho par gnas tshul 'dri skabs kho pas ‘‘dmag mi nam ma gsal gong du 'byor nas byang rgyud sa srung du 'gro mi yin pas mjal kha gtong dgos zhes zhus par mjal kha btang ste dmag mir ja thug sprad song / de rjes dmag mis spro khang gi mtha' bskor nas bsdad pa dang / dgon par yang dmag mi khyon che 'byor nas bsdad 'dug (nabs gras yongs rdzogs khang pa gcig gi nang du bcug nas bzhag yod pa dang / de bzhin sa dbang gnyis kyang 'byor 'dug gzhis rtse bde rab pa'i sras ye shes lags gcig pu rin po che'i sku mdun du thar gyi yod lugs sogs tso bshad / skabs der rwa sgreng mchod dpon ye shes tshul khrims sogs kyis thabs shes sna tshogs byas te rgyal zur rwa sgreng la phyag bris shig phul ba'i bka' lan du/gsal⑫/ 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo sa dbyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigasata〉deb 8pa'i shog grangs 69la — 74 —

khyod tshos thal cha byas‘na phan thogs med nges la/ de las khyod rang (ye shes tshul khrims la zer ) rgya nag tu slar yang brgyud bskul zhu bar bskyod dgos zhes bka' slob gnang ba bzhin mchod dpon ye shes tshul khrims dang / dbang chen rnam rgyal/ ka phrug stag phan bcas mes rgyal nang khul du bskyod de go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la gong gsal gnas tshul rnams snyan sgron zhus thog rgyal zur rwa sgreng la rgyab skyor rogs ram yong ba'i re ba ji ltar zhus kyang skabs der go min tang srid gzhung ni rlung gi dbus na gnas pa'i sgron me lta bur gyur pas rgyal zur rwa sgreng la rgyab skyor byed thabs bral/srid skyong stag brag shog khas bka' blon zur lha gnyis dang 'go dmag rnams rwa sgreng rin po che 'dzin bzung byed par btang rjes bka' shag tu drung rtsis brgyad sbrel skong 'tshog thog nan cing don gcod mkhan mgron lo gsum nas gsang ba'i tar lan 'byor tshul dang / bka' blon zur khang dang lha klu gnyis sogs rwa sgreng du btang zin pa'i skor sogs khyab bsgrags byas pa ma zad/ thengs 'di'i zhib dpyod las 'gan drung rtsis brgyad sbrel nas 'khur dgos thog drung rtsis ser skya dpon rigs yongs nas mthun sgril rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis legs sgrub zhu dgos lugs dang / lha sar rwa sgreng bla brang dang / bzhi sde smyung gnas bla ma/ mkhar rdo bla ma/— 75 —

yab gzhis phun khang / sa 'du tshang bcas kyi mkhar dbang yongs rdzogs la sgo thel rgyag rgyu/ rwa sgreng dza zur 'jam — dbyangs bde legs dang / dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mdzan/bka' gung phun khang bkra shis rdo rje bcas kyi las gnas chabs cig gnas dbyungatsobatang thog khong gsum dang / sa 'du glu'agyur med/ smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan byams pa skal tsobazang / mkhar rdo bla ma skal bzang thub bstan bcas rtse shar chen lcog tu do dam btson 'jug byed dgos pa'i thag gcod kyang byas pa red/ srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab dang / bka' shag gi bkod mngags ltar drung rtsis brgyad sbrel gyis rtse shod bka' shag gi sku tshab mgron gnyer re dang /sa srung dmag 'bras spungs tshogs chen zhal ngo dang sger g.yog sogs mnyam du khrid de rwa sgreng bla brang dang / bzhi sde smyung gnas bla ma'i sdod shag mkhar rdo bla brang / yab gzhis phun khang / sa 'du tshang bcas la sgo thel brgyab pa ma zad/ rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang / dza zur 'jam dbyangs bde legs/ phun khang gung bkra shis rdo rje bcas 'dzin bzung thog srid skyong stag brag gi bkod 'brel ltar shod gzim 'gag nas bka' bsgyur btang ste las zhabs chabs cig gnas dbyung btang nas rtse shar chen lcog tu do dam byas/ de bzhin mkhar rdo bla ma skal bzang thub bstan dang /— 76 —

sa 'du 'gyur med gnyis kyang 'dzing bzung thog rtse shar chen lcog tu btson 'jug byas/ skabs der smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan byams pa skal bzang gis rang nyid 'dzin bzung byed par 'ong ba'i gnas tshul de thos 'phral bzhi sde dgon gyi ltag sgo nas bros byol du phebs te lha sa sbyar pa khang nang zhag gcig bzhugs/ 'on kyang de khul grong pa tshos khong mthong bas bzhugs los rtsa ba nas ma bzod par bar skor nang nu ma'i 'og bal po skal ldan g.yu rgyal gyi nang du yibs bzhugs/dus der snang rtse shag las khungs kyi mi dpon gnyis dang sa srung dmag sogs kyis stag brag gi bka' ltar lha sa grong khyer nang gang sar rtsad gcod bsngogs bsher tsha nan byas pas glumathar nu ma'i 'og tu yod pa shes rtogs byung nas bal po skal ldan g.yu rgyal gyi khang pa bsngogs bsher byed 'go tshugs/ de 'phral smyung gnas bla ma rin po che khong khro dang 'jigs snang cig car du 'char bzhin gsang spyod nang 'dzul te rang gis rang la me mda' brgyab nas rang srog lcebs/ lha sa'i mi dpon dang sa srung dmag gis smyung gnas bla ma gson por 'dzin bzung byed mi thub stabs khong gi sku phung rags rgyab par rtsis sprad de gsang yib nang sa sbas btang / khong gi dge phrug skal bzang dang / mi nyag chos mdzad gnyis bros byol du song ba dang / thub bstan snyan grags 'dzin bzung thog rta — 77 —

lcag btang ste btson du bcug mthar phyu pa dkar po g.yogs te dgon pa'i skyid sdug nas phyir 'bud dang 'brel so nam las khungs la rtsis sprod byas pa ma zad/ dngos po gzhan phar bzhag lto phor tsam yang 'khur rgyu med pa'i dbul phongs nyam thag gi gnas su gyar ro/srid skyong stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog kha dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab ri car san khyi spyang lag sbrel gyis bka' blon zur khang ba dang lha klu gnyis rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po che 'dzin bzung byed par btang ba dang / rwa sgreng dza sag las zur gnyis sogs rwa sgreng ltos phyogs kyi ser skya dpon rigs khag gcig 'dzin bzung thog las zhabs gnas dbyung btang ba/ rwa sgreng bla brang sogs la sgo thel brgyab pa/ smyung gnas bla ma rin po che bya thabs med par rang srog lceb dgos byung ba sogs kyi gnas tshul gang sar khyab rjes lha sa khul du yam yom chen po zhig byung zhing / lhag par du ser 'bras sogs dgon sde khag nang du dmangs sems la ma babs pa'i gleng phyogs sna tshogs byung stabs stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab rtse pho brang du bsdad mus thog srid skyong stag brag gi bkod mngags ltar bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma gnyis kyang rtse pho brang du las shag spos te bsdad/ de bzhin stag brag shog khas lha sa'i — 78 —

mi dmangs dang / lhag par du ser 'bras dge 'dun pa tshos rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi rgyab langs byas te glo bur du rgol lan bslogs yong snyam pa'i zhed snang byas te srid skyong stag brag gi bka' ltar bka' shag gis dmag spyi khang dang / snang rtse shag mi dpon/ zhol gnyer las khungs/ 'bras spungs tshogs chen zhal ngo sogs la lha zhol khul dang / lhag par du dgon khag nang mi mang dpung sdeb kyis phung sbyor mi yong ba'i slad du dogs zon dam bsgrags gang che dgos pa'i bkod khyab nan tan btang ba ma zad/ nor gling gzim sgo khag dang / rtse shar chen lcog zhol go mdzod khang / rwa sgreng bla brang bcas su bod dmag mang po srung byar bzhag pa dang / lhag par du rtse pho brang gi gzim sgo khag dang / gtso gnas gzim chung khag la bod dmag go lag rang sgrig 'bor chen bzhag nas nyin mtshan ltos med srung bya byed du bcug pa red/zla 2tshes 25nyin slar yang yab gzhis phun khang gi sras mgon po tshe ring 'dzin bzung thog las zhabs gnas dbyung btang ba dang / de bzhin stag brag shog kha'i bkod mngags ltar/ se ra bla spyi dang ser byes mkhan po sog po bstan dar sogs kyis se rar yod pa'i rwa sgreng bla brang dang mkhar rdo bla brang gi rgyu dngos yongs rdzogs la sgo thel brgyab/ skabs der se ra'i grwa dmangs kyis ser byes mkhan po gnyis ka btsan — 79 —

dga' shog kha'i rjes 'brang pa yin pa gsal por rtogs te khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar bzhin ser byes mkhan po tshos grwa dmangs dang rdog rtsa gcig sgril byed dam mi byed ces rdo kha len par rdo skas 'dzegs te yong skabs mkhan po'i phyag mdzod skal bzang gis skad cha tshig gcig shod long med par me mda' brgyab ste grwa shar byams pa ye shes (ming 'dogs la rgya se dkar po zhes zer ) bsad pa dang / lho pa khang tshan gyi dkar phrug la rmas skyon phog de skabs rdab rdob tshe 'phel zer ba dpa' blo khog la skad grags che ba zhig yod pa des me mda' tshur phrogs te mkhan po'i phyag mdzod dang grwa g.yog gnyis bcas pa bsad/ dus der ser byes mkhan po sog po bstan dar dang a mdo a ka sprul sku gnyis mkhan po'i las shag tu bsdad mus la me mda'i sgra thos 'phral gang yin nam snyam nas lta ba'i skabs su grwa pa yar yong ba mthong bas dngangs skrag ches cher skyes te sge'u khung nang nas thog kha'i steng du mchongs thog gdugs kyi 'og tu yibs bsdad/ grwa dmangs kyis ser byes mkhan po las shag nang bsdad med pa mthong nas gang sar 'tshol ba'i dus der a mdo a ka sprul sku snang med du song nas bros thar/ grwa dmangs kyis mkhan po'i shag dang thog kha'i steng gang sar mu mthud btsal 'tshol byas mthar ser byes mkhan po sog po bstan dar gdugs kyi 'og tu — 80 —

yibs bsdad yod pa mthong bas grwa dmangs kyis kho par 'khon 'dzin tshad med byas te lde mig dang gri gang byung gzhus te lus po yongs rdzogs dum bur btang nas bsad/ rjes su kho pa'i ro sha rdog rdog re re bzhin bsgrugs te rtswa ras nang blugs nas 'khyer 'gro dgos byung ba red/nyin de'i mtshan mo ser byes grwa tshang gi grwa dmadas rnams tshogs 'du 'tshogs te rgyal zur rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes mchog gi rgyab langs mtha' gcig tu bya rgyu dang /btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rjes 'brang pa stag brag shog khar ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu bya rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag pa ma zad/ lha sa'i grong nang yong ste 'brel yod sku drag 'ga' zhig gi khang pa mer bsregs gtong rgyu dang / rwa sgreng bla brang sogs nas me mda' ji yod bton te 'khyer rgyu'i gros kyang byas te ra che rdo zam 'gram du slebs mtshams bod dmag sa srung ba dang gdong thug brgyab te phan tshun me mda' rgyag res byas pas bod dmag sa srung ba zhig rkyen lam du btang / de byings sa srung dmag mi yongs rdzogs dngangs skrag dang bcas te bros byol du phyin/ser byes grwa pa rnams nas bod dmag shi ba de'i me mda' tshur blangs te mu mthud grong nang du bskyod nas rgya 'bum sgang gi mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gyi khang pa mer bsregs gtong rtsis byas — 81 —

kyang bsam don ji bzhin ma grub/ de nas rwa sgreng bla brang du me mda' 'don par bskyod na'ang srung bya bod dmag phon che bas me mda' mang po brgyab stabs grwa pa rnams phyir log ma byed ka med byung ba red/ 'on kyang ser byes grwa dmangs lha sa'i nang du yong ste tshur rgol byas pa'i gnas tshul de btsan dga' shog kha'i byed gte gtso bo stag brag dza sag bstan pa mthar phyin dang / zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan/ drung yig che mo ngag dbang rnam rgyal sogs kyis shes 'phral snying rtsa 'dar bzhin gyon chas cha tshang gon long med par stag brag bla brang du mnyam rub byas/ 'on kyang kho pa tsho stag brag bla brang du'ang sdod blos rtsa ba nas ma bzod par lag tu me mda' re thogs te rkang thang du lcang gseb shar brgyud rtse pho brang du bros phyin/ skabs der rtse pho brang du yod pa'i srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab kyis lha sa'i nang du me mda' brgyab pa'i sgra thos ma thag dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te hob ste yar langs bas i si sbir gyi nyal khri'i sgang nas gzags te brdabs chag byung ba dang / rlung 'phar nas dbugs gnon mi thub pa'i thog mchi ma yang mang po shor te nyen kha che ba'i gnas su gyar/gnas tshul de stag brag ltos phyogs kyi ser skya dpon rigs gtso gras dza sag bstan pa mthar phyin dang / rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs kyis thos rjes dngangs skrag de — 82 —

bas che ba skyes pa red/skabs der lha sa'i grong nang dang / se ra dgon pa sogs la zing cha chen po langs stabs lha sa'i grong nang sdod mkhan stag brag shog kha'i dpon rigs tsho sdod blos rtsa ba nas ma bzod pa ra rtse pho brang dang / zhol du spos te bsdad/gzhan yang lha sa'i grong mi drag zhan tshang ma'i sems la bod pa'i dmag mi dang mi 'khyam tshos 'phrog bcom byas yong snyam nas 'jigs snang byas te tshong khang dang / sger khang tshang ma'i sgo dang sge'u khung brgyab ste sdod dgos byung ba red/ bka' blon zur lha gnyis dang / 'go dmag rnams rwa sgreng dgon du ma slebs gong grwa bzhi ru dpon a nan zla ba dang dmag mi khag gcig rwa sgreng la sngon du 'byor nas dgon pa'i nang glo bur du 'dzul yong bas grwa pa dang zhabs 'bring rnams ga byed 'di byed med par gyur/ de nas grwa bzhi ru dpon bzhi pa skal bzang dang / brgya dpon karma rab bzang /brgya dpon skal bzang sogs rwa sgreng rin po che'i spro khang nang du yong ste ‘‘nga tsho byang du 'gro mkhan yin pas rwa sgreng rin po che'i mjal kha yong ba zhu ’ zhes rdzun bshad/ rwa sgreng rin po che dang zhabs 'bring rnams dogs zon ha cang zhan pas snang med thog mjal kha gnang ba ma zad/ 'go dmag tsho la ja thug kyang gsol ras gnang / grwa bzhi ru dpon bzhi pa skal — 83 —

bzang gis mjal kha gnang skabs ‘‘bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis nga tsho rwa sgreng rin go che lha sar gdan 'dren zhu bar btang byung / de'i spyi khyab hūṃ bka' blon zur khang dang / lha klu/bod dmag gi dmag spyi skal tshul/ mda' dpon shud khud pa/byang spyi rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa bcas yod 7ces zhus/ skabs der bka' blon zur khang dang / lha klu sogs lam bar du 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / rwa sgrong rin po che 'dzin bzung byed thub min thad sems khral chen po byung ste zur khang gis ‘‘ ‘rwa sgreng gdan zhu bya rgyur da lta las bgos kyis dmag mi khag gcig cung zad sngon la thon song yang / rwa sgreng la gsang brda 'byor yod na byang brgyud phebs grub kyi red/gnas tshul de 'dra shar tshe nga ni phyi rgyal la bros 'gro ba las/lha sar 'gro nus pa mi 'dug ’ces bshad/ de lan lha klus ‘nga ni bza' mi bu phrug mang po yod stabs bros thabs mi 'dugabazang ngan ga re byung na'ang lha sar log 'gro rgyu yin zhes shod res byas te don snying las 'gan sgrub e yong snyam pa'i the tshom dang / skrag snang skye bzhin par 'gro ba'i mur de 'phral ru dpon bzhi pa skal bzang gis brda skyel mkhan dmag mi gcig btang 'byor byung ste brjod gsal/ bka' blon ngo las rnams mgyogs po phebs rogs gnang / gnas tshul lhing 'jags yin/ nga tsho bsgugs bsdad yod zer ba'i lan — 84 —

'byor stabs tshang ma blo bde bar gyur/ ⑪bka' blon zur khang dang / lha klu/ 'go dmag dang bcas pa gang myur ngang thad kar rwa sgreng spro khang du bskyod de rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi sku mdun du bcar nas dad gus che khul gyis phyag dbang re zhus te gdan thog tu bsdad ma thag rwa sgreng rin po ches ‘‘bka' blon rnam gnyis 'dir phebs don gang yin nam zhes gsungs par bka' blon gnyis kyis ‘‘rin po che lha sar phebs dgos pa dang / bla brang la sgo thel gnon dgos zhes bka' phebs byung ba las don gnad ji yin shes tshor ma byung zhes bshad/de'i lan du rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog gis ‘‘nga lha sar phyin chog kyang bla brang la sgo thel rgyag rgyu'i dbang cha khyed tshor rtsa ba nas med ’ ces gsungs/ skabs der rgyal zur rwa sgreng sogs nas phar rgol lan slog thabs med stabs bshan pa'i lag tu sha lug thebs pa lta bu'i gnas su gyar/ de nas bka' blon zur lha gnyis dang ser skya dpon rigs gtso bo rnams spro khang gi gzim chung shod du 'dzoms te rgyal zur rwa sgreng 'khrid chog skor la zhib gsal gros mol byas te rin po che'i zhabs zhu ba gsol gzim mi gsum (gsol dpon rig rnam dang / gzim 'gag tshul khrims nor bu/ gsol thab pa nora'adzin )dang gsal⑫/ 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus daphyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigasanyi〉deb 5pa'i thog grang422la — 85 —

sku mched thub bstan rgyal mtshan bcas mnyam du 'khrid rgyu'i thag gcod gtan 'khel thog nyer mkho gang tsam gra sgrig byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ de bzhin bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa blo gsal don grub gnyis kyis sngon la rwa sgreng rin po che khrid de 'gro rgyu dang /bka' blon lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje dang / dmag spyi skal tshul/mda' dpon shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub sogs kyis rwa sgreng bla brang gi khang khungs yod tshad la sgo thel rgyag rgyu'i las 'gaske khur te rjes su sdod rgyu'i gtan 'khelam̐ byas/ de ltar kho po tshos g.yo thabs la brten nas rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes mchog lha sar btsan khrid byas shing / rwa sgreng spro khang nas zhal gyes skabs chibs rta g.yu 'brug zer ba der chibs sga brgyab yod rung / zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis ‘‘der chibs na mi 'grigs/ gzim 'jol bkal ba'i drel der chibs dgos zhes bshad/ de rjes yang kho pas ‘‘rta la chibs na lam bar nas rta rgyugs btang ste shor nyen yod pa red 7ces bshad/ khong tsho rwa sgreng nas thon te rim bzhin byang stag lung dgon du 'byor skabs thad kar lha sar skyod mi nus par bka' blon lha klu dang / dmag spyi skal tshul/ mda' dpon shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub sogs bsgugs nas bsdad/ khong tsho mnyam 'dzoms byung — 86 —

rjes rwa sgreng bla brang gi khang khungs tshang mar sgo thel brgyab pa'i gnas tshul skor nang mol byed skabs zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis ‘‘srung bya dmag mi med par lde mig tshang ma lde 'chang rgan par rtsis sprad na mi 'grigs ’ zhes brjod de bod dmag mi bcu drug tsam rwa sgreng dgon du srung bya byed par btang ba red/de nas rim bzhin 'phan po sgo la brgyab ste gling bu rdzong du 'byor rjes ‘‘zur khang gis rwa sgreng rin po che'i lus por zhib bsher byas te am phrag nas gnam lcags phur pa de phar blangs te rin po che khyed kyis bsnam mi 'os ⑫ zhes bshad/de nas nyin zhig rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog gis rtse drung shar rtse ye shes thub bstan la ‘‘lam bar sa dbang zur khang sogs rta pa mang po'i dkyil nas grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi brgya dpon skal bzang zer ba des nga'i nye sar rta gral bsgrigs thog lag pas me mda'i yu ba bzung ste nga la mig hrig hrig gis lta bzhin 'dug de nyin gal srid nyen kha'i gnas tshul byung na nga gsod mkhan kho yin pa 'dra zhes gsungs/ dus der srid skyong stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog khas rgyal gces ser skya mang tshogs kyis 'gro lam bkag ste rwa sgreng rin po che phrogs 115dzo gsanābo/da gyi rig gnas lo rgyus dbyad gzhi'i rgyu cha 0dmas bsgrigs〉〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs —— 87 —

yong snyam nas lam 'khel sa gnas su gdong bsu rta dmag dang / rkang dmag 'bor chen btang ba ma zad/ 'brel yod lam 'khel khag la'ang grwa bzhi dmag mi bcu shog re tsam gang sar bkrams pa red/ dus der bka' blon zur lha gnyis nang gros byed skabs zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis ‘‘de ring lha klu dang / dmag spyi skal tshul/ mda' dpon shud khud pa/ gcas kyis rwa sgreng gdan 'dren zhu dgos pa dang / nga dang zhwa sgab pa gnyis sngon la thon te se ra'i glang chen ri zur du bskyod de grwa pa 'gog par 'gro rgyu yin ’ zhes brjod nas sngon la thon phyin/ don du zur khang dbang chen dge legs ni g.yo sgyu che la spyang po yod pas lam bar se ra'i grwa pas lam bkag nas rang gi srog mgo thon mi yong snyam nas skrag gi yod pa red/ de nas rwa sgreng rin po che thad kar rtse shar chen lcog tu gdan drang rgyu'i thag gcod byas pa dang /gsol gzim mi gsum la lus bsher gtsang ma byas te grwa bzhi brgya dpon don grub tshe ring brgyud grwa bzhi dmag sgar la rtsis sprod byas/lha sa'i rgyal gces mang tshogs dang / lhag par du ser byes rgyal gces/ grwa dmangs kyis tshogs 'du thengs mang 'tshogs te bka' blon zur lha gnyis dang / 'go dmag gis rwa sgreng rin po che btsan khrid byas te yong skabs 'gro lam — 88 —

bkag ste dmar 'dzing byas thog rwa sgrong rin po che tshur 'phrog rgyu'i semakuṭa thag mtha' gcig tu bcad/ 'on kyang stagre/ brag thog khas rwa sgreng 'phan po sgo la brgyud btsan khrid bya rgyu'i nang rngo la gta na 'khel zin na yang / phyi rgyar 'brom p+tod dang / stod lung gang rung nas phebs kyi yod tshul gi skad cha gang sar bkrams nas rgyal gces mang tshogs dang grwa pa rnams mgo 'khor ba zhig bzos/ rwa sgreng rin po che btsan khrid byas te se ra dgon pa'i nye 'gram du 'byor skabs grwa dmangs dgon pa'i nang du mgo 'khor te bsdad yod cing / so lta ba grwa pa 'galjori zhig gis rwa sgreng rin po che btsan khrid byed bzhin yod pa mthong 'phral bod dmag la me mda' brgyab ste shag byang rig 'dzin zer ba'i bod dmag gcig bsad/ de rjes se ra'i ri rtse dang / dgon gsham nas me mda' mang po brgyab pa dang sbrags grwa pa khag gcig gis phar phyogs su bskyod de rwa sgreng rin po che btsan 'phrog byed dgos snyam yang grwa bzhi dmag mi dang sku srung dmag mis deng rabs can gyi 'phrul mda' sbag sbag mang po brgyab stabs phyir 'then mi byed ka med byung ba red/ skabs der rgyal gces grwa dmangs tshor go mtshon ha cang dkon pas slar yang phar rgol byed thabs bral/ de nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng lha sa'i bye rag brgyud rtse shar chen lcog tu btsan khrid byas nas btson du bcug dbyin ji'i rjes — 89 —

'brang pa stag brag shog khas btson srung bar ched mngags lung shar o rgyan rnam grol dang / shar rtse ye shes thub bstan bzhagaskabs der shar rtse ye shes thub bstan gyis 'dzems bag med par brjod don/ ‘‘nga rang yang rgyal zur rwa sgreng la 'khon 'dzin yod/ gang lags she na/ rang gi skya khyim dbus stod lo sgo nang pa zer ba'i sa khang rnams rwa sgreng srid skyong byed skabs 'char phul phyag rtags don bzhin btsan 'phrog byas te 'bras spungs spyi bso pha ra gnyer tshang zer bar sprad pa der 'khon 'dzin yod pa ma zad/ nga rang rgyun gtan chos srid kyi lta ba langs phyogs 'di yin rang med pa'i cha le cho le chos lugs dang / bla ma/ dpon chen bcas la gus gus sbyar sbyar byed mi thub pa'i mi zhig yin pa bcas la brten rgyal zur rwa sgreng la sdang zug bya rgyur stag brag dang bka' shag gis blos bkal ba red/ gzigs dang / rgyal zur rwa sgrong gi btson srung pa'i lo rgyus de ni bod kyi lha mo 'gro ba bzang mo'i 'khrab gzhung nang ha shang btsun mos gdol pa rgan gzhon gnyis bed spyod btang nas sras lcam sring gnyis gsod thabs byes pa dang 'dra po mi 'dug gam/mi ⑪gzhan yang stag brag shog khas dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul gyi shag tshang shod mgron skal bzang ngag 112dzī gsanābo/da kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dbyad gzhi'i cha bdams bsgrigasanyi〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs—— 90 —

dbang la yid ches dang blos 'gel byas te btson srung ba'i 'go 'dzin du bsko gzhag byas/ kho pas btsan dga' stobs shugs kyi bsam 'dun yongs su sgrub ched rgyal zur rwa sgreng la 'khon 'dzin rab tu bcangs te btson srung ba lung shar o rgyan rnam grol dang shar rtse ye shes thub bstan la ‘‘gal te se ra'i grwa pas btson khang gi nye sar mchongs yong tshe nga tshos sngon la spo bo (rgyal zur rwa sgreng la zer )gtor rgyu rang red/ rwa sgreng la lta srung gzab nan byed dgos/ rnyog dra yod pa red/ spo bo la cang ce hres rgyab rtsa zhe drag byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ se ra'i grwa pas kyang zing cha gang 'dra slong gi mi 'dug gam rdzi zhes bshad/ dus der rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang / dza zur 'jam dbyangs bde legs/ phun khang gung bkra shis rdo rje/ mkhar rdo bla ma skal bzang thub bstan/ sa 'du 'gyur med bcas kyang rtse shar chen lcog tu bcug pa dang /lhag par du rgyal zur rwa sgreng la mnar gcod tshad med btang stabs rgya che'i rgyal gces ser skya mang tshogs dang / ser byes grwa dmangs kyis rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi rgyab langs byas te stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog khar ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/de nas btsan dga' shog kha dang ser byes grwa tshang gi 121zhu gsanābo/da gyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gagi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs—— 91 —

rgyal gces grwa dmangs dbar dmag 'khrug langs/ ser byes grwa tshang ni rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi thob khungs grwa tshang zhig yin zhing / btsan dga' shog khas rwa sgrong rin po che dang rwa sgreng ltos phyogs dpon rigs gtso gras rnams 'dzin bzung byas pa ma zad/ rwa sgreng bla brang gi khang khongs rgyu dngos yongs rdzogs la'ang sgo thel brgyab pa sogs gnod 'tshe gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis btang bar brten ser byes grwa dmangs sogs rgyal gces ser skya mi dmangs tshos rwa sgreng rin po cher ma nyes kha g.yog byas par bden rdzun dbye ba 'byed dgos pa'i re 'bod lan mang zhus kyang dag sel bya rgyu lta zhog de las ldog ste rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi sku srog la'ang nyen kha ha cang chen po bzos/des na khong tshos drag chas la brtem/ nas rang srung rgol lan bslog rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ dus der srid skyong stag brag gi bkod mngags ltar/ bka' shag dang / spyi khyab mkhan po/ drung rtsis bcas tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas ser byes grwa tshang gi grwa dmangs kyis se ra'i gzhung sgor 'dzing rags brgyab pa dang / ri rtse khag bzung ba/ lha sa khul du zing cha bslangs ba/ ser byes mkhan po sog po bstan dar ngo g.yog bsad pa zer ba sogs la kha g.yar te se rar dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i skor nang gros byed skabs la las dmag spyi gnyis phebs dgos lugs kyi bsam gros bton pas de 'phral bka' shag — 92 —

gis dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul dang / mdo mkhar phun tshogs rab rgyas tshogs 'dur yong dgos pa'i brda btang ba ltar rngo+ogs 'dur zhugs/ tshogs 'du'i thog btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rjes 'brang pa rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gyis ‘‘ser byes grwa tshang gis khrims 'gal ltos med 'di tsam byed bzhin du da dung bka' shag gis zhal zas khyis khyer kyang zhal tsher tsher/ lha khang dri mas brgyangs kyang zhal tsher tsher zer ba lta bu 'di 'dra gnang ste bzhugs na 'grigs e yong / se ra byes pa mi dgos se ra gling gang me btang ba'i shul tsam ma lhag na'ang 'gyod pa til 'bru tsam med thag chod yin zhes mna' chen po bskyal thog dmag don spyi khyab sa dbang rnam pa nas gcig lam seng phebs te da lta rang se ra gtor dgos ⑫zhes shugs chen bshad/ skabs der tshogs zhugs ser skya dpon rigs tshor bsam tshul 'dra min ji ltar yod rung srid skyong stag brag gi dgongs pa dang 'gal dogs kyis rang zon byas te mos mthun med pa'i skad cha tshig gcig kyang shod ma nus pa red/ mthar tshogs 'du'i thog spyi khyab bka' blon gcig pebs rgyu gtan 'khel zin pas tshogs zhugs bka' blon ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma'i sems la de snga rang nyid rgyal zur gsal⑫/ 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo sa dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs 7snyel — 93 —

rwa sgreng dang 'brel 'dris che bas da res dang blangs byas te ma don na srid skyong stag brag la dogs gzhi skyes yong snyam nas ‘‘da res se rar dmag don spyi khyab bka' blon gcig phebs rgyu'i thad sa dbang bla ma ram pa dgung lo'i babs dang bcas bka' shag tu bzhugs 'os pa dang / sa dbang zur khang dang lha klu rnam gnyis rwa sgreng du rgyal tshab rin po che gdan zhur phebs te da lta phyir phebs grub ma thag yin stabs/ da lam 'gro res nga la 'khor 'dug pas ngas phyin chog ’ ces khas len gnang / de la mkhan drung tā bla ma thub bstan nor bzang dang / mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan sogs nas gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis mos mthun byas pa ma zad/ sa dbang ka shod pa'i las rogs su dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul dang / mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rtsis dpon rnam sras gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med/ bka' mgron zhol khang sras bsod nams dar rgyas/ bka' drung rma lam pa dgra lha srid dar/ las byar mkhan chung bkras mthong blo bzang rnam rgyal dang / gro spyi rim bzhi spom mda' yar 'phel/mtsho sgo sras don grub tshe ring / hor khang sras bsod nams dpal 'bar/ zhol gnyer 'brang stod pa mi 'gyur rdo rje sogasga kyang btang / khong tsho ngo las mi grangs sum cu tsam grwa bzhi dmag sgar du 'byor skabs rgyal gces ser skya dpon — 94 —

rigs dang / bla sprul mang po/ lhag don ser byes grwa tshang gi las sne gtso gras sogs kyis zhwa ser bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi bye brag se ra theg chen gling 'di bzhin ming tsam mi gnas par 'gro ba'i nyen kha'i gnas las skyob ched srid skyong stag brag sogs la bar 'dum yong ba'i re ba thengs mang zhus/ 'on kyang stag brag shog khas dkar nag go ldog dang / drang bden ma yin pa'i cha rkyen rab dang rim pa bton par se ra'i grwa dmangs kyis khas len dang sgrub thabs rtsa ba nyid nas med stabs 'dum 'grig yong thabs bral/ dus der grwa bzhi dmag sgar du yod pa'i dmag don spyi khyab bka' blon ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma dang / bod dmag gi dmag spyi skal tshul sogs kyis ser byes grwa dmangs la 'jigs snang skul ched se ra'i rgyab ri dang dgon pa'i g.yas g.yon gang sar me skyogs rgyag rgyu'i thag gcod gtan 'khel byas nas mdel grangs nyi shu skor brgyab kyang bod dmag gi lag rtsal zhan la dmag don gyi myong bya ha cang dman pa'i rkyen gyis me skyogs dmigs sar ma phog pas grwa dmangs la 'jigs snang skye rgyu phar bzhag bod dmag gi 'go dmag rnams ngo tsha kha skyengs su gyur pa red/ skabs der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas mngon sum 'dzems med kyis btsan dga' shog kha'i rgyab langs byas te se ra'i dmag 9rakhrug nang zhugs/〈〈bod — 95 —

sa gnas kyi lo rgyus yig cha phyogs bsdus 〉〉nang ‘‘stag brag gis se ra dgon du me skyogs rgyag dgos pa'i bka' bstud mar phab stabs grong khyer nye 'dabs su dmag 'thab drag po langs pa red/ dbyin phyogs nas me skyogs dpung khag la rogs skyor byas pa ma zad/ lha sar bca' sdod dbyin ji'i tshong don sku tshab tshogs pa'i tar gtong mkhan ṣā0smokyis dmag don gsang gnas gtong ba'i 'gan khur ba dang / rtse pho brang dang dmag sgar dbar tar yig 'phrul 'khor re btsugs pa red tsādabyin jis tar gtong mkhan btang ba dang / de bzhin me skyogs dadu/nga khag la rogs skyor byas pa de'i thog nas gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing chen po yod pa gsal por mthong thub ’ ⑩cesani 'khod yod pa red/ de ni skabs de'i don dngos dang yongs su mthun zhing / dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab ri car san gyis de snga stag brag la shog sbubs rlung 'tshang gis rgyal gces stobs shugs la rdung rdeg gtong ba'i byus ngan mang po 'i/ga btings/ thengs 'dir se ra dgon dang stag brag shog kha'i dbar dmag 'khrug dngos su langs skabs bod kyi ser skya mang tshogs dang lhag par du ser byes grwa tshang gi grwa dmangs yongs nas dpa' ngar zhum med kyis 'gog rgol ske mtha' gcig tu byas pa dang / bod dmag gi 'go dmag tsho phonye 〈〈bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus yig cha phyogs bsdusata〉shog grangs 255la gsal/— 96 —

rtsal med gnyod chung gi dmag dpung zhig yin pa dngos su mthong dus kho pa tsho'i sdig nyes kyi dmigs yul sgrub thub pa'i ched gdong 'bag bshus te mngon sum 'dzems med kyis dmag 'thab nang dngos su zhugs pa red/ bod sdod dbyin ji'i las tshab ri car san gyis ‘‘me mda' dang / rdzas mdel sogs go mtshon ji dgos dbyin gzhung gis rogs 'don zhu rgyu dang / gzhan yang gang ci'i thad la rgyab skyor rogs ram bya rgyu yin pas snying stobs cher skyed kyis mgo gnon byed dgos ’ zhes bshad/ yang de rjes ri car san gyis ‘‘se rar 'thab ra dngos su tshugs mtshams ya ra mar bka' bsdur mdzad sgo gal che yong rgyu dang / dmag don kyi las ka 'phral 'phral thag gcod byed dgos la 'gyangs rkyen mi 'byung ched skud med glog 'phrin kha par btsugs na yag po yong rgyur 'di nas g.yar po phul 'thus gsungs te skud med glog 'phrin kha par yo byad cha tshang gnyis gnang byung ba nas gcig rtse ltag sgo rgyab yab gzhis las shag tu 'dzugs rgyu dang / gcig grwa bzhir btsugs te bka' shag dang / bde gling dbyin gzhung sku tshab/ grwa bzhi dmag don spyi khyab khang kyi dbar gal che dza drag gi— gnas tshul ji byung phar tshur skabs 'phral kha par gtong nyan byed gtan 'khel ba yin pas grwa bzhir yang glog 'phrin kha par gtong nyan 'phrul chas cha tshang 'dzugs par bde skyid gling kha nas sba bu — 97 —

zhig yong ba yod ’ ⑫ ces bshad/ de nas dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i thad ka'i rgyab skyor 'og grwa bzhi dmag don spyi khyab khang nas phreng ring sras 'jigs med sum rtsen dang /ka dang sku srung dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag 'ga' zhig ched 'bod thog me skyogs kha bsgrigs te se ra dgon gyi shar ngos glang chen ri zur dang / sbra ti gling kha sogs la brgyab ste se ra'i grwa dmangs la 'jigs snang ji ltar bskul yang mu mthud 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs phan tshun zhi ba'i gros mol bya thabs bral/ des na me phag (1947)lo'i zla 2tshes 6nyin gyi dgong dro nas 'go btsugs te drag po'i dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i gtan 'khel byas te ka dang sku srung dmag sgar dang / nga dang rgyal rtse dmag sgar sogs grwa bzhi dmag sgar du bsdu 'dzoms thog dmag sgar de rnams kyi dmag dpon che 'bring chung gsum bcas pa dmag don spyi khyab khang du ched 'bod kyis se rar drag po'i dpung 'jug byed phyogs skor zhib phra'i 'thab byus bkod mngags byas/zla 2 pa'i tshes 7nyin nyi ma ri rtser shar skabs se ra'i ri rtse gtso bo de gnyis kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyis blangs pa dang / nub rgyud chu bzang gi ri rtse dang / lha rten dkar gsalayi/ 〈〈bod gyi rig gnas lo sa dpyad gzhi'i cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 6pa'i shog grangag79la — 98 —

po'i rgyud kyi ri rtse de gnyis nga dang rgyal rtse dmag sgar gyis blangs pa/ rin chen rtse zhes pa'i ri rtse de ka dang sku srung dmag sgar gyis blangs pa bcas se ra'i g.yas g.yon gyi ri rtse gtso bo rnams dus gcig tu blangs te ri rtse so sor bod dmag gi dmag dar btsugs/ skabs der se ra'i grwa dmangs kyis dpa' ngar zhum pa med par bod dmag dang phan tshun me mda' rgyag res byas te 'gog rgol ji ltar byas kyang grwa dmangs rnams dmag 'thab kyi nyams myong rtsa ba nas med pa dang / go mtshon zhan pas dpa' ngar can gyi dpa' co ldam rdum dang 'dra bar bya thabs dben pa'i gnas su lhungs/ mthar har gdong dge bshes blo bzang bstan pa dang / khang ser bla brang gi gnyer pa sogs rgyal gces kyi grwa rigs sum cu so gnyis tsam rkyen lam du shor ba dang / grwa pa mang por rmas skyon phogabod dmag mi gsum bsad pa dang / 'ga' zhig rmas/bod dmag gis se ra dgon yongs su blangs rjes dmag don spyi khyab pa sa dbang ka shod pa sogs kyis dgon pa srung skyob byed pa'i bya thabs nus ldan spel stabs dgon pa'i rgyu dngos la gnod skyon che ba byung med/ kho pa tshos ser byes grwa tshang gi sgo mchor steng gi rab gsal che mo'i nang bod dmag gi dmag don spyi khyab khang btsugs te grwa tshang gsum gyi las sne che 'bring chung gsum ched 'bod thog ‘‘byed gte 'phros bsdad ji yod gcig — 99 —

kyang ma lus pa rtsis 'bul dgos rgyu dang / grwa rigs sger gyi lag tu yod pa'i go mtshon tshang ma phyir 'bul zhu dgos zhes brjod/ de 'phral grwa tshang dang / khang tshan/ mi tshan bcas khongs so so brgyud rtsis 'bul zhus pa ltar/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug nang zhugs mkhan rgyal gces bla sprul dang grwa rigs mi grangs brgya dang drug cu tsam yod thog nas rtse gnya' sprul sku dang / grong stod pa/ gzim 'gag mkhyen brtse bcas bros shor ba dang / bya bral dge bshes bu bla ma dang / har gdong dge bshes blo dga'/ tre hor 'dam spyi/ja chu gtsang mo mgo zer ba sogs grwa rigs bcu lhag tsam tso'adzin bzung thog khrims gcod drag po btang ste/ la lar tshe sgo tshe lcags brgyab ste rgyang 'bud btang ba dang / la lar tshe sgo tshe lcags brgyab ste sku drag che rigs la rtsis sprad/ de byings grwa pa mang che ba dgon par rang 'jags bsdad chog pa'i thag gcod byas/ de rjes sa phyogs gang sar rtse gnya' sprul sku sogs 'tshol zhib byed mi btang bas rtse gnya' sprul sku 'dzin bzung thub pa dang / grong stod pa dang gzim 'gag mkhyen brtse dmar gsod btang / dus der se ra'i grwa pa mang po dgon par gnas thabs med stabs 'bras spungs dgon dang /grib tshe mchog gling sogs nye 'gram gyi dgon pa dang ri khrod khag tu yib sdod dgos byung ba sogs mdor na/ rgyal zur rwa — 100 —

sgreng ltos phyogs kyi rgyal gces bla sprul dang grwa rigs sogs la pham nyes ha cang chen po byung ba red/ 'on kyang btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang / de'i rjes 'brang pa stag brag shog kha'i 'dod blo ma khengs par se ra dgon gyi las sne rnams zhib sar ched 'bod thog se ra'i dmag zing skor bskyar zhib byed dgos zhes brjod pa ma zad/ ser byes grwa tshang gi gser dngul bkar 'jug ji yod dang hor stag shun gyi mchod rdzas/ de min dngos po rtsa che'i rigs tshang ma gzhung bzhes gtong dgos zhes brjod kyang skabs der rgyal gces ser skya dpon rigs mang pos mos mthun ma byas stabs kho pa tsho bya thabs dka' ba'i gnas su gyar/ dus der go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod sa gnas srid gzhung la tar btang ste rgyal zur rwa sgreng skyob thabs byas/ ‘‘krung dbyang gi bka'i nang gtso bo gnyis yod pa las gcig ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung skyong byed dgos pa las dgon par me smyogs rgyag mi chog ces pa de yin zhing /gcig ni rwa sgreng sprul sku ni krung dbyang gis cho lo gnang ba'i ho thog thu yin thog tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa rtsad gcod kyi gtso 'gan bzhes nas byas rjes bzhag yod pas khong la lta skyong byed dgos par ma zad/ thag gcod gu yangs byed — 101 —

dgos zhes pa de red ⑫ 'on kyang srid skyong stag brag dang bka' shag sogs kyis snang med du bzhag nas ya lan tsam yang ma byas pa red/ se ra'i rgyal gces bla sprul dang grwa dmangs kyis rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi rgyab langs byas pa dang / go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis tar yig btang nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng btson nas skyob thabs byas kyang gu yangs thob rgyu phar bzhag de las ldog ste stag brag shog khas khong la 'khon 'dzin de bas che ba byas nas zhu ba thengs gsum tsam blangs/zhu ba thengs dang po blangs nas phyir log phebs rjes rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog gis btson srung ba shar rtse ye shes thub bstan la gsungs don/ ‘‘tshogs 'du lhan rgyas nas nga la khas len byed thabs med pa'i don gnad mang po zhig gsung gi 'dug rwa sgreng bla brang gi mis stag brag rgyal tshab bkrong rtsis thengs mang byas pa red/ ngan gshom ga re ga re byas yod khyed rang gis re re bzhin gsal zhu byed dgos/ khyed rang 'dzin bzung byed dgos don der thug pa red gsungs byung / der ngas lan zhus par/ ma gzhi stag brag rgyal tshab kyis rwa sgreng bla brang la kha dan rgyab bskyur gyis gnod 'tshe thengs mang gnang byung / yin na'ang ngas khong bkrong rgyu'i ngan gshom byas pa rtsa ba nas med/ khong nga gnyis bla ma slob ma'i dam tshig 'di lta ⑫ 〈〈twa la'itā ma'i rnam tharanyi〉bodar+yāg gi shog grangs ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃl gsal/— 102 —

bu yod bzhin du sku srog la gnod 'tshe byed pa dpe ga la srid zhus pa yin/ ⑩ de rjes stag brag shog khas zhu bsher thengs gnyis tsam blangs te rwa sgreng bla brang gis srid skyong stag brag gi mdun du 'bar mdel bskyal tshul dang / srid skyong stag brag ri khrod du 'gro ba'i skabs dang bstun nas stod lung khri zam du sgug brgyab te stag brag bkrong rtsis byas tshul/ bka' blon lha 0klur me mda' brgyab ste gsod rtsis byas tshul sogs ma nyes kha g.yogs mang tsam byas/ de la rgyal zur rwa sgreng gis don gnad re re bzhin la lan btab gnang ste ‘‘ngas bstan srid la gnod pa'i las ka gang yang byas med la/ gsham 'og gi ser skya dpon rigs dang zhabs 'bring rnams la'ang gang ci'i bslab bya yang yang byed kyi yod ces gsal bshad gnang /'on kyang kho pa tshos rwa sgreng rin po che'i gtam la nyan 'jog byed ga la srid/ btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brang pa tshos de ltar byed pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po che bkrongs nas bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur rgyu de yin pa rwa sgreng ltos phyogs kyis gsal por rtogs/ dus der rgyal zur rwa sgreng gis btson nas thar thabs byed ched dga' nye ser skya dpon rigs khri byang rin po 117dzī gsanābo/da gyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigasanyi〉deb :pa'i shog grangs—— 103 —

che dang / sa dbang ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma/ 'bum thang drung yig che mo chos 'phel thub bstan bcas so sor phyag bris re dang0skyabs rten gzi cha re btson bzung ba lung shar o rgyan rnam grol dang shar rtse ye shes thub bstan brgyud bskur gnang mdzad kyang / btson bzung ba gnyis kyis yi ge de gsum khungs so sor ma bskyal bar shod 'gag gzim chung la sprad pas stag brag shog kha'i byed gte dmag spyi skal tshul dang / shod mgron skal bzang ngag dbang gnyis kyis rgyal zur rwa sgreng la do dam nan tan byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ phyogs mtshungs bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i thog rgyal zur rwa sgreng la dngos gzhi'i nyes tshad ji gcod skor gros bsdur byed skabs stag brag shog kha'i byed gte sne mgron thub bstan legs smon gyis khrims yig deb gcig khyer yong nas nag can khrag sbyor gyi zhal lce zhes pa las lung drangs te/ rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi spyan 'bras gnyis ka 'don rgyu'i gros 'go bton par mgron gnyer che mo ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan gyis rgyab skyor byas te khrims gcod nan po byed dgos zhes brjod/ 'on kyang ser skya dpon rigs khag gcig dang / lhag don se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po dang 'thus mis 'di 'dra e 'gab ces mos ma thun med pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ tshogs zhugs 'thus mi mang che bas de'i skor gros bsdur ma byas pa ma zad/ gcig mjug gnyis — 104 —

mthud kyis chogs 'dur ma bsdad par rtse ltag sgo rgyab dang /bde yangs shar sogs la chab gsang gtong bar 'gro khul byas/des na stag brag shog khas ser skya dpon rigs mang che ba dang /lhag/ par du gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po las zur dang 'thus mi tshos kho pa tsho'i byed thabs de rigs la mos mthun mi byed pa gsal por mthong ste g.yo thabs gzhan zhig la brten nas sdig nyes kyi dmigs yu'/ 'grub thabs byas/ de nas / nyin shas song mtshams rgyal zur rwa sgreng sku gzugs bde mi na byung bas btson srung ba gnyis kyis rwa sgreng la snyung gzhi bzhes tshu‘ro skor tshogs 'dur snyan seng zhus pa ltar shod mgron skal bzang ngag dbang gi lta rtog 'og sman rtsis khang gi mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gis rgyal zur rwa sgreng la phyag rtsa gzigs par phebs nas ‘‘snyung gzhi rlung grib yin pas sman a gar so lnga mchod dgos/ de'ang 'brel yod kyis chog mchan gnang mtshams gzhi nas phul chog mi ces gsungs/rgyal zur rwa sgreng gis kyang rlung grib ni ngari rgyun nad yin pas a gar so lnga mang tsam gnang rogs zhes re 'dun ya/nga yang zhus/ ‘‘nyin de'i dgong dro'i chu chu+od bzhi pa tsam la shod mgron skal bzang ngag dbang gis a gar so lnga yin zhes sman ril bu gsum shog bur bsgril nas btson srung ba gnyis la sprad thog sman/ 'di a gar so lnga yin pas sha khu'i thang gis sman rta — 105 —

byas te thengs rer ril bu re re byas te 'bul dgos zhes bkod mngags byas pa ltar bcan srung ba gnyis kyis dgong dro'i chu tshod lnga pa tsam la phag sha btsos pa'i khu bas sman rta byas te thengs gnyis phul bas rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi skung gzhi je lod du song zha gong gsal de'i thog nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng skung gzhi bzhes rjes btsan dga' shog kha'i byed gte tshos go skabs de dang bstun nas dug phul ba zhig yin pa gsal por mthong thub /gang yin zer na/ bod sman gyi shes bya cung zad yod pa'i mi su 'dra zhig gis kyang sha khus sman rta byas nas gtong ba'i rlung sman a gar so lnga zhes pa ni rtsa ba nas med pa shes rtogs thub pas yin/ nyin de'i sa srib mtshams la shod mgron skal bzang ngag dbang slar yang btson khang gi sgo 'gram du yong nas sman phul min dang skung gzhi'i skor 'dri rtsad byas par lung shar o rgyan rnam grol dang shar rtse ye shes thub bstan gyis sman phag sha'i khu bas rta byas te phul zin tshul dang / rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi skung gzhi je lod du phyin pa'i skor snyan seng zhus/ de rjes kho pas ‘‘sman lhag ma ril bu gcig pu de'ang 'bul dgos ’ zhes brjod pa ltar gong gsal btson srung ba gnyis kyis ril bu lhag ma de phul 'phral snyung gzhi je sdug tu song ste skyug ldang 122dzo gsanābo/da kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigasata〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs—— 106 —

gnang ba las skyug mi thub pa dang / ljags dbugs hal zhing sku gzugs bzhugs mi tshugs par gyur stabs ‘‘bde skyid gling kha nas rgya gar ba'i sman pa skad btang ste khab gcig rgyag rogs ’ zhes gsungs kyang btsan dga' shog kha'i byed gte shod mgron skal bzang ngag dbang gis ‘‘nam gung la khab rgyag mkhan ga la yod/ snang ba skyid drags pa red ’ ces brjod nas kha ya ma byas pa red/ don du kho pas rwa sgreng gi sku srog skyob thabs med pa ni gsal por rtogs/ de nas nam phyed yol tsam gyi chu tshod dang po tsam la rwa sgreng rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs/ skabs der rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkrong tshul skor bshad tshul mi 'dra ba mang tsam byung ba ste/ la las mgul du dar brdzangs brgyab ste bkrongs pa red zer ba dang / la las pho mtshan gyi 'bras bu btsir te bkrongs pa red zer ba/ la las dug phul te bkrongs pa red zer/ don du shod tshul de rigs 'gal ba med cing / skabs der btsan dga' shog khas thabs sna tshogs spyad nas bkrongs pa ni smos med red/ phyis rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkrong skabs gsung ngan chen po shor ba srung bya bod dmag la las thos byung zer ba dang / sku gdung la brtag skabs zhal dang shangs nang nas khrag mang po don pa'ang mi mang pos mthong ba red/ rgyal zur rwa sgreng gshegs rjes btson srung ba gnyis kyis rtse phyag dar han thub bstan thar — 107 —

'dod la snyan seng zhus/ de'i sang nyin tshogs 'du'i thog rtse phyag dar han dang / srung cha'i 'go 'dzin shod mgron skal bzang ngag dbang gnyis kyis snyung gzhi'i brgyud rim dang /sman bcos byed lugs/ mthar gshegs tshul sogs sngon tshud nas rdzun sgrig byas pa ltar snyan seng zhus rjes/ tshogs 'dus rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi sku gdung rags rgyab a phar sprod rgyu'i thag gcod byas/ de'i thog nas btsan dga' shog khas rgyal zur rwa sgreng la 'khon 'dzin gang 'dra byed min gsal po rtogs thub/ lung shar o rgyan rnam grol dang / shar rtse ye shes thub bstan sogs nas stag brag shog kha'i bkod mngags ltar/ rwa sgreng bkrong ba'i bya ba nang zhugs stabs kho pa gnyis la gzengs bstod du lha sa'i mi dpon gyi go gnas dang rdzong gzhis gang legs sprad/ skabs der lha sa'i nang gang sar khyab pa'i dmangs gzhas su ‘‘phu dkrugs mda' dkrugs bzo mkhan/ bdud phrug min na gang yin/ ra pho bsad pa'i sdig glar/ lha sa'i mi dpon sprad song ’ zer ba ltar ro/de rjes rwa sgreng ltos phyogs kyi mi sna gtso gras khag la khrims gcod byed phyogs skor srid skyong stag brag gis chog mchan bkod pa ltar/ rwa sgreng bla brang gitshode snga'i 'dzin dbang mtha' dag rang 'jags las/ gsar chod chos gzhis yongs rdzogs gzhung bzhes dang / yang srid ngos 'dzin — 108 —

skabs tshogs chen sprul sku'i gdan thob tsam las rgyal sprul ho thog thu'i go gnas dang thob thang tshang ma med pa bzos shing /de bzhin rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang /mkhar rdo bla ma skal bzang thub bstan gnyis la rta lcag tsha na btang thog nor gling sku srung dmag sgar 'gram du btson khang gsar rgyag gis tshe btson du bcug pa dang / bya bral dge bshes bu bla ma dang / rtse gnya' sprul sku/ ja tshul sde pa/dkon gnyer byams pa don grub sogs la rta lcag btang thog tshe sgo tshe lcags brgyab ste zhol dpal sding btson khang du bcugade bzhin 'brel yod grwa rigs 'ga' zhig la'ang nyes chad drag po btang / mdor na thengs 'dir rgyal gces stobs shugs la rdung rdeg tshabs chen phog pa dang / kha bral ring lugs pas bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur/rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkrongs pa'i gnas tshul phyir khyab rjes bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs dang / lhag par du dgom/ sde khag gi dge 'dun pa rnams sdug bsngal gyi khung por lhungs/bka' shag nas rwa sgreng gi sku phung rags rgyab a phar rtsis sprod rgyu byas kyang / rgyal gces ser skya mang tshogs kyis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs mang tshogs kyi re 'dun ltar sku gdung rtse shar chen lcog nas bzhi sde dgon du gdan drangs/skabs der sku gdung gdan 'dren zhu mi bzhi sde dgon gyi grwa pa — /09 —

sogs kyis sku gdung gi zhal dang shangs tshang ma nas khrag mang po don pa gsal por mthong / de nas nang bstan chos lugs kyi rgyun srol ltar nyin shas ring dad ldan mang tshogs dang /dgon sde khag gi dge 'dun par gdung mjal btang/rgyal zur rwa sgreng rtse shar chen lcog tu btson 'jug byed pa'i skabs der rwa sgreng dgon du sgo thel srung mkhan kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi dmag mi bcu drug bzhag pa de dag gis las sne dang grwa dmangs la don med dbang yod tshad med btang ba dang / lhag par du dgon par gso sbyong 'tshog skabs chos lugs kyi srol rgyun ltar phyi mi yar yong mi chog kyang bod dmag kyis rang snang gar shar gyis nang du 'dzul yong ba/ grwa dmangs la gshe gshe btang ba sogs brnyas bcos tshad med byas stabs grwa dmangs bzod thabs med par bod dmag la rgol lan bslog rgyu'i grabs byas/ dus der rwa sgreng dgon pa'i las sne gtso gras mkhan po grags pa chos 'phel dang /dbu mdzad bgres pa blo bzang mkhas grub/ dbu mdzad gzhon pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ zhal ngo bgres gzhon sogs kyis grwa dmangs la ‘‘da lta nga tsho'i bla ma khrid zin pa dang / bla brang phyi nang la sgo thel brgyab zin pas khyed tshos de ltar byas tshe dgon pa gtor brlags 'gro rgyu dang / grwa rigs mang po shi rmas yong rgyu las med pas dmag 'thab rtsa ba nas byed mi — 110 —

rung zhes kha ta bslab bya yang yang byas rung / grwa dmangs rnams kyis khong khro chen po byas te ‘‘bod dmag gis nga tshor brnyas bcos 'di lta bu byas pas bzod sgom rtsa ba nas byed thub pa mi 'dug ’ ces brjod/ de rjes grwa dmangs kyis thabs shes sna tshogs spyad de rwa sgreng spro khang gi sgo thel gtor nas me mda' bton thog nyin de ga'i nam phyed yol tsam du bod dmag dang me mda' rgyag res byas te dmag 'thab byas mthar srung bya kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi bod dmag yod tshad tshang ma bsad/ yang bshad tshul gzhan zhig la rwa sgreng gi zhabs 'bring dang grwa rigs kyis bod dmag gi 'go dmag la lto dang chang rag mang po bster nas dmag mi tshang ma ra bzi rjes sdeb bsad btang ba red zer/ skabs der grwa dmangs kyis g.yaso g.yon gyi ri steng dang / 'gro lam gtso bo khag la 'dzing rags bzos te bod dmag dang dmag 'thab bya rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ dus der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis byang spyir yig skyel a drung zhig btang ba de grwa dmangs kyi lag tu thebs/ yi ge'i nang byang rgyud khul du grwa rigs yul gyar dang 'grul bzhud byed mkhan yod rigs bzung gsod byed dgos pa'i bka' phab yod stabs rwa sgreng gi grwa dmangs dang zhabs 'bring rnams sngar bas 'khon 'dzin ches cher skyes pa red/ gong gsal gyi gnas tshul rnams bod sa gnas srid — 111 —

gzhung gis shes 'phral rwa sgreng du dmag mi 'bor chen btang nas drag gnon byed dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar/ kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub dang / dmag grangs nyis brgya tham pas bzhon rta rang sgrig thog me mda' sbag sbag che ba gnyis sogs deng rabs5can/ gyi go lag cha tshang thogs nas 'bri gung rtsa zhol chu brgyud shar ngos ma/sa rwa sgreng dgon du dpung 'jug byas/ nga dang rgyal rtse dmag sgar gyi ru dpon phun tshogs g.yu rgyal dang ṭ+wāṃ rkang dmag nyis brgya tham pas me mda' sbag/ sbag che ba gcig dang me skyos/sa gcig sogs dmag mi rnams go lag rang sgrig thog 'phan po sgo la nas gzhung lam brgyud rwa sgreng phyogs su dpung 'jug byas/ de bzhin dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul dang rim bzhi zhwa sgab nga/ blo gsal don grub sanyis kyis 'go gtso byas te rtse shod bka' gsum gyi sku tshab rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs dang / shod mgron thub bstan bsam mchogabaka' mgron khri smon sras/ de min mtsho sgo sras don grub tshe ring / bka' mgron dpal lhun sras/ dmag spyi khang gi las bya las tshan pa lhun grub tshul khrims/ shod drung nya smon pa sogs dang bod dmag lnga bcu skor bcas rwa sgreng du bskyod/kho pa tsho snga rjes su rwa sgreng gi nye 'gram du 'byor skabs bcom mdo nas rwa sgreng phyogs su 'gro sa'i lam 'phrang la 'dzing rags — 112 —

brgyab yod pa dang / rwa sgreng dgon gyi sa/yas g.yon du 'dzing rags mang po brgyab yod pa ma zad/ pho rong thang du'ang dmag sgar btsugs te rwa bla'i zhabs 'bring dang / khams rigs/ 'brog pa bcas kyis mtshon cha khyer nas bsdad yod tshul dang / lhag par du drag rtsal che ba'i ga rgya 'gram nag gi a phrug mang po yod tshul gyi gtam gleng thos rjes dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul dang / rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa sogs dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te rim bzhi zhwa sgab pas gra sgrig yag po ma byas na zhabs 'dren zhu yi red ces smras/ de nas dmag spyi ngo las so gas kyis nang gros byas te 'bri gung rtsa zhol brgyud skyod mkhan kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi rta dmag rnams sngon du 'byor yod med lta zhib byed par rtse drung blo gros chos 'dzin dang /rtse drung blo gros chos 'phel sogs 'go dmag khag gcig sngon du btang / don du kha dang dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon shud khud pa 'jam/ dbyangs mkhas grub sogs rta dmag nyis brgya skor snga sa nas rwa sgreng dgon du 'byor zin pa red/ kha dang nga/mag sgar gyi rta dmag rnams rwa sgreng du 'byor skabs grwa dmangs dang / bla brang gi zhabs 'bring mang pos lag tu mtshon cha khyer nas 'gog rgol dmag 'thab yun ring byas stabs grwa pa dang bod dmag phyogs gnyis ka'i khongs nas shi rmas 'ga' zhig byung zhing / mthar rwa sgreng gi grwa dmangs dang zhabs — 113 —

'bring rnams mtshon cha zhan la dmag 'thab kyi nyams myong rtsa ba nas med pa dang / bod dmag mi 'bor mang la deng rabs can gyi mtshon cha mang po yod stabs grwa dmangs rnams la pham nyes chen po byung ste bros byol du mi 'gro thabs med byung ba red/bod dmag gis rwa sgreng blangs rjes snying rje spu tsam med par nyes med mi ser mang po'i khang pa dang ra lug sems can bcas pa mer bsregs/ de nas bod dmag rnams dgon pa'i nang 'dzul te gcan gzan stogs pa sha la rngam pa bzhin khang pa'i sgo dang sge'u khung dang / cha sgam yod tshad bcag‘‘rten gtso jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i drung gi gser kong dang /lha khang gzhan gyi gser kong bzhi/ dngul kong grangs med bcas rdo brdung btang nas dmag mis khyer ba red/ dpe cha sa steng du g.yugs nas dpe ras khyer ba dang / dpe cha'i steng du snum nag gsho ba/ gtsug lag khang du rta bong 'jug pa/ lha khang ji/ khug kyog gang sar skyag gcin gtong ba/lhung bzed nang skra 'khru ba/ dgon nang du bud med nyar ba sogs mdor na nang pa sangs rgyas pa lta ci/ phyi rol mu stegs pas kyang byed mi srid pa'i ngan rgu tshang ba'i bya spyod yod tshad bod dmag de tsho'i gras kyis byas/ kho tshos da dung grwa shag nang gi sku sa la brdabs nas bcag rjes grwa pa 'bar khog gcig bsad yod ces gtor brlags btang / — 114 —

gnas tshul de tshor bsam/ gzhigs byas na grwa pas 'gog rgol ma byas thabs med red/’ ⑫ da dung rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / zhal thang me thub ma sogs rin thang bral ba'i gna' rdzas gal che mang po'ang dmag mis rku 'khyer byas shing /kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag kho nas rwa sgreng dgon dang bla brang gi dngos rigs bcom 'phrog byas pa khal g.yag nyis brgya tsam gyi rgyab chas lha sa khul du dbor nas tshong sgyur byas pa red/ de bzhin dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul dang /rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa blo gsal don grub ngo las kyis rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi 'brog khag gi 'bri g.yag dang / chibs chen sogs rta drel sum cu tsam/ gsang spyod nang sbas pa'i gser leb lcug shing sgam bcu gnyis/ rgya dngul rta rmig ma dang / rgya dngul sa phag ṭam dkar bcas ko btum brgyab pa'i do po nyi shu rtsa gsum/ dar gos chen dang gru'u tsi ltebs sgril/ me mda' dang mde'u sogs rtsa che'i dngos rigs yongs rdzogs gzhung bzhes thog lha sar dbor ba red/dus mtshungs rgyal gces grwa pa gtso gras 'ga' zhig bros byol du song stabs kha dang ru dpon gsum dang / brgya dpon dam chos/ lding dmag sum cu skor/ de bzhin rgyal rtse ṭ+wāṃ9padzo gsanābo/da kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dbyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 5pa'i shog grangs—— 115 —

dmag sgar gyi dmag mi nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas 'dzin bzung byed par btang bas grwa rigs khag gcig bros shor ba dang /'ga' zhig 'dzin bzung byas/ zla ba chos rab sogs grwa rigs mi bdun lha sar khrid nas khrims gcod nan po byas pas la la khrims 'og tu shi ba dang / la la rgyang 'bud btang /drel pa mkhas grub dmar gsod btang nas mgo lag rnams sangs rgyas chos rab kyi mjing par bskur te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa mtshon byed kyi dar chen thog bkal/gzhan yang ye shes zla ba dang / bsam gtan/ mthar phyin sogs rgyal gces grwa rigs rnams la khrims gcod tsha nan btang ba sogs mdor na 'dzam gling yul gru kun tu grags che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i gnas chen rwa sgrong de nyid gshin rje'i khrims ra dang mtshungs par gyur pa'o/drug pa/ rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkrongs rjes btsan dga' shog khas bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgrur pa'i skor/stag brag shog khas dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i bsam 'dun ltar/ thabs brgya byus stong gi sgo nas rgyal zur — 116 bhe

rwa sgreng bkrongs pa dang / rgyal gces stobanu/ shugs la rdung deg tshabs chen btang ste bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur/ ‘‘1947lo'i lo mjug tu 'bras spyis ri car san brgyud bka' shag la brjod gsal/ rgya nag nas rwa sgreng zing 'khrug thad la dbyin phyogs dang rgya phyogs bar gyi 'khrug rtsod yin yu+ol tshags par bkram 'dug pas bod nas kyang rwa bla'i yong rkyen dang / rang btsan yin skor gyi tshags par bkram dgos kyi 'dug zer ba sogs kyi ngan skul byas pa red/ ⑫gong gsal skad cha dum bu 'di'i thog nas kho pa tsho'i dmigs yul gtso bo gang yin gsal po mthong thub/ btsan dga' shog khas mngon sum 'dzems med kyis snga rjes su mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i spyod ngan rab dang rim pa spel ba ste/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me khyi (1946)lo'i zla 12par rgya gar ldi lir e she ya mi rigs ser po'i don gnad skor gyi tshogs 'du zhig skong 'tshog bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byed pa'i skabs der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du bed spyad de bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i lkog g.yo zhig bshams/ de yang lha sar bca' sdod dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab ri car san brgyud bka' shag la gsalaphye/ 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgya cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 5pa'i shog grangs 47la — 117 —

e she ya'i tshogs 'dur rgyal khab gzhan dang 'dra bar bod kyi sku tshab gtong dgos pa'i mgron brda zhig 'byor bas stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog khas kho pa tsho'i ‘‘bod rang btsan zer ba'i stong bsam de mngon du 'gyur ba'i go skabs shig byung song snyam nas dga' tshor chen pos sku tshab gtong rgyu'i khas len byas/ me khyi (1946)lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes shar du tshogs zhugs 'thus mi ngo las rnams shod 'gag tu bskongs te srid skyong stag brag sogs kyi bkod mngags ltar sne mgron thub bstan legs smon gyis ‘‘srid skyong stag brag gi bka' phebs dgongs don bzhin rgya gar ldi lir e she ya mi rigs ser po'i don gnad skor gyi tshogs 'dur bod gzhung nas sku tshab gtong rgyu gtan 'khel zin pas sku tshab tu tha'i ji bsam pho tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang / mkhan chung blo bzang dbang rgyal/ las byar bsam pho sras bstan 'dzin don grub dang / rtse drung kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ skad bsgyur ka shod sras don grub dang /las tshan skyid sbug dbang 'dus nor bu bcas bsko gzhag byas pa yin/ zhib phra'i byed sgo bka' shag gi bkod mngags ltar byed dgos 7yi zhes bka' sgrogs sbyang byas/ de bzhin chos lugs skor mkhyen rgya che ba'i 'bras spungs dge shes rig 'dzin gsal⑪/ 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lo sanabyadagazhi'i cha bdams bsgrigs〉〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs 29la — 118 —

bstan pa dang / dga' ldan dge bshes ngag dbang dpal ldan gnyis chos lugs shes bya'i skor blo 'dri yul du ched mngags btang / bo da kyi 'thus mi ngo las rnams lha sa nas ma thon gong srid skyong stag brag dang / bka' shag gi bka' 'brel ltar bod 'di chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su rgyal khab dngos su btsugs tshul dang / hor se chen rgyal po'i dus du sog bod dbar mchod yon gyi 'brel ba chags tshul/ phag gru dang / gtsang pa sde srid/ lhag par du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa mchog gis dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang dngos su btsugs tshul/ bod kyi btsan po rim byon dang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon gyis chos srid bskyangs tshul/ bod dang rgya nag gi sa mtshams dang / bod dang rgya gar gyi sa mtshams skor sogs nang don don tshan brgyad dgu tsam bkod pa'i yig cha zhig bzos te thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i thog khyer nas ‘‘bod rang btsan zer ba'i kho pa tsho'i dmigs yul de sgrub thub pa'i re stong bcangs/ de rjes me phag (1947)lo'i zla dang por bod gzhung gi 'thus mi ngo ma gnyis bka' shag tu bos nas gong gsal yig cha rnams sprad thog zhib gsal nang mol bslab bya mang po byas pa ma zad/ srid skyong stag brag gis thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i spyi khyab paṇ+ḍi ta 'ja' wa la ne he ru dang / tshogs 'du'i gra sgrig 'go 'dzin sa ro ca ni na ye — 119 d+ngha
