kru lha lcam/ tshogs 'du'i las bya a pa kro re dang a sdur ka lam bcas 'brel yod 'go 'dzin las bya so sor yi ge re dang skyabs zhu'i rten gser dang / rum gyi sa gdan/ snam rigs sogs bskur/ de bzhin rgya gar du bca' sdod dbyin gzhung sku tshab dang / 'bras spyi blon chen sogs la'ang yi ge dang gong gsal bzhin rten chas dngos rigs bskur/ me phag (1947)lo'i zla 1tshes 6nyin bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las rnams lha sa nas thon te 'bras ljongs brgyud rgya gar du bskyod dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar/ bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las drug lha sa nas gro mo'i phyogs su bskyod/ skabs der lha sar bca' sdod dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab ri car san gyis bka' shag la ‘‘e she ya tshogs 'du'i dpon rigs nas yi ge 'byor gsal/ tshogs 'du 'tshog yul du 'grems rgyu'i bod sa/zhung gi dar cha zhig 'phral du gnang skyong dang / gal te dar cha gnang chog med tshe gzhung dar che chung gi tshad dang tshos ris sogs kyi gnas tshul byung bstun ldi lir bzos chog ⑫ ces brjod pa ma zad/ kho pas da dung tshogs 'du 'tshog yul du rgyal khab khag gi dar cha 'grems rgyu gtan 'khel zin pas bod kyi dar cha yod tshe bod 'di rgyal khab dngos gsalagyi/ 〈〈bodashrī rig gnas lo gdapyad gagi'i khyu cha bdams bsgrigasata〉deb 2pa'i shog grangs 22la — 120 —

zhugs kyi gras yin pas chab srid thog khe phan che ba yod lugs skor ngan skul mang tsam byas/ srid skyong stag brag dang bka' shag gis ri car san gyi bsam 'char ltar gangs ri dang seng ge'i ri mo yod pa'i sngar yod bod dmag gi dmag dar de rgyal dar du brtsis nas dar cha gsar btsem byas pa ma zad/ dar cha'i ri mo'i 'grel bshad kyang bod dbyin yig rigs gnyis su bkod nas a drung rta shad ched gtong byas stabs 'thus mi ngo ma gnyis gro mo nas ma thon gong lag son byung ba red/skabs der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pas khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas 'thus mi ngo las btang ba'i gnas tshul de go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis shes 'phral skyon brjod dang bkag 'gog mtha' gcig tu byas/ 'on kyang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pas der nyan 'jog bya rgyu lta zhog de las ldog ste bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las la tar btang ste go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab ma 'byor gong bod kyi 'uthus mi ngo las ldi li gsar par 'byor ba byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las kyis srid skyong dang bka' shag gi bka' bkod ltar ka sbug nas 'phral du ldi lir bskyod/ kho pa tsho ldi lir 'byor skabs thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i gra sgrig las khungs kyi 'brel yod mi snas gnam gru'i babs thang du ched mngags bsu ba zhu bar 'ongs pa — 121 —

ma zad/ de'i sang nyin zhogs pa de rang la 'ja' wa la ne te ru dang / sa ro ca ne na ye kru lha lcam gnyis ched mngags bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las sdod gnas mgron khang du 'ongs nas 'tshams 'dri yang byas/ de bzhin ldi li gsar pa'i tshags par khag nang bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las rgya gar ldi li gsar par bslebs zin pa'i skor dril bsgrags shugs chen byas te bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las rnams thengs 'di'i tshogs zhugs rgyal khab khag gi sku tshab ngo ma'i gras yin lugs skor gyi gleng phyogs mang po bzos/ de rjes bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las tshos paṇ+ḍi ta ne he ru'i sar bcar nas srid skyong stag brag sogs kyi yi ge dang skyabs zhu'i dngos po rnams phul ba ma zad/ thengs 'di'i tshogs 'dur ched du gra sgrig byas pa'i ‘‘bod rang btsan ’ yin tshul gyi yig cha dang / rgya bod sa mtshams/ bod hin satsho mtshams sogs kyi nang don 'khod pa'i yig cha gzhir bzung ne he ru dang nang mol byas/ 'on kyang bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la ne ho rus ‘‘bod rang btsan zhes pa'i skor tshogs 'du'i thog gtam bshad bya rgyur mos mthun ma byas pa red/ne he rus ‘‘thengs 'di'i e she ya'i tshogs 'du thengs dang po rgya gar gyi sa thog tu 'tshogs pa red/ tshogs 'du 'di brgyud phan tshun ngo shes 'brel gtugs dang / gnas tshul spel res bya rgyu tsam las sa mtshams sogs srid don kyi skor sus kyang — 122 —

gleng na mi 'grigs la/ thag gcod kyang rtsa ba nas yong srid kyi ma red ’ ces brjod/e she ya mi rigs ser po'i don gnad skor gyi tshogs 'du dngos su 'tshog skabs tshogs zhugs sku tshab mi grangs sum brgya tsam yod cing / de'i nang e she ya rgyal khab che gras khag la sku tshab bzhugs yul stegs bu bcu re dang / bod kyi sku tshab la stegs bu bzhi sprad/ rgyal khab so so'i sku tshab gtso bo sdod gnas mdun lcog gi gdong ngos su pang leb thog rgyal khab kyi ming dang rgyal dar gyi ri mo bris yod la/ bod kyi sku tshab gtso bo'i mdun lcog gi gdong ngos su'ang pang leb thog gangs ri dang seng ge 'khod pa'i dar cha dang bod ces bris yod pa red/ de bzhin tshogs chen gyi kru'u zhi sdings cha'i rgyab ngos su sa bkra chen po zhig bkal yod pa 'di'i nang bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs ma yin par rang btsan rgyal khab cig yin pa gsal por bkod yod stabs go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab kran yan h+phan gyis thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i 'go 'dzin pa tshos bod 'di rgyal khab cig tu brtsis nas tshogs 'dur gdan drangs pa ma zad/ bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs nas kha phral ba'i sa bkra 'di lta bu zhig —bkal ba der skyon brjod dang ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ skabs der tshogs 'du'i 'go 'dzin tshos g.yo gtam mang po bshad de — 123 d+ngha

thengs 'di'i tshogs 'dur bod kyi sku tshab ni in dran dang /war dri/ i wan kri/ ka mi shan sogs dmangs khrod skyid sdug mthun tshogs kyis gdan drangs pa zhig yin pa las/ rgya gar srid gzhung gis gdan drangs pa rtsa ba nas ma yin la/sa bkra'i nang gi gnad don la'ang do snang rtsa ba nas ma byung zhes khungs lung med pa'i 'grel bshad mang tsam brgyab/ de rjes tshogs 'dus sa bkra der bzo bcos brgyab ste bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs cha shas shig yin pa'i lo rgyus gyi don dngos dang mthun pa'i sa bkra zhig mi bzo ka med byung ba ma zad/ bod kyi 'thus mis kyang ched mngags bzos te khyer yong ba'i gangs ri dang seng ge'i ri mo bkod pa'i dar cha de dngos su bkal ma nus pa red/ 'on kyang 〈〈bod rigs lo rgyus gnad bsdus 〉〉zhes pa sogs rgya yig gi rtsom yig mang po'i nang skabs der bod kyi gangs ri dang seng ge'i ri mo bkod pa'i dar cha de e she ya rgyal khab gzhan gyi dar cha dang mnyam du bkal ba red ces 'khod yod pas de ni lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang rtsa ba nas mi mthun pa zhig red snyam/ gong smos ltar go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab kyis gnad don de'i thad ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas par brten bod kyi 'thus mis tshogs 'du'i thog tu gtam bshad byed skabs bod dang rgya gar dbar chos phyogs kyi 'brel ba yod lugs dang / bod hin mi ge 124 —

rigs dbar la phan tshun 'brel ba che ba'i lo rgyus yun ring yod tshul/ thengs 'di'i tshogs 'dur gdan zhu gnang bar dga' po byung tshul sogs las ‘‘bod rang btsan yin lugs skor skad cha tshig gcig kyang shod ma nus pa dang / de bzhin tshogs chung khag bgos kyis gros bsdur byed skabs bod kyi thon khungs dang / so nam byed stangs/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba/shes rig sogs skor gyi gnas tshul bshad pa las btsan dga' shog khas bskur ba'i tshig tho'i nang gi skad cha tshig gcig kyang shod ma nus pa red/thengs 'di'i rngo+ogs 'du grol skabs tshogs zhugs sku tshab tsho'i 'dra par 'og tu ming dang / las 'gan/ lo rgyus mdor bsdus bcas 'khod pa'i deb gcig bzos nas sku tshab so sor sprad cing / tshogs 'du'i 'go 'dzin sa ro ca ne na ye kru lha lcam gyis bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las kho mo'i gzim shag tu ched mngags bos nas mi rer deb re sprad thog ‘‘khyed rang tsho bod la mtshon na/ bod zer ba gang du yod med tsam ma shes mkhan mang po yod pa red/ da lam e she ya tshogs 'du 'dir zhugs pa dang / par deb 'di bton pa nas bzung rgyal khab tshang mas bod ha go gi red/ de ni khyed tshor thob

pa'i 'bras bu red ⑫ ces brjod/ sa ro ca ne na ye kru lha lcam gyi skad cha dum bu de ni bod kyi 'thus mi rnams la sems gso btang ba zhig rang red/ mdor na/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og srid skyong stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog khas e she ya mi rigs ser po'i don gnad skor gyi tshogs 'du'i thog ched mngags 'thus mi ngo las drug tsam btang nas tshogs 'du'i thog ‘‘bod rang btsan 7yin lugs skor dril bsgrags byas te 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag dang /lhag par du e she ya rgyal khab khag gi rgyab skyor thob pa byas nas kho pa tsho'i bsam 'dun ji bzhin 'grub pa'i re ba byas kyang /don dngos su tshogs 'du'i thog e she ya rgyal khab sus kyang ‘‘bod rang btsan 7yin pa khas len ma byas stabs kho pa tshor sna rgyug tsha thag chod cig phog pa red/skabs der btsan dga' shog khas da dung mu mthud mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i ched du ‘‘hur brtson gyis bod dmag rgya skyed gtong bzhin yod pas tshod dpag ltar na spyi'i dmag grangs mi khri lnga tsam dang / lha sar bca' sdod pu li si mi grangs chig stong / de bzhin dbyin ji'i lag nas go mtshon nyo bzhin yod cing / mtshon cha khag dang po de ka sbug nas tshur gsal6/ 〈bodashrī rig gnaspolo sa dbyadagazhi'i cha bdamaspobasgrigad+ku〉deb 2pa'i shog grangag26la — 126 —

dbor bzhin yod pa red/ de'i khongs su me mda' sbag sbag che ba brgya tsam dang / me skyogs bcu/ me mda' ring mda' chig khri lhag tsam/ rang 'gul me mda' ring mda' brgya/rdzas mdel do po brgya tsam yod pa de rnams tshod dpag byas na zla rjes mar lha sar 'byor gyi yod pa red/ de min go thos su rgya gar du yod pa'i dbyin ji'i go mtshon yongs rdzogs bod la btsong rtsis yod pa dang / de'i rin 'bab tu sa cha khag gcig bogs mar gtong ba'am yang na gser sa phag sprod rtsis yod pa red/’ ⑫ srid skyong stag brag sogs kyis kho pa tsho'i dmigs yul mngon du 'gyur ba'i ched du dbyin ji'i mtshon cha mang po nyos te bod dmag rgya skyed btang ba dang phyogs mtshungs rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan dang / chang khyim thub bstan tshe dpal/ rim bzhi spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel/ skad bsgyur dbus mda' zur khang sras lha dbang stobs rgyal bcas las grub pa'i bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa zer ba sgrig 'dzugs dang ngo las bsko gzhag thog khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas a ri sogs rgyal khab khag la 'gro chog pa'i lag khyer dang / a ri'i spyi khyab ru man dang / dbyin gzhung gong ma 'jo je/ rgya gar gyi spyi khyab srid blon paṇ+ḍi ta ne he ru sogs la thang ka 'tshem drub ma re dang / mjal dar/4me 〈〈bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus yig cha phyogs bsdus〉〉rgya yig shog grangs 257la gsal/— 127 —

tā la'i bla ma'i sku par bris ma re sogs bskur nas me phag ( 1947)lo'i zla 9tshes 11nyin lha sa nas rdog thon gyis rgya gar dang / a ri/ dbyin ji sogs su btang / don du skabs der bod nas phyi 'gro thon khungs gtso bo bal dang /rnga ma/ khul tsid/ pags rigs/ gla rtsi/ khrag rwa sogs yul zog tshong bsgyur byas pa'i spyi'i rin thang a ri'i sgor khri sum cu tsam yang ma zin stabs ched mngags tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa gtong dgos pa'i rgyu ma/tshan ci yang med/ kho pa tsho'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni skabs de'i go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi phyi 'brel pu'u yi dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs nang 'khod pa ltar/ ‘‘rgyal spyi'i thog tu bod 'di rang btsan yin pa'i rnam pa bstan rgyu dang gcig krung dbyang gi tshod 'dzin 'khur mi dgos par rang mos kyi sgo nas 'dzam gling rgyal khab gzhan dang 'brel gtugs bya rgyu dang gnyis/ a ri stobs shugs che bas rgyab skyor 'thob re byed pa dang gsum/ bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs dang tshong pa rnams 'brel ba dam zab yod pas tshong khe yong re byed pa dang bzhi/ mu mthud dmag mkho'i yo chas nyo sgrub bya rgyu dang lnga bcas yin stabs tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa'i ming khyer ba tsam las don du chab srid kyi dmigs yul sgrub ched red/7 rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pas gtsos pa'i bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa rgya gar du — 128 —

'byor rjes rgya gar gyi spyi khyab srid blon paṇ+ḍi ta ne he ru dang thugs 'phrad byas te rgya gar dang bod gnyis lo ngo stong phrag mang po'i sngon nas chos dang / shes rig thad 'brel ba chen po yod lugs dang / da cha rgya gar rang btsan thob pas rgya gar dang bod dbar chings yig bzhag dgos tshul/ phan tshun mtha' mtshams sa 'dres shin tu che bas zhi don mnyam gnas bya rgyu ha cang gal 'gangs che tshul/ de bzhin tshong don skor sogs nang mol bsam gros mang tsam byas/ dus der rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde lda na sogs bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa zer ba rgya gar du 'byor ba'i gnas tshul de go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis shes 'phral bod sa gnas srid gzhung la bod kyi rngo+ong don brtag zhib tshogs pa zer bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi lag khyer thogs nas phyi'i rgyal khab gang zhig la'ang skyod mi chog pa'i bka' phab pa ma zad/ rgya gar du bca' sdod go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi lo'o gzhung tshab che mo bas 1947lo'i zla 12tshes 21nyin rgya gar gyi spyi khyab srid blon ne he ru dang phan tshun thugs 'phrad byes te ‘‘dbyin ji'i go mtshon bod du dbor 'dren byas pa'i lhag lus rgya gar du yod pa rnacims brtag zhib thog dbor 'jug mi chog pa dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rang 'tsham byas nas sprad pa'i phyi rgyal du 'gro chog pa'i — 129 —

lag khyer khas len byed mi chog ’ ces brjod/ de'i lan du srid blon ne he rus/ ‘‘dbyin ji dang rgya gar dbar srid dbang sprod len byed pa'i skabs su rgya gar du go mtshon nyo tshong bya rgyu ni ha cang las sla po zhig red/ gnas tshul de rigs yod med brtag dpyad zhus chog bod rigs rgya gar du yong dus phyi rgyal du 'gro chog pa'i lag khyer 'khur mi dgos/ dbyin jir 'gro chog pa'i lag khyer ni rgya gar du bca' sdod dbyin ji'i mtho rim kron yon gyis chog mchan 'god dgos pa las/ rgya gar srid gzhung gis chog mchan 'god dgos med ’ ces brjod/ de rjes rgya gar gyi spyi khyab srid blon ne he rus ‘‘bod 'di krung go'i rang skyong gi sa cha zhig red ces brjod par go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi gzhung tshab che mo bas ‘‘rang skyong zhes pa de rang btsan rgyal khab cig ma yin pas bod kyi rang skyong dbang cha de krung go'i rtsa khrims nang 'khod pa'i dbang cha de rang la tshod 'dzin byed dgos ’ zhes brjod/ de nas zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa'i ngo las rnams rgyal khab gzhan du 'gro bar 'dzam gling rgyal khab mang che bas bod 'di rang btsan gyi rgyal khab cig yin pa'i khas len ma byas stabs rgyal khag gzhan du 'gro ba'i lag khyer dang lag dngul thad dka' ngal mang po 'phrad pa dang /lhag don go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bka' tsha nan — 130 —

phab pa sogs la brten rgya gar nas thon te shang kang dang /hrang had brgyud go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi rgyal sa nan cing du me phag (1947)lo'i zla 11tshes 21nyin 'byor/kho pa tsho nan cing du 'byor rjes sne len dang 'brel gtugs gros mol gyi las 'gan tshang ma bod sog u yon lhan khang nas khur ba dang / tsung thung cang ce hre sogs kyis mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma zad/ ‘‘a me ri ka dang / dbyin ji sogs rgyal khab khag la bskyod na 'gro song che ba tsam las/ phan pa gang yang med/ lha rab byung na bod la phyin log gnang na legs shos dang / gal srid nges par du gong gsal rgyal khab khag la bskyod dgos tshe go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi lag khyer 'khur dgos pa dang / rgyal khab gang du 'byor yang krung go'i gzhung tshab khang yod pas khyed tshor gang ci'i thad rogs ram thob nges red ces ’ gsungs/ zhwa sgab pa sogs tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa'i ngo las tshos a ri dang dbyin ji sogs la 'gro ba'i gron dngul a ri'i sgor mo khri nyis brgya tsam dgos pa'i re ba bton yang go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis grangs 'bor ha cang mang bas dka' ngal che ba yod tshul bshad de lag dngul a ri'i sgor khri lnga tsam sprod rgyu'i khas len byas/ dus der zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs kyis bod sog u yon lhan khang brgyud 'thus mi ngo las bod du — 131 —

phyir log bya rgyu yin tshul snyan seng zhus/ don du kho pa tsho nan cing du sdod skabs lkog tu a me ri ka dang / dbyin ji/ rgya gar sogs kyi gzhung tshab dang ngan 'brel gyis phyi rgyal du 'gro chog pa'i lag khyer len rgyu dang dngul lor brje res bya rgyu sogs kyi byed sgo mtha' dag yongs su grub/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis zhwa sgab pa sogs kyi rdzun gtam rnams bden par mngon nas kho pa tshor phyi rgyal gyi dngul lor dang /gnang skyes gang legs gnang ba ma zad/ ched mngags gnam gru btang nas shang kang du bskyal/ 'on kyang kho pa tshos sngon tshud nas 'char 'god gra sgrig byas pa ltar/ sa byi (1948)lo'i zla 5tshes 17nyin shang kang brgyud a rir bskyod/dus der a rir bca' sdod go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi gzhung tshab che mo bas ngag thog nas gsal bsgrags spel te/‘‘1 bod sa gnas la rang sger gyis phyi phyogs su 'brel ba byed pa'i dbang chagyumed/ 2 zhwa sgab pa sogs la a ri'i srid gzhung dang tshong don gros mol byed pa'i dbang cha med/2 shang kang du bca' sdod a ri'i spyi khyab las don khang nas zhwa sgab pa sogs kyi lag khyer thog mchan 'god ma byas gong du shang kang du bca' sdod rang rgyal gyi dmigs bsal mngags gtong pa ko'o la brda lan ma byas pa gang yin nam/ 4 a ri'i srid gzhung gis krung gor bod kyi bdag thob dbang cha yod — 132 ge

pa khas len bzhin du bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mchan 'god byas pa'i lag khyer khas blangs pa ni rtogs dka' ba'i gnad don zhig red/ 'di ni shang kang du bca' sdod a ri'i spyi khyab don gcod pa mi sger gyi nor 'khrul yin mi srid pas a ri'i srid gzhung gis bod kyi gnad don thad 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur la 'gyur ldog byung ba ma yin nam/ de don gsal bshad gnang dgos ’ zhes brjod/ de'i lan du a ri'i srid blon rma she 'ar gyis ‘‘a ris bod kyi gnad don thad la krung go srid gzhung gi bsam 'char la btsi bkur dang lag bstar bya rgyu yin/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi las don de'i skor gtso gnyer byed mkhan gyis brjod gsal du shang kang du bca' sdod a ri'i spyi khyab don gcod khang gis zhwa sgab pa sogs la spyir btang gi bri shog thog a rir bskyod chog pa'i mchan 'god byas pa las yul skor du bskyod chog pa'i lag khyer thog mchan 'god byas med pas gnad don des krung gos bod la 'dzin pa'i bdag dbang la gnod 'tshe yong mi srid pa zhig red ’ ces brjod/de bzhin go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis dbyin ji sogs la'ang gong gsal ltar 'brel gtugs dang ngag thog nas gsal bsgrags spel bas dbyin ji'i phyi 'brel pu'u yis de don dgongs sel zhus pa red/gong gsal ltar go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis — 133 —

4bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pas khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas e ri dang / dbyin ji sogs la bskyod par ngo rgol dang 'brel yod rgyal khab khag la'ang gsal bsgrags spel stabs zhwa sgab pa sogs ngo las tshang ma ci bya gtol med du gyur te tshong las kyi byed sgo 'ga' zhig spel thub pa tsam las rgyal khab khag gis bod kyi srid don thad rgyab skyor byed mi nus pas kho pa tsho'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul de sgrub ma thub pa red/ de rjes kho pa tsho a ri dang dbyin ji sogs la zla shas ring bsdad de mthar sa byi ( 1948) lo'i zla 12par h+pha ran si dang / dbyi tā li/sud si/ rgya gar sogs brgyud bod du phyir log ma byed ka med byung ba red/dus der rgyal nang gi gnas tshul la'ang rtsa ba'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba ste/ krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og gi krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis le'u hren g.yul 'gyed dang / phin cin g.yul 'gyed/ ho'e had g.yul 'gyed bcas la rgyal kha rlabs chen thob rjes 'bri chu brgal te lho khul du dpung skyod byas pa ma zad/nub byang dang / lho nub sa khul du'ang dpung skyod byas stabs go min tang srid gzhung 'di bzhin rlung gi dbus na gnas pa'i sgron me lta bur gyur/ mes rgyal skam sa chen po yongs su bcings 'grol gtong ba'i skabs der a ri dang dbyin ji — 134 —

btsan rgyal ring lugs pas mngon sum 'dzems med kyi sgo nas dmag don mi sna btang ste mtsho sngon dang mdo khams sogs sa khul du yod pa'i go min tang gi dmag mi lhag ma rnams la byus bkod byas te gung khran tang la ngo rgol byas/ skabs der bod du yod pa'i a ri dang / dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa tsho dngangs skrag rab tu skyes nas bya thabs dben pa'i gnas su gyur/ dus der ri car san gyis srid skyong stag brag dang d+nghabaka' shag la gsang gtam yin khul gyis lha sar gung khran tang gi so pa dang sgrig 'dzugs mang po yod tshul skor brjod pa ma zad/ de dag tshang ma lha sa nas 'bral du phyir 'bud ma byas na phyi nang lag 'brel gyis bod btsan bzung byed nyen shin tu che bas 'phral du phyir 'bud byed dgos zhes ngan skul byas/kho pa'i gtam de btsan dga' shog kha'i bsam 'dun dang yongs su mthun stabs kho pa tshos lkog tu nang mol byas te sa glang ( 1949) lo'i zla 7tshes 8nyin ka lon sbug rgyang bsgrags babs tshugs thog nas lha sar bca' sdod go min tang gi don gcod khang 'phral du phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / phyogs mtshungs nyin de rang du lha sa'i srang lam gang sar bod dmag bkram ste lha sar bca' sdod go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi don gcod khang gi las don mi sna yongs rdzogs gza' 'khor gnyis nang phyir 'then byed — 135 —

dgos zer ba ma zad/ dpon rigs sdod gnas khag tu bod dmag gis mtha' bskor ba dang / phyi phyogs dang sbrag tar gyi 'brel ba yongs su bcad/ de bzhin go min tang srid gzhung gi 'grim 'grul pu'u khongs kyi sbrag tar khang gtor ba dang /shi'i thas krang la gri brgyab ste rmas skyon phog skabs der lha sar yod pa'i rgya rigs tshong pa dang / tha na dgon par yod pa'i rgya bla ma mang por yang gnod skyon tshabs chen phog pa red/de nas nyin gnyis tsam song rjes rgya gar ldi li'i tshags par khag thog lha sa'i zhib gsal gnas tshul bkod de gang sar dril bsgrags byas/ mthar go min tang gi dpon rigs dang nang mi sogs rgya gar brgyud phyir log byed dgos byung ba red/thengs 'dir lha sar yod pa'i rgya rigs yongs rdzogs phyir 'bud byed pa'i don rkyen 'di'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul ni a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod du yod pa'i kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brang par shog sbubs rlung 'tshang gis go min tang srid gzhung la kha'i nyi ma lta bur gyur pa'i go skabs de dang bstun nas bod 'di mes rgyal nas kha bral btang ste btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i mi ser spel yul du bsgyur rgyu de red/ skabs der shin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gis 'go brjod du 〈〈phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul pas krung go'i mnga' khongs bod 'di khyur mid rtsa ba nas gtong mi chog 〉〉ces pa'i ched brjod spel te/ ‘‘bod — 136 —

sdod rgya rigs yongs rdzogs phyir 'bud byed pa'i don rkyen 'di ni a ri dang dbyin ji'i byus bkod 'og kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brang pa ne he ru dang bod du yod pa'i btsan dga' shog kha ngan 'brel byas te gung khran tang la ngo rgol byed pa'i bya ba zhig red/a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas snga sa nas krung rgo'i mnga' khongs bod 'di kho pa tsho'i mi ser spel yul du 'gyur ched snga rjes su bod la drag po'i btsan 'dzul dang /so pa mang po btang ste rgyal gces stobs shugs la rdung rdeg btang ba ma zad/ kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brang pa gso skyong yang byas te g.yo thabs la brten nas bod kyi dbang cha bzung /bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral btang ste btsan rgyal ring lugs pas khyur mid gtong ba'i bsam tshul 'di ni nyin mo'i gi lam lta bu yin pas rtsa ba nas 'grub thabs med pa zhig red/ krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid byas pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis bod dang mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs sa cha yongs rdzogs bcings 'grol gtong nges yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas pa red/

bdun pa/ bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs kyis kha bral ring lugs par ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas te srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab khri nas phab pa'i skor/gong du smras pa ltar/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das rjes bod kyi gnas tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas su gyur pa dang / kha bral dang kha bral la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de nyin bzhin rno ngar can du gyur/ lhag par du stag brag shog khas g.yo thabs la brten nas bod kyi srid dbang ham bzung byas rjes mes bod kha bral gtong ba'i bya ngan rab dang rim pa spel ba der bod kyi ser skya mang tshogs yongs nas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ 'on kyang stag brag shog khas mes rgyal dang bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs kyi khe phan la ma bltos par ‘‘bod rang btsan mi zhes pa'i sdig nyesta kyi dmigs yul de sgrub ched mu mthud a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs dang / dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs/ rgya gar gyi log spyod stobs shugs bcas — 138 —

dang ngan 'brel byas te mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du skyod par 'gog rgol byas shing / dper na/ ya ri'i sau pa la'o 'ar thang mu sis bka' shag tu btang ba'i yi ge'i nang ‘‘ngas gzi brjid ngang rang rgyal gyi tsung thung tu'u lu men mjal thub pa byung ba ma zad/ khyed tsho'i srid gzhung gi yi ge de yang khong la phul zin pa yin/ lhag par du bod kyi rang btsan la 'jigs skul phog stabs deng rabs kyi mtshon cha dang /dmag don byus 'dri ba sogs rgyab skyor rogs ram yong ba zhu skabs sku zhabs tu'u lu men gyis khyed tshor gdung sems mnyam skye gnang gi 'dug de bzhin a ri'i rgyal don blon chen ad ji sun gyis bod la rgyab skyor byed dgos na bod kyi gnas tshul la zhib phra'i brtag zhib byed dgos pas khyed lha sar skyod skabs 'thus mi tshogs pa zhig yul skor spro 'cham gyi ming thog nas gtong gi yin zer ba sogs gtam 'chal mang tsam bshad yod pa red/ de bzhin la'o 'ar thang mu si bod du sdod skabs bka' shag gis kho par ‘‘gal srid gung khran tang gis bod la tshur rgol byas na a me ri kas bod la rogs ram gnang ngam/ rogs ram gnang na tshad gang 'dra zhig gnang gi red dam nyazhes dris par de'i lan du la'o 'ar thang mu sis ‘‘gal srid gung khran tang gis bod la tshur rgol byas na byang rgyud dang 44 〈〈bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus yig cha spyogs bkusata〉rgyar+yāg zhog grangs 78la gsal/da 139 da

khams kyi shar ngos nas dpung 'jug byed nges yin pas/ sa cha de gnyis kar lam rīthag ring tshad dbyin le drug brgya re yod pa red/ thog mar gyi lam thag dbyin le nyis brgya tsam 'gro bde tsam yod rung / de rjes kyi lam rnams 'gro dka' bas bod nas nges med rgol rdung ru khag rtsal ldan zhig sgrig 'dzugs byas tshe btsan 'dzul pa bkag 'gog byed thub pa zhig dang /kho tsho'i mkho sprod byed lam gcod thub pa zhig yong bas btsan 'dzul byed par mi dngos ha cang mang po gtong dgos pa zhig yong gi red/ de yang rtsal ldan dmag dpung de lta bu zhig sgrig 'dzugs byed par cha rkyen gnyis 'dzoms dgos pa ste/gcig ni mtshon cha (yang ba'i mtshon cha )gang 'tsham zhig mkho sbyor byed dgos pa dang / gnyis ni lag rtsal thad sbyong bdar byed dgos pa de red/ bod mir mtshon cha dang sbyong bdar yag po zhig byung na gong gsal gi 'gog srung gi las 'gan de khur thub kyi red ’ ⑫ces bshad/ dus der a ris me mda' ring mda' dang / me shin kan dang kreng kan zer ba'i me mda' sbag sbag lag 'bom sogs mtshon cha 'bor chen rgya gar brgyud bod du dbor nas gzhung zhabs ser skya lo na chung ba khag gcis dang / bod dmag rkang 'dzin pa khag gcig la mtshon cha gsar pa de dag bed spyod gtong lugs sogs skor 4) 〈〈bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus yig cha phyogs bsdusanyi〉rgya yig shog grangs 27/la gsal/— 140 —

dmas/ don sbyong bdar mang po byas pa ma zad/ dbyin ji'i so pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang las ka 'dra min sna tshogs la kha g.yar te bod du 'ongs thog mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis bod bcings 'grol gtong bar 'gog rgol byed pa'i ngan byus mang po btings pa red/ srid skyong stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog khas zhi drag gi thabs rnam pa sna tshogs la brten nas 'gog rkyen mang po bzos kyang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis da dung ngang rgyud ring pos kha ta bslab bya gnang ba dang / zhi ba'i thabs lam la brten nas bod bcings 'grol gtong ba'i ched du dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab rgya marngo+o mtsho sngon brgyud bod du bslab bya gnang bar gtong gnang mdzad/ 'on te dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab rgya mtsho nag chu khar 'byor skabs srid skyong stag brag dang bka' shag sogs kyi bka' bkod ltar drag shugs la brten nas phyir bskrad/ de rjes shis khams zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dge stag rin po che bod kyi mtho rim mi sna rnams la dge bshad sdig bkrol byed par chab mdo bar phebs pas de 'phral mdo smad spyi khyab kyis srid skyong stag brag dang bka' shag la snyan seng zhus par ‘‘dge stag sprul sku lha sar gtong mi chog la/ mar phyir log byas na'ang mi 'grigs zhes pa'i brda lan 'byor/ kho pa — 141 —
